1.zh: 不从恶人的计谋， 不站罪人的道路， 不坐亵慢人的座位，
1.en: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;

1.zh: 惟喜爱耶和华的律法， 昼夜思想， 这人便为有福！
1.en: but his delight is in the LORD’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.

1.zh: 他要像一棵树栽在溪水旁， 按时候结果子， 叶子也不枯干。 凡他所做的尽都顺利。
1.en: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

1.zh: 恶人并不是这样， 乃像糠秕被风吹散。
1.en: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.

1.zh: 因此，当审判的时候、恶人必站立不住； 罪人在义人的会中也是如此。
1.en: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

1.zh: 因为耶和华知道义人的道路； 恶人的道路却必灭亡。
1.en: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.

2.zh: 外邦为什么争闹？ 万民为什么谋算虚妄的事？
2.en: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

2.zh: 世上的君王一齐起来， 臣宰一同商议， 要敌挡耶和华并他的受膏者，
2.en: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his Anointed, saying,

2.zh: 说：我们要挣开他们的捆绑， 脱去他们的绳索。
2.en: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”

2.zh: 那坐在天上的必发笑； 主必嗤笑他们。
2.en: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.

2.zh: 那时，他要在怒中责备他们， 在烈怒中惊吓他们，
2.en: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:

2.zh: 说：我已经立我的君 在锡安—我的圣山上了。
2.en: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”

2.zh: [受膏者说]：我要传[圣]旨。 耶和华曾对我说：你是我的儿子， 我今日生你。
2.en: I will tell of the decree: The LORD said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.

2.zh: 你求我，我就将列国赐你为基业， 将地极赐你为田产。
2.en: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.

2.zh: 你必用铁杖打破他们； 你必将他们如同窑匠的瓦器摔碎。
2.en: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”

2.zh: 现在，你们君王应当省悟！ 你们世上的审判官该受管教！
2.en: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.

2.zh: 当存畏惧事奉耶和华， 又当存战兢而快乐。
2.en: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

2.zh: 当以嘴亲子，恐怕他发怒， 你们便在道中灭亡， 因为他的怒气快要发作。 凡投靠他的，都是有福的。
2.en: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.

3.zh: 大卫逃避他儿子押沙龙的时候作的诗。 耶和华啊，我的敌人何其加增； 有许多人起来攻击我。
3.en: A Psalm by David, when he fled from Absalom his son. LORD, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.

3.zh: 有许多人议论我说： 他得不着　神的帮助。 （细拉）
3.en: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.

3.zh: 但你—耶和华是我四围的盾牌， 是我的荣耀，又是叫我抬起头来的。
3.en: But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.

3.zh: 我用我的声音求告耶和华， 他就从他的圣山上应允我。 （细拉）
3.en: I cry to the LORD with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.

3.zh: 我躺下睡觉，我醒着， 耶和华都保佑我。
3.en: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for the LORD sustains me.

3.zh: 虽有成万的百姓来周围攻击我， 我也不怕。
3.en: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.

3.zh: 耶和华啊，求你起来！ 我的　神啊，求你救我！ 因为你打了我一切仇敌的腮骨， 敲碎了恶人的牙齿。
3.en: Arise, LORD! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.

3.zh: 救恩属乎耶和华； 愿你赐福给你的百姓。 （细拉）
3.en: Salvation belongs to the LORD. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.

4.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。用丝弦的乐器。 显我为义的　神啊， 我呼吁的时候，求你应允我！ 我在困苦中，你曾使我宽广； 现在求你怜恤我，听我的祷告！
4.en: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm by David. Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.

4.zh: 你们这上流人哪，你们将我的尊荣变为羞辱[要到几时呢]？ 你们喜爱虚妄，寻找虚假，要到几时呢？ （细拉）
4.en: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.

4.zh: 你们要知道，耶和华已经分别虔诚人归他自己； 我求告耶和华，他必听我。
4.en: But know that the LORD has set apart for himself him who is godly; The LORD will hear when I call to him.

4.zh: 你们应当畏惧，不可犯罪； 在床上的时候，要心里思想，并要肃静。 （细拉）
4.en: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.

4.zh: 当献上公义的祭， 又当倚靠耶和华。
4.en: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in the LORD.

4.zh: 有许多人说：谁能指示我们什么好处？ 耶和华啊，求你仰起脸来，光照我们。
4.en: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” LORD, let the light of your face shine on us.

4.zh: 你使我心里快乐， 胜过那丰收五谷新酒的人。
4.en: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.

4.zh: 我必安然躺下睡觉， 因为独有你—耶和华使我安然居住。
4.en: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.

5.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。用吹的乐器。 耶和华啊，求你留心听我的言语， 顾念我的心思！
5.en: For the Chief Musician, with the flutes. A Psalm by David. Give ear to my words, LORD. Consider my meditation.

5.zh: 我的王我的　神啊，求你垂听我呼求的声音！ 因为我向你祈祷。
5.en: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.

5.zh: 耶和华啊，早晨你必听我的声音； 早晨我必向你陈明[我的心意]，并要警醒！
5.en: LORD, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

5.zh: 因为你不是喜悦恶事的　神， 恶人不能与你同居。
5.en: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.

5.zh: 狂傲人不能站在你眼前； 凡作孽的，都是你所恨恶的。
5.en: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.

5.zh: 说谎言的，你必灭绝； 好流人血弄诡诈的，都为耶和华所憎恶。
5.en: You will destroy those who speak lies. The LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.

5.zh: 至于我，我必凭你丰盛的慈爱进入你的居所； 我必存敬畏你的心向你的圣殿下拜。
5.en: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.

5.zh: 耶和华啊，求你因我的仇敌，凭你的公义引领我， 使你的道路在我面前正直。
5.en: Lead me, LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.

5.zh: 因为，他们的口中没有诚实； 他们的心里满有邪恶； 他们的喉咙是敞开的坟墓； 他们用舌头谄媚人。
5.en: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.

5.zh: 神啊，求你定他们的罪！ 愿他们因自己的计谋跌倒； 愿你在他们许多的过犯中把他们逐出， 因为他们背叛了你。
5.en: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.

5.zh: 凡投靠你的，愿他们喜乐，时常欢呼， 因为你护庇他们； 又愿那爱你名的人都靠你欢欣。
5.en: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.

5.zh: 因为你必赐福与义人； 耶和华啊，你必用恩惠如同盾牌四面护卫他。
5.en: For you will bless the righteous. LORD, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.

6.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。用丝弦的乐器，调用第八。 耶和华啊，求你不要在怒中责备我， 也不要在烈怒中惩罚我！
6.en: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, upon the eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm by David. LORD, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.

6.zh: 耶和华啊，求你可怜我，因为我软弱。 耶和华啊，求你医治我，因为我的骨头发战。
6.en: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint. LORD, heal me, for my bones are troubled.

6.zh: 我心也大大地惊惶。 耶和华啊，你要到几时[才救我]呢？
6.en: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, LORD—how long?

6.zh: 耶和华啊，求你转回搭救我！ 因你的慈爱拯救我。
6.en: Return, LORD. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.

6.zh: 因为，在死地无人记念你， 在阴间有谁称谢你？
6.en: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?

6.zh: 我因唉哼而困乏； 我每夜流泪，把床榻漂起， 把褥子湿透。
6.en: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.

6.zh: 我因忧愁眼睛干瘪， 又因我一切的敌人眼睛昏花。
6.en: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.

6.zh: 你们一切作孽的人，离开我吧！ 因为耶和华听了我哀哭的声音。
6.en: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard the voice of my weeping.

6.zh: 耶和华听了我的恳求； 耶和华必收纳我的祷告。
6.en: The LORD has heard my supplication. The LORD accepts my prayer.

6.zh: 我的一切仇敌都必羞愧，大大惊惶； 他们必要退后，忽然羞愧。
6.en: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.

7.zh: 大卫指着便雅悯人古实的话，向耶和华唱的流离歌。 耶和华—我的　神啊，我投靠你！ 求你救我脱离一切追赶我的人，将我救拔出来！
7.en: A meditation by David, which he sang to the LORD, concerning the words of Cush, the Benjamite. LORD, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,

7.zh: 恐怕他们像狮子撕裂我， 甚至撕碎，无人搭救。
7.en: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.

7.zh: 耶和华—我的　神啊，我若行了这事， 若有罪孽在我手里，
7.en: LORD, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,

7.zh: 我若以恶报那与我交好的人— 连那无故与我为敌的，我也救了他，
7.en: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary),

7.zh: 就任凭仇敌追赶我，直到追上， 将我的性命踏在地下， 使我的荣耀归于灰尘。 （细拉）
7.en: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.

7.zh: 耶和华啊，求你在怒中起来， 挺身而立，抵挡我敌人的暴怒！ 求你为我兴起！你已经命定施行审判！
7.en: Arise, LORD, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.

7.zh: 愿众民的会环绕你！ 愿你从其上归于高位！
7.en: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.

7.zh: 耶和华向众民施行审判； 耶和华啊，求你按我的公义和我心中的纯正判断我。
7.en: The LORD administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, LORD, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.

7.zh: 愿恶人的恶断绝！ 愿你坚立义人！ 因为公义的　神察验人的心肠肺腑。
7.en: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.

7.zh: 神是我的盾牌； 他拯救心里正直的人。
7.en: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

7.zh: 神是公义的审判者， 又是天天[向恶人]发怒的　神。
7.en: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.

7.zh: 若有人不回头，他的刀必磨快， 弓必上弦，预备妥当了。
7.en: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.

7.zh: 他也预备了杀人的器械； 他所射的是火[箭]。
7.en: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.

7.zh: 试看恶人因奸恶而劬劳， 所怀的是毒害，所生的是虚假。
7.en: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.

7.zh: 他掘了坑，又挖深了， 竟掉在自己所挖的阱里。
7.en: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.

7.zh: 他的毒害必临到他自己的头上； 他的强暴必落到他自己的脑袋上。
7.en: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.

7.zh: 我要照着耶和华的公义称谢他， 歌颂耶和华至高者的名。
7.en: I will give thanks to the LORD according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.

8.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。用迦特乐器。 耶和华—我们的主啊， 你的名在全地何其美！ 你将你的荣耀彰显于天。
8.en: For the Chief Musician; on an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by David. LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!

8.zh: 你因敌人的缘故， 从婴孩和吃奶的口中， 建立了能力， 使仇敌和报仇的闭口无言。
8.en: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.

8.zh: 我观看你指头所造的天， 并你所陈设的月亮星宿，
8.en: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,

8.zh: [便说]：人算什么，你竟顾念他！ 世人算什么，你竟眷顾他！
8.en: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?

8.zh: 你叫他比天使微小一点， 并赐他荣耀尊贵为冠冕。
8.en: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.

8.zh: 你派他管理你手所造的， 使万物，就是一切的牛羊、 田野的兽、空中的鸟、海里的鱼， 凡经行海道的，都服在他的脚下。
8.en: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:
All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,
the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.

8.zh: 耶和华—我们的主啊， 你的名在全地何其美！
8.en: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!

9.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。调用慕拉便。 我要一心称谢耶和华； 我要传扬你一切奇妙的作为。
9.en: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm by David. I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.

9.zh: 我要因你欢喜快乐； 至高者啊，我要歌颂你的名！
9.en: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

9.zh: 我的仇敌转身退去的时候， 他们一见你的面就跌倒灭亡。
9.en: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.

9.zh: 因你已经为我伸冤，为我辨屈； 你坐在宝座上，按公义审判。
9.en: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.

9.zh: 你曾斥责外邦，你曾灭绝恶人； 你曾涂抹他们的名，直到永永远远。
9.en: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.

9.zh: 仇敌到了尽头； 他们被毁坏，直到永远。 你拆毁他们的城邑， 连他们的名号都归于无有。
9.en: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.

9.zh: 惟耶和华坐着[为王]，直到永远； 他已经为审判设摆他的宝座。
9.en: But the LORD reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.

9.zh: 他要按公义审判世界， 按正直判断万民。
9.en: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

9.zh: 耶和华又要给受欺压的人作高台， 在患难的时候作高台。
9.en: The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.

9.zh: 耶和华啊，认识你名的人要倚靠你， 因你没有离弃寻求你的人。
9.en: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.

9.zh: 应当歌颂居锡安的耶和华， 将他所行的传扬在众民中。
9.en: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.

9.zh: 因为那追讨流人血之罪的—他记念受屈的人， 不忘记困苦人的哀求。
9.en: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.

9.zh: 耶和华啊，你是从死门把我提拔起来的； 求你怜恤我，看那恨我的人所加给我的苦难，
9.en: Have mercy on me, LORD. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,

9.zh: 好叫我述说你一切的美德； 我必在锡安城的门因你的救恩欢乐。
9.en: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.

9.zh: 外邦人陷在自己所掘的坑中； 他们的脚在自己暗设的网罗里缠住了。
9.en: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.

9.zh: 耶和华已将自己显明了，他已施行审判； 恶人被自己手所做的缠住了。 （细拉）
9.en: The LORD has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.

9.zh: 恶人，就是忘记　神的外邦人， 都必归到阴间。
9.en: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.

9.zh: 穷乏人必不永久被忘； 困苦人的指望必不永远落空。
9.en: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

9.zh: 耶和华啊，求你起来，不容人得胜！ 愿外邦人在你面前受审判！
9.en: Arise, LORD! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.

9.zh: 耶和华啊，求你使外邦人恐惧； 愿他们知道自己不过是人。 （细拉）
9.en: Put them in fear, LORD. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.

10.zh: 耶和华啊，你为什么站在远处？ 在患难的时候为什么隐藏？
10.en: Why do you stand far off, LORD? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

10.zh: 恶人在骄横中把困苦人追得火急； 愿他们陷在自己所设的计谋里。
10.en: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.

10.zh: 因为恶人以心愿自夸； 贪财的背弃耶和华，并且轻慢他。
10.en: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns the LORD.

10.zh: 恶人面带骄傲，[说]：耶和华必不追究； 他一切所想的都以为没有　神。
10.en: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.

10.zh: 凡他所做的，时常稳固； 你的审判超过他的眼界。 至于他一切的敌人， 他都向他们喷气。
10.en: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.

10.zh: 他心里说：我必不动摇， 世世代代不遭灾难。
10.en: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”

10.zh: 他满口是咒骂、诡诈、欺压， 舌底是毒害、奸恶。
10.en: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.

10.zh: 他在村庄埋伏等候； 他在隐密处杀害无辜的人。 他的眼睛窥探无倚无靠的人；
10.en: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.

10.zh: 他埋伏在暗地，如狮子蹲在洞中。 他埋伏，要掳去困苦人； 他拉网，就把困苦人掳去。
10.en: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net.

10.zh: 他屈身蹲伏， 无倚无靠的人就倒在他爪牙之下。
10.en: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.

10.zh: 他心里说：　神竟忘记了； 他掩面永不观看。
10.en: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”

10.zh: 耶和华啊，求你起来！ 　神啊，求你举手，不要忘记困苦人！
10.en: Arise, LORD! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.

10.zh: 恶人为何轻慢　神， 心里说：你必不追究？
10.en: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?

10.zh: [其实]你已经观看； 因为奸恶毒害，你都看见了， 为要以手施行报应。 无倚无靠的人把[自己]交托你； 你向来是帮助孤儿的。
10.en: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.

10.zh: 愿你打断恶人的膀臂； 至于坏人，愿你追究他的恶，直到净尽。
10.en: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.

10.zh: 耶和华永永远远为王； 外邦人从他的地已经灭绝了。
10.en: The LORD is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.

10.zh: 耶和华啊，谦卑人的心愿， 你早已知道。 你必预备他们的心， 也必侧耳听他们[的祈求]，
10.en: LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,

10.zh: 为要给孤儿和受欺压的人伸冤， 使强横的人不再威吓他们。
10.en: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.

11.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。 我是投靠耶和华； 你们怎么对我说：你当像鸟飞往你的山去。
11.en: For the Chief Musician. By David. In the LORD, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?

11.zh: 看哪，恶人弯弓，把箭搭在弦上， 要在暗中射那心里正直的人。
11.en: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.

11.zh: 根基若毁坏， 义人还能做什么呢？
11.en: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?

11.zh: 耶和华在他的圣殿里； 耶和华的宝座在天上； 他的慧眼察看世人。
11.en: The LORD is in his holy temple. The LORD is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.

11.zh: 耶和华试验义人； 惟有恶人和喜爱强暴的人，他心里恨恶。
11.en: The LORD examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.

11.zh: 他要向恶人密布网罗； 有烈火、硫磺、热风，作他们杯中的分。
11.en: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.

11.zh: 因为耶和华是公义的，他喜爱公义； 正直人必得见他的面。
11.en: For the LORD is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.

12.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。调用第八。 耶和华啊，求你帮助，因虔诚人断绝了； 世人中间的忠信人没有了。
12.en: For the Chief Musician; upon an eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm of David. Help, LORD; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

12.zh: 人人向邻舍说谎； 他们说话，是嘴唇油滑，心口不一。
12.en: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.

12.zh: 凡油滑的嘴唇和夸大的舌头， 耶和华必要剪除。
12.en: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,

12.zh: 他们曾说：我们必能以舌头得胜； 我们的嘴唇是我们自己的， 谁能作我们的主呢？
12.en: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”

12.zh: 耶和华说：因为困苦人的冤屈 和贫穷人的叹息， 我现在要起来， 把他安置在他所切慕的稳妥之地。
12.en: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”

12.zh: 耶和华的言语是纯净的言语， 如同银子在泥炉中炼过七次。
12.en: The LORD’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.

12.zh: 耶和华啊，你必保护他们； 你必保佑他们永远脱离这世代的人。
12.en: You will keep them, LORD. You will preserve them from this generation forever.

12.zh: 下流人在世人中升高， 就有恶人到处游行。
12.en: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.

13.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。 耶和华啊，你忘记我要到几时呢？要到永远吗？ 你掩面不顾我要到几时呢？
13.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

13.zh: 我心里筹算，终日愁苦，要到几时呢？ 我的仇敌升高压制我，要到几时呢？
13.en: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?

13.zh: 耶和华—我的　神啊，求你看顾我，应允我！ 使我眼目光明，免得我沉睡至死；
13.en: Behold, and answer me, LORD, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;

13.zh: 免得我的仇敌说：我胜了他； 免得我的敌人在我摇动的时候喜乐。
13.en: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.

13.zh: 但我倚靠你的慈爱； 我的心因你的救恩快乐。
13.en: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.

13.zh: 我要向耶和华歌唱， 因他用厚恩待我。
13.en: I will sing to the LORD, because he has been good to me.

14.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。 愚顽人心里说：没有　神。 他们都是邪恶，行了可憎恶的事； 没有一个人行善。
14.en: For the Chief Musician. By David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.

14.zh: 耶和华从天上垂看世人， 要看有明白的没有， 有寻求　神的没有。
14.en: The LORD looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.

14.zh: 他们都偏离正路， 一同变为污秽； 并没有行善的， 连一个也没有。
14.en: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

14.zh: 作孽的都没有知识吗？ 他们吞吃我的百姓，[如同]吃饭一样， 并不求告耶和华。
14.en: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on the LORD?

14.zh: 他们在那里大大地害怕， 因为　神在义人的族类中。
14.en: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.

14.zh: 你们叫困苦人的谋算变为羞辱； 然而耶和华是他的避难所。
14.en: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.

14.zh: 但愿以色列的救恩从锡安而出。 耶和华救回他被掳的子民那时， 雅各要快乐，以色列要欢喜。
14.en: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

15.zh: 大卫的诗。 耶和华啊，谁能寄居你的帐幕？ 谁能住在你的圣山？
15.en: A Psalm by David. LORD, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?

15.zh: 就是行为正直、做事公义、 心里说实话的人。
15.en: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;

15.zh: 他不以舌头谗谤人， 不恶待朋友， 也不随伙毁谤邻里。
15.en: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;

15.zh: 他眼中藐视匪类， 却尊重那敬畏耶和华的人。 他发了誓，虽然自己吃亏也不更改。
15.en: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear the LORD; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;

15.zh: 他不放债取利， 不受贿赂以害无辜。 行这些事的人必永不动摇。
15.en: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.

16.zh: 大卫的金诗。 　神啊，求你保佑我， 因为我投靠你。
16.en: A Poem by David. Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.

16.zh: [我的心哪]，你曾对耶和华说：你是我的主； 我的好处不在你以外。
16.en: My soul, you have said to the LORD, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”

16.zh: 论到世上的圣民，他们又美又善， 是我最喜悦的。
16.en: As for the saints who are on the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.

16.zh: 以别[神]代替[耶和华]的， 他们的愁苦必加增； 他们所浇奠的血我不献上； 我嘴唇也不提别神的名号。
16.en: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.

16.zh: 耶和华是我的产业， 是我杯中的分； 我所得的，你为我持守。
16.en: The LORD assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.

16.zh: 用绳量给我的地界，坐落在佳美之处； 我的产业实在美好。
16.en: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.

16.zh: 我必称颂那指教我的耶和华； 我的心肠在夜间也警戒我。
16.en: I will bless the LORD, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.

16.zh: 我将耶和华常摆在我面前， 因他在我右边，我便不致摇动。
16.en: I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

16.zh: 因此，我的心欢喜，我的灵快乐； 我的肉身也要安然居住。
16.en: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.

16.zh: 因为你必不将我的灵魂撇在阴间， 也不叫你的圣者见朽坏。
16.en: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.

16.zh: 你必将生命的道路指示我。 在你面前有满足的喜乐； 在你右手中有永远的福乐。
16.en: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.

17.zh: 大卫的祈祷。 耶和华啊，求你听闻公义， 侧耳听我的呼吁！ 求你留心听我这不出于诡诈嘴唇的祈祷！
17.en: A Prayer by David. Hear, LORD, my righteous plea. Give ear to my prayer that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.

17.zh: 愿我的判语从你面前发出； 愿你的眼睛观看公正。
17.en: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.

17.zh: 你已经试验我的心； 你在夜间鉴察我； 你熬炼我，却找不着什么； 我立志叫我口中没有过失。
17.en: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.

17.zh: 论到人的行为，我借着你嘴唇的言语自己谨守， 不行强暴人的道路。
17.en: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.

17.zh: 我的脚踏定了你的路径； 我的两脚未曾滑跌。
17.en: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.

17.zh: 神啊，我曾求告你，因为你必应允我； 求你向我侧耳，听我的言语。
17.en: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.

17.zh: 求你显出你奇妙的慈爱来； 你是那用右手拯救投靠你的脱离起来攻击他们的人。
17.en: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.

17.zh: 求你保护我，如同保护眼中的瞳人； 将我隐藏在你翅膀的荫下，
17.en: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,

17.zh: 使我脱离那欺压我的恶人， 就是围困我要害我命的仇敌。
17.en: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.

17.zh: 他们的心被脂油包裹； 他们用口说骄傲的话。
17.en: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.

17.zh: 他们围困了我们的脚步； 他们瞪着眼，要把我们推倒在地。
17.en: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.

17.zh: 他像狮子急要抓食， 又像少壮狮子蹲伏在暗处。
17.en: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

17.zh: 耶和华啊，求你起来，前去迎敌，将他打倒！ 用你的刀救护我命脱离恶人。
17.en: Arise, LORD, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword,

17.zh: 耶和华啊，求你用手救我脱离[世]人， 脱离那只在今生有福分的世人！ 你把你的财宝充满他们的肚腹； 他们因有儿女就心满意足， 将其余的财物留给他们的婴孩。
17.en: from men by your hand, LORD, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.

17.zh: 至于我，我必在义中见你的面； 我醒了的时候，得见你的形象就心满意足了。
17.en: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.

18.zh: 耶和华的仆人大卫的诗，交与伶长。当耶和华救他脱离一切仇敌和扫罗之手的日子，他向耶和华念这诗的话。说： 耶和华，我的力量啊，我爱你！
18.en: For the Chief Musician. By David the servant of the LORD, who spoke to the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul. He said, I love you, LORD, my strength.

18.zh: 耶和华是我的岩石，我的山寨，我的救主， 我的　神，我的磐石，我所投靠的。 他是我的盾牌， 是拯救我的角，是我的高台。
18.en: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

18.zh: 我要求告当赞美的耶和华； 这样我必从仇敌手中被救出来。
18.en: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.

18.zh: 曾有死亡的绳索缠绕我， 匪类的急流使我惊惧，
18.en: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

18.zh: 阴间的绳索缠绕我， 死亡的网罗临到我。
18.en: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.

18.zh: 我在急难中求告耶和华， 向我的　神呼求。 他从殿中听了我的声音； 我在他面前的呼求入了他的耳中。
18.en: In my distress I called on the LORD, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.

18.zh: 那时，因他发怒，地就摇撼战抖； 山的根基也震动摇撼。
18.en: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.

18.zh: 从他鼻孔冒烟上腾； 从他口中发火焚烧，连炭也着了。
18.en: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.

18.zh: 他又使天下垂，亲自降临， 有黑云在他脚下。
18.en: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.

18.zh: 他坐着基路伯飞行； 他借着风的翅膀快飞。
18.en: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.

18.zh: 他以黑暗为藏身之处， 以水的黑暗、天空的厚云为他四围的行宫。
18.en: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

18.zh: 因他面前的光辉， 他的厚云行过便有冰雹火炭。
18.en: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.

18.zh: 耶和华也在天上打雷； 至高者发出声音便有冰雹火炭。
18.en: The LORD also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.

18.zh: 他射出箭来，使仇敌四散； 多多发出闪电，使他们扰乱。
18.en: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them. He routed them with great lightning bolts.

18.zh: 耶和华啊，你的斥责一发， 你鼻孔的气一出， 海底就出现， 大地的根基也显露。
18.en: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, LORD, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.

18.zh: 他从高天伸手抓住我， 把我从大水中拉上来。
18.en: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.

18.zh: 他救我脱离我的劲敌和那些恨我的人， 因为他们比我强盛。
18.en: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

18.zh: 我遭遇灾难的日子，他们来攻击我； 但耶和华是我的倚靠。
18.en: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my support.

18.zh: 他又领我到宽阔之处； 他救拔我，因他喜悦我。
18.en: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

18.zh: 耶和华按着我的公义报答我， 按着我手中的清洁赏赐我。
18.en: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.

18.zh: 因为我遵守了耶和华的道， 未曾作恶离开我的　神。
18.en: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

18.zh: 他的一切典章常在我面前； 他的律例我也未曾丢弃。
18.en: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.

18.zh: 我在他面前作了完全人； 我也保守自己远离我的罪孽。
18.en: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.

18.zh: 所以，耶和华按我的公义， 按我在他眼前手中的清洁偿还我。
18.en: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

18.zh: 慈爱的人，你以慈爱待他； 完全的人，你以完全待他。
18.en: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.

18.zh: 清洁的人，你以清洁待他； 乖僻的人，你以弯曲待他。
18.en: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.

18.zh: 困苦的百姓，你必拯救； 高傲的眼目，你必使他降卑。
18.en: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.

18.zh: 你必点着我的灯； 耶和华—我的　神必照明我的黑暗。
18.en: For you will light my lamp, LORD. My God will light up my darkness.

18.zh: 我借着你冲入敌军， 借着我的　神跳过墙垣。
18.en: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

18.zh: 至于　神，他的道是完全的； 耶和华的话是炼净的。 凡投靠他的，他便作他们的盾牌。
18.en: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

18.zh: 除了耶和华，谁是　神呢？ 除了我们的　神，谁是磐石呢？
18.en: For who is God, except the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God,

18.zh: 惟有那以力量束我的腰、 使我行为完全的，他是　神。
18.en: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?

18.zh: 他使我的脚快如母鹿的[蹄]， 又使我在高处安稳。
18.en: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.

18.zh: 他教导我的手能以争战， 甚至我的膀臂能开铜弓。
18.en: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

18.zh: 你把你的救恩给我作盾牌； 你的右手扶持我； 你的温和使我为大。
18.en: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.

18.zh: 你使我脚下的地步宽阔； 我的脚未曾滑跌。
18.en: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.

18.zh: 我要追赶我的仇敌，并要追上他们； 不将他们灭绝，我总不归回。
18.en: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.

18.zh: 我要打伤他们，使他们不能起来； 他们必倒在我的脚下。
18.en: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.

18.zh: 因为你曾以力量束我的腰，使我能争战； 你也使那起来攻击我的都服在我以下。
18.en: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

18.zh: 你又使我的仇敌在我面前转背逃跑， 叫我能以剪除那恨我的人。
18.en: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

18.zh: 他们呼求，却无人拯救； 就是呼求耶和华，他也不应允。
18.en: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to the LORD, but he didn’t answer them.

18.zh: 我捣碎他们，如同风前的灰尘， 倒出他们，如同街上的泥土。
18.en: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.

18.zh: 你救我脱离百姓的争竞， 立我作列国的元首； 我素不认识的民必事奉我。
18.en: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.

18.zh: 他们一听见我的名声就必顺从我； 外邦人要投降我。
18.en: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.

18.zh: 外邦人要衰残， 战战兢兢地出他们的营寨。
18.en: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.

18.zh: 耶和华是活[神]。 愿我的磐石被人称颂； 愿救我的　神被人尊崇。
18.en: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,

18.zh: 这位　神，就是那为我伸冤、 使众民服在我以下的。
18.en: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.

18.zh: 你救我脱离仇敌， 又把我举起，高过那些起来攻击我的； 你救我脱离强暴的人。
18.en: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

18.zh: 耶和华啊，因此我要在外邦中称谢你， 歌颂你的名。
18.en: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

18.zh: 耶和华赐极大的救恩给他[所立]的王， 施慈爱给他的受膏者， 就是给大卫和他的后裔，直到永远。
18.en: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.

19.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。 诸天述说　神的荣耀； 穹苍传扬他的手段。
19.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

19.zh: 这日到那日发出言语； 这夜到那夜传出知识。
19.en: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.

19.zh: 无言无语， 也无声音可听。
19.en: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.

19.zh: 它的量带通遍天下， 它的言语传到地极。 　神在其间为太阳安设帐幕；
19.en: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,

19.zh: 太阳如同新郎出洞房， 又如勇士欢然奔路。
19.en: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.

19.zh: 它从天这边出来，绕到天那边， 没有一物被隐藏不得它的热气。
19.en: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.

19.zh: 耶和华的律法全备，能苏醒人心； 耶和华的法度确定，能使愚人有智慧。
19.en: The LORD’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.

19.zh: 耶和华的训词正直，能快活人的心； 耶和华的命令清洁，能明亮人的眼目。
19.en: The LORD’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. The LORD’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.

19.zh: 耶和华的道理洁净，存到永远； 耶和华的典章真实，全然公义—
19.en: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever. The LORD’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.

19.zh: 都比金子可羡慕，且比极多的精金可羡慕； 比蜜甘甜，且比蜂房下滴的蜜甘甜。
19.en: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.

19.zh: 况且你的仆人因此受警戒， 守着这些便有大赏。
19.en: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.

19.zh: 谁能知道[自己的]错失呢？ 愿你赦免我隐而未现的[过错]。
19.en: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.

19.zh: 求你拦阻仆人不犯任意妄为的罪， 不容这罪辖制我， 我便完全，免犯大罪。
19.en: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.

19.zh: 耶和华—我的磐石，我的救赎主啊， 愿我口中的言语、心里的意念在你面前蒙悦纳。
19.en: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.

20.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。 愿耶和华在你遭难的日子应允你； 愿名为雅各　神的高举你。
20.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,

20.zh: 愿他从圣所救助你， 从锡安坚固你，
20.en: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,

20.zh: 记念你的一切供献， 悦纳你的燔祭， （细拉）
20.en: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.

20.zh: 将你心所愿的赐给你， 成就你的一切筹算。
20.en: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.

20.zh: 我们要因你的救恩夸胜， 要奉我们　神的名竖立旌旗。 愿耶和华成就你一切所求的！
20.en: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May the LORD grant all your requests.

20.zh: 现在我知道耶和华救护他的受膏者， 必从他的圣天上应允他， 用右手的能力救护他。
20.en: Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.

20.zh: 有人[靠]车，有人[靠]马， 但我们要提到耶和华—我们　神的名。
20.en: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.

20.zh: 他们都屈身仆倒， 我们却起来，立得正直。
20.en: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.

20.zh: 求耶和华施行拯救； 我们呼求的时候，愿王应允我们！
20.en: Save, LORD! Let the King answer us when we call!

21.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。 耶和华啊，王必因你的能力欢喜； 因你的救恩，他的快乐何其大！
21.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The king rejoices in your strength, LORD! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!

21.zh: 他心里所愿的，你已经赐给他； 他嘴唇所求的，你未尝不应允。 （细拉）
21.en: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.

21.zh: 你以美福迎接他， 把精金的冠冕戴在他头上。
21.en: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.

21.zh: 他向你求寿，你便赐给他， 就是日子长久，直到永远。
21.en: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.

21.zh: 他因你的救恩大有荣耀； 你又将尊荣威严加在他身上。
21.en: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.

21.zh: 你使他有洪福，直到永远， 又使他在你面前欢喜快乐。
21.en: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.

21.zh: 王倚靠耶和华， 因至高者的慈爱必不摇动。
21.en: For the king trusts in the LORD. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.

21.zh: 你的手要搜出你的一切仇敌； 你的右手要搜出那些恨你的人。
21.en: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.

21.zh: 你发怒的时候，要使他们如在炎热的火炉中。 耶和华要在他的震怒中吞灭他们； 那火要把他们烧尽了。
21.en: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. The LORD will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.

21.zh: 你必从世上灭绝他们的子孙， 从人间灭绝他们的后裔。
21.en: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.

21.zh: 因为他们有意加害于你； 他们想出计谋，却不能作成。
21.en: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.

21.zh: 你必使他们转背逃跑， 向他们的脸搭箭在弦。
21.en: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.

21.zh: 耶和华啊，愿你因自己的能力显为至高！ 这样，我们就唱诗，歌颂你的大能。
21.en: Be exalted, LORD, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.

22.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。调用朝鹿。 我的　神，我的　神！为什么离弃我？ [为什么]远离不救我？不听我唉哼的言语？
22.en: For the Chief Musician; set to “The Doe of the Morning.” A Psalm by David. My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?

22.zh: 我的　神啊，我白日呼求，你不应允， 夜间呼求，并不住声。
22.en: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.

22.zh: 但你是圣洁的， 是用以色列的赞美为宝座的。
22.en: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.

22.zh: 我们的祖宗倚靠你； 他们倚靠你，你便解救他们。
22.en: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.

22.zh: 他们哀求你，便蒙解救； 他们倚靠你，就不羞愧。
22.en: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.

22.zh: 但我是虫，不是人， 被众人羞辱，被百姓藐视。
22.en: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.

22.zh: 凡看见我的都嗤笑我； 他们撇嘴摇头，[说]：
22.en: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,

22.zh: 他把[自己]交托耶和华，耶和华可以救他吧！ 耶和华既喜悦他，可以搭救他吧！
22.en: “He trusts in the LORD. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”

22.zh: 但你是叫我出母腹的； 我在母怀里，你就使我有倚靠的心。
22.en: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.

22.zh: 我自出母胎就被交在你手里； 从我母亲生我，你就是我的　神。
22.en: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.

22.zh: 求你不要远离我！ 因为急难临近了，没有人帮助我。
22.en: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.

22.zh: 有许多公牛围绕我， 巴珊大力的公牛四面困住我。
22.en: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.

22.zh: 它们向我张口， 好像抓撕吼叫的狮子。
22.en: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.

22.zh: 我如水被倒出来； 我的骨头都脱了节； 我心在我里面如蜡熔化。
22.en: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.

22.zh: 我的精力枯干，如同瓦片； 我的舌头贴在我牙床上。 你将我安置在死地的尘土中。
22.en: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.

22.zh: 犬类围着我，恶党环绕我； 他们扎了我的手，我的脚。
22.en: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.

22.zh: 我的骨头，我都能数过； 他们瞪着眼看我。
22.en: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.

22.zh: 他们分我的外衣， 为我的里衣拈阄。
22.en: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.

22.zh: 耶和华啊，求你不要远离我！ 我的救主啊，求你快来帮助我！
22.en: But don’t be far off, LORD. You are my help. Hurry to help me!

22.zh: 求你救我的灵魂脱离刀剑， 救我的生命脱离犬类，
22.en: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.

22.zh: 救我脱离狮子的口； 你已经应允我，使我脱离野牛的角。
22.en: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.

22.zh: 我要将你的名传与我的弟兄， 在会中我要赞美你。
22.en: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.

22.zh: 你们敬畏耶和华的人要赞美他！ 雅各的后裔都要荣耀他！ 以色列的后裔都要惧怕他！
22.en: You who fear the LORD, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!

22.zh: 因为他没有藐视憎恶受苦的人， 也没有向他掩面； 那受苦之人呼吁的时候，他就垂听。
22.en: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.

22.zh: 我在大会中赞美你的话是从你而来的； 我要在敬畏耶和华的人面前还我的愿。
22.en: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.

22.zh: 谦卑的人必吃得饱足； 寻求耶和华的人必赞美他。 愿你们的心永远活着！
22.en: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise the LORD who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.

22.zh: 地的四极都要想念耶和华，并且归顺他； 列国的万族都要在你面前敬拜。
22.en: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the LORD. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.

22.zh: 因为国权是耶和华的； 他是管理万国的。
22.en: For the kingdom is the LORD’s. He is the ruler over the nations.

22.zh: 地上一切丰肥的人必吃喝而敬拜； 凡下到尘土中—不能存活自己性命的人 —都要在他面前下拜。
22.en: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.

22.zh: 他必有后裔事奉他； 主所行的事必传与后代。
22.en: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.

22.zh: 他们必来把他的公义传给将要生的民， 言明这事是他所行的。
22.en: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.

23.zh: 大卫的诗。 耶和华是我的牧者， 我必不致缺乏。
23.en: A Psalm by David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.

23.zh: 他使我躺卧在青草地上， 领我在可安歇的水边。
23.en: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

23.zh: 他使我的灵魂苏醒， 为自己的名引导我走义路。
23.en: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

23.zh: 我虽然行过死荫的[幽]谷， 也不怕遭害， 因为你与我同在； 你的杖，你的竿，都安慰我。
23.en: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

23.zh: 在我敌人面前，你为我摆设筵席； 你用油膏了我的头，使我的[福]杯满溢。
23.en: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.

23.zh: 我一生一世必有恩惠慈爱随着我； 我且要住在耶和华的殿中，直到永远。
23.en: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.

24.zh: 大卫的诗。 地和其中所充满的， 世界和住在其间的，都属耶和华。
24.en: A Psalm by David. The earth is the LORD’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.

24.zh: 他把地建立在海上， 安定在大水之上。
24.en: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.

24.zh: 谁能登耶和华的山？ 谁能站在他的圣所？
24.en: Who may ascend to the LORD’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?

24.zh: 就是手洁心清，不向虚妄， 起誓不怀诡诈的人。
24.en: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.

24.zh: 他必蒙耶和华赐福， 又蒙救他的　神使他成义。
24.en: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, righteousness from the God of his salvation.

24.zh: 这是寻求耶和华的族类， 是寻求你面的雅各。 （细拉）
24.en: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.

24.zh: 众城门哪，你们要抬起头来！ 永久的门户，你们要被举起！ 那荣耀的王将要进来！
24.en: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

24.zh: 荣耀的王是谁呢？ 就是有力有能的耶和华， 在战场上有能的耶和华！
24.en: Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

24.zh: 众城门哪，你们要抬起头来！ 永久的门户，你们要把头抬起！ 那荣耀的王将要进来！
24.en: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

24.zh: 荣耀的王是谁呢？ 万军之耶和华， 他是荣耀的王！ （细拉）
24.en: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.

25.zh: 大卫的诗。 耶和华啊，我的心仰望你。
25.en: By David. To you, LORD, I lift up my soul.

25.zh: 我的　神啊，我素来倚靠你； 求你不要叫我羞愧， 不要叫我的仇敌向我夸胜。
25.en: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.

25.zh: 凡等候你的必不羞愧； 惟有那无故行奸诈的必要羞愧。
25.en: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.

25.zh: 耶和华啊，求你将你的道指示我， 将你的路教训我！
25.en: Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths.

25.zh: 求你以你的真理引导我，教训我， 因为你是救我的　神。 我终日等候你。
25.en: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.

25.zh: 耶和华啊，求你记念你的怜悯和慈爱， 因为这是亘古以来所常有的。
25.en: LORD, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.

25.zh: 求你不要记念我幼年的罪愆和我的过犯； 耶和华啊，求你因你的恩惠，按你的慈爱记念我。
25.en: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, LORD.

25.zh: 耶和华是良善正直的， 所以他必指示罪人走[正]路。
25.en: Good and upright is the LORD, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.

25.zh: 他必按公平引领谦卑人， 将他的道教训他们。
25.en: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.

25.zh: 凡遵守他的约和他法度的人， 耶和华都以慈爱诚实待他。
25.en: All the paths of the LORD are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

25.zh: 耶和华啊，求你因你的名赦免我的罪， 因为我的罪重大。
25.en: For your name’s sake, LORD, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.

25.zh: 谁敬畏耶和华， 耶和华必指示他当选择的道路。
25.en: What man is he who fears the LORD? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.

25.zh: 他必安然居住； 他的后裔必承受地土。
25.en: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.

25.zh: 耶和华与敬畏他的人亲密； 他必将自己的约指示他们。
25.en: The friendship of the LORD is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.

25.zh: 我的眼目时常仰望耶和华， 因为他必将我的脚从网里拉出来。
25.en: My eyes are ever on the LORD, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.

25.zh: 求你转向我，怜恤我， 因为我是孤独困苦。
25.en: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.

25.zh: 我心里的愁苦甚多， 求你救我脱离我的祸患。
25.en: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.

25.zh: 求你看顾我的困苦，我的艰难， 赦免我一切的罪。
25.en: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.

25.zh: 求你察看我的仇敌， 因为他们人多，并且痛痛地恨我。
25.en: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.

25.zh: 求你保护我的性命，搭救我， 使我不致羞愧，因为我投靠你。
25.en: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.

25.zh: 愿纯全、正直保守我， 因为我等候你。
25.en: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.

25.zh: 神啊，求你救赎以色列脱离他一切的愁苦。
25.en: God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.

26.zh: 大卫的诗。 耶和华啊，求你为我伸冤， 因我向来行事纯全； 我又倚靠耶和华，并不摇动。
26.en: By David. Judge me, LORD, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in the LORD without wavering.

26.zh: 耶和华啊，求你察看我，试验我， 熬炼我的肺腑心肠。
26.en: Examine me, LORD, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.

26.zh: 因为你的慈爱常在我眼前， 我也按你的真理而行。
26.en: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.

26.zh: 我没有和虚谎人同坐， 也不与瞒哄人的同群。
26.en: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.

26.zh: 我恨恶恶人的会， 必不与恶人同坐。
26.en: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.

26.zh: 耶和华啊，我要洗手表明无辜， 才环绕你的祭坛；
26.en: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, LORD,

26.zh: 我好发称谢的声音， 也要述说你一切奇妙的作为。
26.en: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.

26.zh: 耶和华啊，我喜爱你所住的殿 和你显荣耀的居所。
26.en: LORD, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.

26.zh: 不要把我的灵魂和罪人一同除掉； 不要把我的性命和流人血的一同除掉。
26.en: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men

26.zh: 他们的手中有奸恶， 右手满有贿赂。
26.en: in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes.

26.zh: 至于我，却要行事纯全； 求你救赎我，怜恤我！
26.en: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.

26.zh: 我的脚站在平坦地方； 在众会中我要称颂耶和华！
26.en: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless the LORD.

27.zh: 大卫的诗。 耶和华是我的亮光，是我的拯救， 我还怕谁呢？ 耶和华是我性命的保障， 我还惧谁呢？
27.en: By David. The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

27.zh: 那作恶的就是我的仇敌， 前来吃我肉的时候就绊跌仆倒。
27.en: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.

27.zh: 虽有军兵安营攻击我，我的心也不害怕； 虽然兴起刀兵攻击我，我必仍旧安稳。
27.en: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.

27.zh: 有一件事，我曾求耶和华，我仍要寻求： 就是一生一世住在耶和华的殿中， 瞻仰他的荣美，在他的殿里求问。
27.en: One thing I have asked of the LORD, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in the LORD’s house all the days of my life, to see the LORD’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.

27.zh: 因为我遭遇患难，他必暗暗地保守我； 在他亭子里，把我藏在他帐幕的隐密处， 将我高举在磐石上。
27.en: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.

27.zh: 现在我得以昂首，高过四面的仇敌。 我要在他的帐幕里欢然献祭； 我要唱诗歌颂耶和华。
27.en: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the LORD.

27.zh: 耶和华啊，我用声音呼吁的时候，求你垂听； 并求你怜恤我，应允我。
27.en: Hear, LORD, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.

27.zh: [你说]：你们当寻求我的面。 那时我心向你说：耶和华啊， 你的面我正要寻求。
27.en: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, LORD.”

27.zh: 不要向我掩面。 不要发怒赶逐仆人， 你向来是帮助我的。 救我的　神啊，不要丢掉我， 也不要离弃我。
27.en: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.

27.zh: 我父母离弃我， 耶和华必收留我。
27.en: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.

27.zh: 耶和华啊，求你将你的道指教我， 因我仇敌的缘故引导我走平坦的路。
27.en: Teach me your way, LORD. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.

27.zh: 求你不要把我交给敌人，遂其所愿； 因为妄作见证的和口吐凶言的，起来攻击我。
27.en: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.

27.zh: 我若不信在活人之地得见耶和华的恩惠， [就早已丧胆了]。
27.en: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

27.zh: 要等候耶和华！ 当壮胆，坚固你的心！ 我再说，要等候耶和华！
27.en: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.

28.zh: 大卫的诗。 耶和华啊，我要求告你！ 我的磐石啊，不要向我缄默！ 倘若你向我闭口， 我就如将死的人一样。
28.en: By David. To you, LORD, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.

28.zh: 我呼求你，向你至圣所举手的时候， 求你垂听我恳求的声音！
28.en: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.

28.zh: 不要把我和恶人并作孽的一同除掉； 他们与邻舍说和平话，心里却是奸恶。
28.en: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.

28.zh: 愿你按着他们所做的， 并他们所行的恶事待他们。 愿你照着他们手所做的待他们， 将他们所应得的报应加给他们。
28.en: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.

28.zh: 他们既然不留心耶和华所行的和他手所做的， 他就必毁坏他们，不建立他们。
28.en: Because they don’t respect the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.

28.zh: 耶和华是应当称颂的， 因为他听了我恳求的声音。
28.en: Blessed be the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.

28.zh: 耶和华是我的力量，是我的盾牌； 我心里倚靠他就得帮助。 所以我心中欢乐， 我必用诗歌颂赞他。
28.en: The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

28.zh: 耶和华是他百姓的力量， 又是他受膏者得救的保障。
28.en: The LORD is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

28.zh: 求你拯救你的百姓，赐福给你的产业， 牧养他们，扶持他们，直到永远。
28.en: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.

29.zh: 大卫的诗。 　神的众子啊，你们要将荣耀、能力归给耶和华， 归给耶和华！
29.en: A Psalm by David. Ascribe to the LORD, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

29.zh: 要将耶和华的名所当得的荣耀归给他， 以圣洁的妆饰敬拜耶和华。
29.en: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Worship the LORD in holy array.

29.zh: 耶和华的声音发在水上； 荣耀的　神打雷， 耶和华打雷在大水之上。
29.en: The LORD’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even the LORD on many waters.

29.zh: 耶和华的声音大有能力； 耶和华的声音满有威严。
29.en: The LORD’s voice is powerful. The LORD’s voice is full of majesty.

29.zh: 耶和华的声音震破香柏树； 耶和华震碎黎巴嫩的香柏树。
29.en: The LORD’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

29.zh: 他也使之跳跃如牛犊， 使黎巴嫩和西连跳跃如野牛犊。
29.en: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.

29.zh: 耶和华的声音使火焰分岔。
29.en: The LORD’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.

29.zh: 耶和华的声音震动旷野； 耶和华震动加低斯的旷野。
29.en: The LORD’s voice shakes the wilderness. The LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

29.zh: 耶和华的声音惊动母鹿落胎， 树木也脱落净光。 凡在他殿中的，都称说[他的]荣耀。
29.en: The LORD’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”

29.zh: 洪水泛滥之时，耶和华坐着[为王]； 耶和华坐着为王，直到永远。
29.en: The LORD sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, the LORD sits as King forever.

29.zh: 耶和华必赐力量给他的百姓； 耶和华必赐平安的福给他的百姓。
29.en: The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.

30.zh: 大卫在献殿的时候，作这诗歌。 耶和华啊，我要尊崇你， 因为你曾提拔我，不叫仇敌向我夸耀。
30.en: A Psalm. A Song for the Dedication of the Temple. By David. I will extol you, LORD, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.

30.zh: 耶和华—我的　神啊， 我曾呼求你，你医治了我。
30.en: LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.

30.zh: 耶和华啊，你曾把我的灵魂从阴间救上来， 使我存活，不至于下坑。
30.en: LORD, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

30.zh: 耶和华的圣民哪，你们要歌颂他， 称赞他可记念的圣[名]。
30.en: Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.

30.zh: 因为，他的怒气不过是转眼之间； 他的恩典乃是一生之久。 一宿虽然有哭泣， 早晨便必欢呼。
30.en: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

30.zh: 至于我，我凡事平顺，便说： 我永不动摇。
30.en: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”

30.zh: 耶和华啊，你曾施恩，叫我的[江]山稳固； 你掩了面，我就惊惶。
30.en: You, LORD, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.

30.zh: 耶和华啊，我曾求告你； 我向耶和华恳求，[说]：
30.en: I cried to you, LORD. I made supplication to the Lord:

30.zh: 我被害流血，下到坑中，有什么益处呢？ 尘土岂能称赞你，传说你的诚实吗？
30.en: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?

30.zh: 耶和华啊，求你应允我，怜恤我！ 耶和华啊，求你帮助我！
30.en: Hear, LORD, and have mercy on me. LORD, be my helper.”

30.zh: 你已将我的哀哭变为跳舞， 将我的麻衣脱去，给我披上喜乐，
30.en: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,

30.zh: 好叫我的灵歌颂你，并不住声。 耶和华—我的　神啊，我要称谢你，直到永远！
30.en: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever!

31.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。 耶和华啊，我投靠你； 求你使我永不羞愧； 凭你的公义搭救我！
31.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. In you, LORD, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.

31.zh: 求你侧耳而听， 快快救我！ 作我坚固的磐石， 拯救我的保障！
31.en: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.

31.zh: 因为你是我的岩石，我的山寨； 所以，求你为你名的缘故引导我，指点我。
31.en: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.

31.zh: 求你救我脱离人为我暗设的网罗， 因为你是我的保障。
31.en: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.

31.zh: 我将我的灵魂交在你手里； 耶和华诚实的　神啊，你救赎了我。
31.en: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, LORD, God of truth.

31.zh: 我恨恶那信奉虚无[之神]的人； 我却倚靠耶和华。
31.en: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in the LORD.

31.zh: 我要为你的慈爱高兴欢喜； 因为你见过我的困苦，知道我心中的艰难。
31.en: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.

31.zh: 你未曾把我交在仇敌手里； 你使我的脚站在宽阔之处。
31.en: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.

31.zh: 耶和华啊，求你怜恤我， 因为我在急难之中； 我的眼睛因忧愁而干瘪， 连我的身心也不安舒。
31.en: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.

31.zh: 我的生命为愁苦所消耗； 我的年岁为叹息所旷废。 我的力量因我的罪孽衰败； 我的骨头也枯干。
31.en: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.

31.zh: 我因一切敌人成了羞辱， 在我的邻舍跟前更甚； 那认识我的都惧怕我， 在外头看见我的都躲避我。
31.en: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.

31.zh: 我被人忘记，如同死人，无人记念； 我好像破碎的器皿。
31.en: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.

31.zh: 我听见了许多人的谗谤， 四围都是惊吓； 他们一同商议攻击我的时候， 就图谋要害我的性命。
31.en: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.

31.zh: 耶和华啊，我仍旧倚靠你； 我说：你是我的　神。
31.en: But I trust in you, LORD. I said, “You are my God.”

31.zh: 我终身的事在你手中； 求你救我脱离仇敌的手和那些逼迫我的人。
31.en: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

31.zh: 求你使你的脸光照仆人， 凭你的慈爱拯救我。
31.en: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.

31.zh: 耶和华啊，求你叫我不致羞愧， 因为我曾呼吁你； 求你使恶人羞愧， 使他们在阴间缄默无声。
31.en: Let me not be disappointed, LORD, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.

31.zh: 那撒谎的人逞骄傲轻慢， 出狂妄的话攻击义人； 愿他的嘴哑而无言。
31.en: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.

31.zh: 敬畏你、投靠你的人，你为他们所积存的， 在世人面前所施行的恩惠是何等大呢！
31.en: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!

31.zh: 你必把他们藏在你面前的隐密处， 免得遇见人的计谋； 你必暗暗地保守他们在亭子里， 免受口舌的争闹。
31.en: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.

31.zh: 耶和华是应当称颂的， 因为他在坚固城里向我施展奇妙的慈爱。
31.en: Praise be to the LORD, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.

31.zh: 至于我，我曾急促地说： 我从你眼前被隔绝。 然而，我呼求你的时候， 你仍听我恳求的声音。
31.en: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.

31.zh: 耶和华的圣民哪，你们都要爱他！ 耶和华保护诚实人， 足足报应行事骄傲的人。
31.en: Oh love the LORD, all you his saints! The LORD preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.

31.zh: 凡仰望耶和华的人， 你们都要壮胆，坚固你们的心！
31.en: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.

32.zh: 大卫的训诲诗。 得赦免其过、遮盖其罪的， 这人是有福的！
32.en: By David. A contemplative psalm. Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

32.zh: 凡心里没有诡诈、耶和华不算为有罪的， 这人是有福的！
32.en: Blessed is the man to whom the LORD doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

32.zh: 我闭口不认罪的时候， 因终日唉哼而骨头枯干。
32.en: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

32.zh: 黑夜白日，你的手在我身上沉重； 我的精液耗尽，如同夏天的干旱。 （细拉）
32.en: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.

32.zh: 我向你陈明我的罪， 不隐瞒我的恶。 我说：我要向耶和华承认我的过犯， 你就赦免我的罪恶。 （细拉）
32.en: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the LORD, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

32.zh: 为此，凡虔诚人都当趁你可寻找的时候祷告你； 大水泛溢的时候，必不能到他那里。
32.en: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.

32.zh: 你是我藏身之处； 你必保佑我脱离苦难， 以得救的乐歌四面环绕我。 （细拉）
32.en: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.

32.zh: 我要教导你，指示你当行的路； 我要定睛在你身上劝戒你。
32.en: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

32.zh: 你不可像那无知的骡马， 必用嚼环辔头勒住它； 不然，就不能驯服。
32.en: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.

32.zh: 恶人必多受苦楚； 惟独倚靠耶和华的必有慈爱四面环绕他。
32.en: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in the LORD.

32.zh: 你们义人应当靠耶和华欢喜快乐； 你们心里正直的人都当欢呼。
32.en: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!

33.zh: 义人哪，你们应当靠耶和华欢乐； 正直人的赞美是合宜的。
33.en: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.

33.zh: 你们应当弹琴称谢耶和华， 用十弦瑟歌颂他。
33.en: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.

33.zh: 应当向他唱新歌， 弹得巧妙，声音洪亮。
33.en: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!

33.zh: 因为耶和华的言语正直； 凡他所做的尽都诚实。
33.en: For the LORD’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.

33.zh: 他喜爱仁义公平； 遍地满了耶和华的慈爱。
33.en: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD.

33.zh: 诸天借耶和华的命而造； 万象借他口中的气而成。
33.en: By the LORD’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.

33.zh: 他聚集海水如垒， 收藏深洋在库房。
33.en: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.

33.zh: 愿全地都敬畏耶和华！ 愿世上的居民都惧怕他！
33.en: Let all the earth fear the LORD. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

33.zh: 因为他说有，就有， 命立，就立。
33.en: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.

33.zh: 耶和华使列国的筹算归于无有， 使众民的思念无有功效。
33.en: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

33.zh: 耶和华的筹算永远立定； 他心中的思念万代常存。
33.en: The counsel of the LORD stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

33.zh: 以耶和华为　神的，那国是有福的！ 他所拣选为自己产业的，那民是有福的！
33.en: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

33.zh: 耶和华从天上观看； 他看见一切的世人。
33.en: The LORD looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.

33.zh: 从他的居所往外察看地上一切的居民—
33.en: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,

33.zh: 他是那造成他们众人心的， 留意他们一切作为的。
33.en: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.

33.zh: 君王不能因兵多得胜； 勇士不能因力大得救。
33.en: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

33.zh: 靠马得救是枉然的； 马也不能因力大救人。
33.en: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.

33.zh: 耶和华的眼目看顾敬畏他的人 和仰望他慈爱的人，
33.en: Behold, the LORD’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,

33.zh: 要救他们的命脱离死亡， 并使他们在饥荒中存活。
33.en: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.

33.zh: 我们的心向来等候耶和华； 他是我们的帮助，我们的盾牌。
33.en: Our soul has waited for the LORD. He is our help and our shield.

33.zh: 我们的心必靠他欢喜， 因为我们向来倚靠他的圣名。
33.en: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

33.zh: 耶和华啊，求你照着我们所仰望你的， 向我们施行慈爱！
33.en: Let your loving kindness be on us, LORD, since we have hoped in you.

34.zh: 大卫在亚比米勒面前装疯，被他赶出去，就作这诗。 我要时时称颂耶和华； 赞美他的话必常在我口中。
34.en: By David; when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.

34.zh: 我的心必因耶和华夸耀； 谦卑人听见就要喜乐。
34.en: My soul shall boast in the LORD. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.

34.zh: 你们和我当称耶和华为大， 一同高举他的名。
34.en: Oh magnify the LORD with me. Let’s exalt his name together.

34.zh: 我曾寻求耶和华，他就应允我， 救我脱离了一切的恐惧。
34.en: I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

34.zh: 凡仰望他的，便有光荣； 他们的脸必不蒙羞。
34.en: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.

34.zh: 我这困苦人呼求，耶和华便垂听， 救我脱离一切患难。
34.en: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

34.zh: 耶和华的使者在敬畏他的人四围安营， 搭救他们。
34.en: The LORD’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.

34.zh: 你们要尝尝[主恩的滋味]，便知道他是美善； 投靠他的人有福了！
34.en: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

34.zh: 耶和华的圣民哪，你们当敬畏他， 因敬畏他的一无所缺。
34.en: Oh fear the LORD, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.

34.zh: 少壮狮子还缺食忍饿， 但寻求耶和华的什么好处都不缺。
34.en: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.

34.zh: 众弟子啊，你们当来听我的话！ 我要将敬畏耶和华的道教训你们。
34.en: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

34.zh: 有何人喜好存活， 爱慕[长]寿，得享美福，
34.en: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?

34.zh: 就要禁止舌头不出恶言， 嘴唇不说诡诈的话。
34.en: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.

34.zh: 要离恶行善， 寻求和睦，一心追赶。
34.en: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.

34.zh: 耶和华的眼目看顾义人； 他的耳朵听他们的呼求。
34.en: The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.

34.zh: 耶和华向行恶的人变脸， 要从世上除灭他们的名号。
34.en: The LORD’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.

34.zh: [义人]呼求，耶和华听见了， 便救他们脱离一切患难。
34.en: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

34.zh: 耶和华靠近伤心的人， 拯救灵性痛悔的人。
34.en: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

34.zh: 义人多有苦难， 但耶和华救他脱离这一切，
34.en: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.

34.zh: 又保全他一身的骨头， 连一根也不折断。
34.en: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.

34.zh: 恶必害死恶人； 恨恶义人的，必被定罪。
34.en: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.

34.zh: 耶和华救赎他仆人的灵魂； 凡投靠他的，必不致定罪。
34.en: The LORD redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.

35.zh: 大卫的诗。 耶和华啊，与我相争的，求你与他们相争！ 与我相战的，求你与他们相战！
35.en: By David. Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.

35.zh: 拿着大小的盾牌， 起来帮助我。
35.en: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.

35.zh: 抽出枪来，挡住那追赶我的； 求你对我的灵魂说：我是拯救你的。
35.en: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”

35.zh: 愿那寻索我命的，蒙羞受辱！ 愿那谋害我的，退后羞愧！
35.en: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.

35.zh: 愿他们像风前的糠， 有耶和华的使者赶逐他们。
35.en: Let them be as chaff before the wind, the LORD’s angel driving them on.

35.zh: 愿他们的道路又暗又滑， 有耶和华的使者追赶他们。
35.en: Let their way be dark and slippery, the LORD’s angel pursuing them.

35.zh: 因他们无故地为我暗设网罗， 无故地挖坑，要害我的性命。
35.en: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.

35.zh: 愿灾祸忽然临到他身上！ 愿他暗设的网缠住自己！ 愿他落在其中遭灾祸！
35.en: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.

35.zh: 我的心必靠耶和华快乐， 靠他的救恩高兴。
35.en: My soul shall be joyful in the LORD. It shall rejoice in his salvation.

35.zh: 我的骨头都要说： 耶和华啊，谁能像你 救护困苦人脱离那比他强壮的， 救护困苦穷乏人脱离那抢夺他的？
35.en: All my bones shall say, “LORD, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”

35.zh: 凶恶的见证人起来， 盘问我所不知道的事。
35.en: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.

35.zh: 他们向我以恶报善， 使我的灵魂孤苦。
35.en: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.

35.zh: 至于我，当他们有病的时候， 我便穿麻衣，禁食，刻苦己心； 我所求的都归到自己的怀中。
35.en: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.

35.zh: 我这样行，好像他是我的朋友，我的弟兄； 我屈身悲哀，如同人为母亲哀痛。
35.en: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.

35.zh: 我在患难中，他们却欢喜，大家聚集。 我所不认识的那些下流人聚集攻击我； 他们不住地把我撕裂。
35.en: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.

35.zh: 他们如同席上好嬉笑的狂妄人向我咬牙。
35.en: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.

35.zh: 主啊，你看着不理要到几时呢？ 求你救我的灵魂脱离他们的残害！ 救我的生命脱离少壮狮子！
35.en: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.

35.zh: 我在大会中要称谢你， 在众民中要赞美你。
35.en: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.

35.zh: 求你不容那无理与我为仇的向我夸耀！ 不容那无故恨我的向我挤眼！
35.en: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.

35.zh: 因为他们不说和平话， 倒想出诡诈的言语害地上的安静人。
35.en: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.

35.zh: 他们大大张口攻击我，说： 阿哈，阿哈，我们的眼已经看见了！
35.en: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”

35.zh: 耶和华啊，你已经看见了，求你不要闭口！ 主啊，求你不要远离我！
35.en: You have seen it, LORD. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.

35.zh: 我的　神我的主啊，求你奋兴醒起， 判清我的事，伸明我的冤！
35.en: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!

35.zh: 耶和华—我的　神啊，求你按你的公义判断我， 不容他们向我夸耀！
35.en: Vindicate me, LORD my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.

35.zh: 不容他们心里说：阿哈，遂我们的心愿了！ 不容他们说：我们已经把他吞了！
35.en: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”

35.zh: 愿那喜欢我遭难的一同抱愧蒙羞！ 愿那向我妄自尊大的披惭愧，蒙羞辱！
35.en: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.

35.zh: 愿那喜悦我冤屈得伸的欢呼快乐； 愿他们常说：当尊耶和华为大！ 耶和华喜悦他的仆人平安。
35.en: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May the LORD be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”

35.zh: 我的舌头要终日论说你的公义， 时常赞美你。
35.en: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.

36.zh: 耶和华的仆人大卫的诗，交与伶长。 恶人的罪过在他心里说： 我眼中不怕　神！
36.en: For the Chief Musician. By David, the servant of the LORD. A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

36.zh: 他自夸自媚， 以为他的罪孽终不显露，不被恨恶。
36.en: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.

36.zh: 他口中的言语尽是罪孽诡诈； 他与智慧善行已经断绝。
36.en: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.

36.zh: 他在床上图谋罪孽， 定意行不善的道，不憎恶恶事。
36.en: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.

36.zh: 耶和华啊，你的慈爱上及诸天； 你的信实达到穹苍。
36.en: Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

36.zh: 你的公义好像高山； 你的判断如同深渊。 耶和华啊，人民、牲畜，你都救护。
36.en: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. LORD, you preserve man and animal.

36.zh: 神啊，你的慈爱何其宝贵！ 世人投靠在你翅膀的荫下。
36.en: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.

36.zh: 他们必因你殿里的肥甘得以饱足； 你也必叫他们喝你乐河的[水]。
36.en: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.

36.zh: 因为，在你那里有生命的源头； 在你的光中，我们必得见光。
36.en: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.

36.zh: 愿你常施慈爱给认识你的人， 常以公义待心里正直的人。
36.en: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

36.zh: 不容骄傲人的脚践踏我； 不容凶恶人的手赶逐我。
36.en: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.

36.zh: 在那里，作孽的人已经仆倒； 他们被推倒，不能再起来。
36.en: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.

37.zh: 大卫的诗。 不要为作恶的心怀不平， 也不要向那行不义的生出嫉妒。
37.en: By David. Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.

37.zh: 因为他们如草快被割下， 又如青菜快要枯干。
37.en: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.

37.zh: 你当倚靠耶和华而行善， 住在地上，以他的信实为粮；
37.en: Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.

37.zh: 又要以耶和华为乐， 他就将你心里所求的赐给你。
37.en: Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

37.zh: 当将你的事交托耶和华， 并倚靠他，他就必成全。
37.en: Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

37.zh: 他要使你的公义如光发出， 使你的公平明如正午。
37.en: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.

37.zh: 你当默然倚靠耶和华，耐性等候他； 不要因那道路通达的和那恶谋成就的心怀不平。
37.en: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

37.zh: 当止住怒气，离弃忿怒； 不要心怀不平，以致作恶。
37.en: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.

37.zh: 因为作恶的必被剪除； 惟有等候耶和华的必承受地土。
37.en: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD shall inherit the land.

37.zh: 还有片时，恶人要归于无有； 你就是细察他的住处也要归于无有。
37.en: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.

37.zh: 但谦卑人必承受地土， 以丰盛的平安为乐。
37.en: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

37.zh: 恶人设谋害义人， 又向他咬牙。
37.en: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.

37.zh: 主要笑他， 因见他[受罚]的日子将要来到。
37.en: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.

37.zh: 恶人已经弓上弦，刀出鞘， 要打倒困苦穷乏的人， 要杀害行动正直的人。
37.en: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.

37.zh: 他们的刀必刺入自己的心； 他们的弓必被折断。
37.en: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.

37.zh: 一个义人所有的虽少， 强过许多恶人的富余。
37.en: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.

37.zh: 因为恶人的膀臂必被折断； 但耶和华是扶持义人。
37.en: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.

37.zh: 耶和华知道完全人的日子； 他们的产业要存到永远。
37.en: The LORD knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.

37.zh: 他们在急难的时候不致羞愧， 在饥荒的日子必得饱足。
37.en: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

37.zh: 恶人却要灭亡。 耶和华的仇敌要像羊羔的脂油； 他们要消灭，要如烟消灭。
37.en: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of the LORD shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.

37.zh: 恶人借贷而不偿还； 义人却恩待人，并且施舍。
37.en: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.

37.zh: 蒙耶和华赐福的必承受地土； 被他咒诅的必被剪除。
37.en: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.

37.zh: 义人的脚步被耶和华立定； 他的道路，耶和华也喜爱。
37.en: A man’s steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way.

37.zh: 他虽失脚也不至全身仆倒， 因为耶和华用手搀扶他。
37.en: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for the LORD holds him up with his hand.

37.zh: 我从前年幼，现在年老， 却未见过义人被弃， 也未见过他的后裔讨饭。
37.en: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.

37.zh: 他终日恩待人，借给人； 他的后裔也蒙福！
37.en: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.

37.zh: 你当离恶行善， 就可永远[安]居。
37.en: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.

37.zh: 因为，耶和华喜爱公平， 不撇弃他的圣民； 他们永蒙保佑， 但恶人的后裔必被剪除。
37.en: For the LORD loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.

37.zh: 义人必承受地土， 永居其上。
37.en: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.

37.zh: 义人的口谈论智慧； 他的舌头讲说公平。
37.en: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.

37.zh: 神的律法在他心里； 他的脚总不滑跌。
37.en: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.

37.zh: 恶人窥探义人， 想要杀他。
37.en: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.

37.zh: 耶和华必不撇他在恶人手中； 当审判的时候，也不定他的罪。
37.en: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

37.zh: 你当等候耶和华，遵守他的道， 他就抬举你，使你承受地土； 恶人被剪除的时候，你必看见。
37.en: Wait for the LORD, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.

37.zh: 我见过恶人大有势力， 好像一棵青翠树在本土生发。
37.en: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

37.zh: 有人从那里经过，不料，他没有了； 我也寻找他，却寻不着。
37.en: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.

37.zh: 你要细察那完全人，观看那正直人， 因为和平人有[好]结局。
37.en: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.

37.zh: 至于犯法的人，必一同灭绝； 恶人终必剪除。
37.en: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.

37.zh: 但义人得救是由于耶和华； 他在患难时作他们的营寨。
37.en: But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

37.zh: 耶和华帮助他们，解救他们； 他解救他们脱离恶人，把他们救出来， 因为他们投靠他。
37.en: The LORD helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.

38.zh: 大卫的纪念诗。 耶和华啊，求你不要在怒中责备我， 不要在烈怒中惩罚我！
38.en: A Psalm by David, for a memorial. LORD, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.

38.zh: 因为，你的箭射入我身； 你的手压住我。
38.en: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.

38.zh: 因你的恼怒，我的肉无一完全； 因我的罪过，我的骨头也不安宁。
38.en: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

38.zh: 我的罪孽高过我的头， 如同重担叫我担当不起。
38.en: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.

38.zh: 因我的愚昧， 我的伤发臭流脓。
38.en: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.

38.zh: 我疼痛，大大拳曲， 终日哀痛。
38.en: I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.

38.zh: 我满腰是火； 我的肉无一完全。
38.en: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.

38.zh: 我被压伤，身体疲倦； 因心里不安，我就唉哼。
38.en: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.

38.zh: 主啊，我的心愿都在你面前； 我的叹息不向你隐瞒。
38.en: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.

38.zh: 我心跳动，我力衰微， 连我眼中的光也没有了。
38.en: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.

38.zh: 我的良朋密友因我的灾病都躲在旁边站着； 我的亲戚本家也远远地站立。
38.en: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.

38.zh: 那寻索我命的设下网罗； 那想要害我的口出恶言， 终日思想诡计。
38.en: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.

38.zh: 但我如聋子不听， 像哑巴不开口。
38.en: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.

38.zh: 我如不听见的人， 口中没有回话。
38.en: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.

38.zh: 耶和华啊，我仰望你！ 主—我的　神啊，你必应允我！
38.en: For I hope in you, LORD. You will answer, Lord my God.

38.zh: 我曾说：恐怕他们向我夸耀； 我失脚的时候，他们向我夸大。
38.en: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”

38.zh: 我几乎跌倒； 我的痛苦常在我面前。
38.en: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.

38.zh: 我要承认我的罪孽； 我要因我的罪忧愁。
38.en: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.

38.zh: 但我的仇敌又活泼又强壮， 无理恨我的增多了。
38.en: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.

38.zh: 以恶报善的与我作对， 因我是追求良善。
38.en: They who give evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.

38.zh: 耶和华啊，求你不要撇弃我！ 我的　神啊，求你不要远离我！
38.en: Don’t forsake me, LORD. My God, don’t be far from me.
