38.zh: 拯救我的主啊，求你快快帮助我！
38.en: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.

39.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长耶杜顿。 我曾说：我要谨慎我的言行， 免得我舌头犯罪； 恶人在我面前的时候， 我要用嚼环勒住我的口。
39.en: For the Chief Musician. For Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”

39.zh: 我默然无声，连好话也不出口； 我的愁苦就发动了，
39.en: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.

39.zh: 我的心在我里面发热。 我默想的时候，火就烧起， 我便用舌头说话。
39.en: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:

39.zh: 耶和华啊，求你叫我晓得我身之终！ 我的寿数几何？ 叫我知道我的生命不长！
39.en: “LORD, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.

39.zh: 你使我的年日窄如手掌； 我一生的年数，在你面前如同无有。 各人最稳妥的时候，真是全然虚幻。 （细拉）
39.en: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.

39.zh: 世人行动实系幻影。 他们忙乱，真是枉然； 积蓄[财宝]，不知将来有谁收取。
39.en: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.

39.zh: 主啊，如今我等什么呢？ 我的指望在乎你！
39.en: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.

39.zh: 求你救我脱离一切的过犯， 不要使我受愚顽人的羞辱。
39.en: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.

39.zh: 因我所遭遇的是出于你， 我就默然不语。
39.en: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.

39.zh: 求你把你的责罚从我身上免去； 因你手的责打，我便消灭。
39.en: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

39.zh: 你因人的罪恶惩罚他的时候， 叫他的笑容消灭，如[衣]被虫所咬。 世人真是虚幻！ （细拉）
39.en: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.

39.zh: 耶和华啊，求你听我的祷告， 留心听我的呼求！ 我流泪，求你不要静默无声！ 因为我在你面前是客旅， 是寄居的，像我列祖一般。
39.en: “Hear my prayer, LORD, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.

39.zh: 求你宽容我， 使我在去而不返之先可以力量复原。
39.en: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”

40.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。 我曾耐性等候耶和华； 他垂听我的呼求。
40.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry.

40.zh: 他从祸坑里， 从淤泥中，把我拉上来， 使我的脚立在磐石上， 使我脚步稳当。
40.en: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.

40.zh: 他使我口唱新歌， 就是赞美我们　神的话。 许多人必看见而惧怕， 并要倚靠耶和华。
40.en: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.

40.zh: 那倚靠耶和华、 不理会狂傲和偏向虚假之辈的， 这人便为有福！
40.en: Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.

40.zh: 耶和华—我的　神啊，你所行的奇事， 并你向我们所怀的意念甚多，不能向你陈明； 若要陈明，其事不可胜数。
40.en: Many, LORD, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.

40.zh: 祭物和礼物，你不喜悦； 你已经开通我的耳朵。 燔祭和赎罪祭非你所要。
40.en: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.

40.zh: 那时我说：看哪，我来了！ 我的事在经卷上已经记载了。
40.en: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.

40.zh: 我的　神啊，我乐意照你的旨意行； 你的律法在我心里。
40.en: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”

40.zh: 我在大会中宣传公义的佳音； 我必不止住我的嘴唇。 耶和华啊，这是你所知道的。
40.en: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, LORD, you know.

40.zh: 我未曾把你的公义藏在心里； 我已陈明你的信实和你的救恩； 我在大会中未曾隐瞒你的慈爱和诚实。
40.en: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.

40.zh: 耶和华啊，求你不要向我止住你的慈悲！ 愿你的慈爱和诚实常常保佑我！
40.en: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, LORD. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.

40.zh: 因有无数的祸患围困我， 我的罪孽追上了我，使我不能昂首； 这罪孽比我的头发还多， 我就心寒胆战。
40.en: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.

40.zh: 耶和华啊，求你开恩搭救我！ 耶和华啊，求你速速帮助我！
40.en: Be pleased, LORD, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, LORD.

40.zh: 愿那些寻找我、要灭我命的，一同抱愧蒙羞！ 愿那些喜悦我受害的，退后受辱！
40.en: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.

40.zh: 愿那些对我说阿哈、阿哈的， 因羞愧而败亡！
40.en: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”

40.zh: 愿一切寻求你的，因你高兴欢喜！ 愿那些喜爱你救恩的，常说：当尊耶和华为大！
40.en: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let the LORD be exalted!”

40.zh: 但我是困苦穷乏的，主仍顾念我； 你是帮助我的，搭救我的。 　神啊，求你不要耽延！
40.en: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.

41.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。 眷顾贫穷的有福了！ 他遭难的日子，耶和华必搭救他。
41.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Blessed is he who considers the poor. The LORD will deliver him in the day of evil.

41.zh: 耶和华必保全他，使他存活； 他必在地上享福。 求你不要把他交给仇敌，遂其所愿。
41.en: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.

41.zh: 他病重在榻，耶和华必扶持他； 他在病中，你必给他铺床。
41.en: The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.

41.zh: 我曾说：耶和华啊，求你怜恤我，医治我！ 因为我得罪了你。
41.en: I said, “LORD, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”

41.zh: 我的仇敌用恶言议论我[说]： 他几时死，他的名才灭亡呢？
41.en: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”

41.zh: 他来看[我]就说假话； 他心存奸恶，走到外边才说出来。
41.en: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.

41.zh: 一切恨我的，都交头接耳地议论我； 他们设计要害我。
41.en: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.

41.zh: [他们说]：有怪病贴在他身上； 他已躺卧，必不能再起来。
41.en: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”

41.zh: 连我知己的朋友， 我所倚靠、吃过我饭的也用脚踢我。
41.en: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.

41.zh: 耶和华啊，求你怜恤我， 使我起来，好报复他们！
41.en: But you, LORD, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.

41.zh: 因我的仇敌不得向我夸胜， 我从此便知道你喜爱我。
41.en: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.

41.zh: 你因我纯正就扶持我， 使我永远站在你的面前。
41.en: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.

41.zh: 耶和华—以色列的　神是应当称颂的， 从亘古直到永远。阿们！阿们！
41.en: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.

42.zh: 可拉后裔的训诲诗，交与伶长。 　神啊，我的心切慕你， 如鹿切慕溪水。
42.en: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.

42.zh: 我的心渴想　神，就是永生　神； 我几时得朝见　神呢？
42.en: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?

42.zh: 我昼夜以眼泪当饮食； 人不住地对我说：你的　神在哪里呢？
42.en: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

42.zh: 我从前与众人同往， 用欢呼称赞的声音 领他们到　神的殿里，大家守节。 我追想这些事， 我的心极其悲伤。
42.en: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.

42.zh: 我的心哪，你为何忧闷？ 为何在我里面烦躁？ 应当仰望　神，因他笑脸帮助我； 我还要称赞他。
42.en: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.

42.zh: 我的　神啊，我的心在我里面忧闷， 所以我从约旦地， 从黑门岭，从米萨山记念你。
42.en: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.

42.zh: 你的瀑布发声，深渊就与深渊响应； 你的波浪洪涛漫过我身。
42.en: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.

42.zh: 白昼，耶和华必向我施慈爱； 黑夜，我要歌颂祷告赐我生命的　神。
42.en: The LORD will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.

42.zh: 我要对　神—我的磐石说： 你为何忘记我呢？ 我为何因仇敌的欺压时常哀痛呢？
42.en: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”

42.zh: 我的敌人辱骂我， 好像打碎我的骨头， 不住地对我说： 你的　神在哪里呢？
42.en: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

42.zh: 我的心哪，你为何忧闷？ 为何在我里面烦躁？ 应当仰望　神，因我还要称赞他。 他是我脸上的光荣，是我的　神。
42.en: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

43.zh: 神啊，求你伸我的冤， 向不虔诚的国为我辨屈； 求你救我脱离诡诈不义的人。
43.en: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.

43.zh: 因为你是赐我力量的　神，为何丢弃我呢？ 我为何因仇敌的欺压时常哀痛呢？
43.en: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

43.zh: 求你发出你的亮光和真实，好引导我， 带我到你的圣山，到你的居所！
43.en: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.

43.zh: 我就走到　神的祭坛， 到我最喜乐的　神那里。 　神啊，我的　神， 我要弹琴称赞你！
43.en: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.

43.zh: 我的心哪，你为何忧闷？ 为何在我里面烦躁？ 应当仰望　神，因我还要称赞他。 他是我脸上的光荣，是我的　神。
43.en: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.

44.zh: 可拉后裔的训诲诗，交与伶长。 　神啊，你在古时， 我们列祖的日子所行的事， 我们亲耳听见了； 我们的列祖也给我们述说过。
44.en: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. A contemplative psalm. We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.

44.zh: 你曾用手赶出外邦人， 却栽培了我们列祖； 你苦待列邦， 却叫我们列祖发达。
44.en: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.

44.zh: 因为他们不是靠自己的刀剑得地土， 也不是靠自己的膀臂得胜， 乃是靠你的右手、你的膀臂， 和你脸上的亮光， 因为你喜悦他们。
44.en: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.

44.zh: 神啊，你是我的王； 求你出令使雅各得胜。
44.en: God, you are my King. Command victories for Jacob!

44.zh: 我们靠你要推倒我们的敌人， 靠你的名要践踏那起来攻击我们的人。
44.en: Through you, we will push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.

44.zh: 因为，我必不靠我的弓； 我的刀也不能使我得胜。
44.en: For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me.

44.zh: 惟你救了我们脱离敌人， 使恨我们的人羞愧。
44.en: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.

44.zh: 我们终日因　神夸耀， 还要永远称谢你的名。 （细拉）
44.en: In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.

44.zh: 但如今你丢弃了我们，使我们受辱， 不和我们的军兵同去。
44.en: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.

44.zh: 你使我们向敌人转身退后； 那恨我们的人任意抢夺。
44.en: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.

44.zh: 你使我们当作快要被吃的羊， 把我们分散在列邦中。
44.en: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.

44.zh: 你卖了你的子民也不赚利， 所得的价值并不加添你的[资财]。
44.en: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.

44.zh: 你使我们受邻国的羞辱， 被四围的人嗤笑讥刺。
44.en: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.

44.zh: 你使我们在列邦中作了笑谈， 使众民向我们摇头。
44.en: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

44.zh: 我的凌辱终日在我面前， 我脸上的羞愧将我遮蔽，
44.en: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,

44.zh: 都因那辱骂毁谤人的声音， 又因仇敌和报仇人的缘故。
44.en: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.

44.zh: 这都临到我们身上， 我们却没有忘记你， 也没有违背你的约。
44.en: All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.

44.zh: 我们的心没有退后； 我们的脚也没有偏离你的路。
44.en: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,

44.zh: 你在野狗之处压伤我们， 用死荫遮蔽我们。
44.en: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

44.zh: 倘若我们忘了　神的名， 或向别神举手，
44.en: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,

44.zh: 神岂不鉴察这事吗？ 因为他晓得人心里的隐秘。
44.en: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.

44.zh: 我们为你的缘故终日被杀； 人看我们如将宰的羊。
44.en: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.

44.zh: 主啊，求你睡醒，为何尽睡呢？ 求你兴起，不要永远丢弃[我们]！
44.en: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.

44.zh: 你为何掩面， 不顾我们所遭的苦难和所受的欺压？
44.en: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?

44.zh: 我们的性命伏于尘土； 我们的肚腹紧贴地面。
44.en: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.

44.zh: 求你起来帮助我们！ 凭你的慈爱救赎我们！
44.en: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.

45.zh: 可拉后裔的训诲诗，又是爱慕歌，交与伶长。调用百合花。 我心里涌出美辞； 我论到我为王做的事， 我的舌头是快手笔。
45.en: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Lilies.” A contemplation by the sons of Korah. A wedding song. My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.

45.zh: 你比世人更美； 在你嘴里满有恩惠； 所以　神赐福给你，直到永远。
45.en: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.

45.zh: 大能者啊，愿你腰间佩刀， 大有荣耀和威严！
45.en: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.

45.zh: 为真理、谦卑、公义赫然坐车前往，无不得胜； 你的右手必显明可畏的事。
45.en: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.

45.zh: 你的箭锋快，射中王敌之心； 万民仆倒在你以下。
45.en: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.

45.zh: 神啊，你的宝座是永永远远的； 你的国权是正直的。
45.en: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.

45.zh: 你喜爱公义，恨恶罪恶； 所以　神—就是你的　神—用喜乐油膏你， 胜过膏你的同伴。
45.en: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

45.zh: 你的衣服都有没药、沉香、肉桂[的香气]； 象牙宫中有丝弦乐器的声音使你欢喜。
45.en: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.

45.zh: 有君王的女儿在你尊贵妇女之中； 王后佩戴俄斐金饰站在你右边。
45.en: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.

45.zh: 女子啊，你要听，要想，要侧耳而听！ 不要记念你的民和你的父家，
45.en: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.

45.zh: 王就羡慕你的美貌； 因为他是你的主，你当敬拜他。
45.en: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.

45.zh: 泰尔的民[必来]送礼； 民中的富足人也必向你求恩。
45.en: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.

45.zh: 王女在[宫]里极其荣华； 她的衣服是用金[线]绣的。
45.en: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.

45.zh: 她要穿锦绣的衣服，被引到王前； 随从她的陪伴童女也要被带到你面前。
45.en: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.

45.zh: 她们要欢喜快乐被引导； 她们要进入王宫。
45.en: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.

45.zh: 你的子孙要接续你的列祖； 你要立他们在全地作王。
45.en: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.

45.zh: 我必叫你的名被万代记念， 所以万民要永永远远称谢你。
45.en: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.

46.zh: 可拉后裔的诗歌，交与伶长。调用女音。 　神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量， 是[我们]在患难中随时的帮助。
46.en: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

46.zh: 所以，地虽改变， 山虽摇动到海心，
46.en: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;

46.zh: 其中的水虽匉訇翻腾， 山虽因海涨而战抖， 我们也不害怕。 （细拉）
46.en: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.

46.zh: 有一道河，这河的分汊使　神的城欢喜； 这城就是至高者居住的圣所。
46.en: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.

46.zh: 神在其中，城必不动摇； 到天一亮，　神必帮助这城。
46.en: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.

46.zh: 外邦喧嚷，列国动摇； 　神发声，地便熔化。
46.en: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.

46.zh: 万军之耶和华与我们同在； 雅各的　神是我们的避难所！ （细拉）
46.en: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

46.zh: 你们来看耶和华的作为， 看他使地怎样荒凉。
46.en: Come, see the LORD’s works, what desolations he has made on the earth.

46.zh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极； 他折弓、断枪，把战车焚烧在火中。
46.en: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.

46.zh: 你们要休息，要知道我是　神！ 我必在外邦中被尊崇，在遍地上也被尊崇。
46.en: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”

46.zh: 万军之耶和华与我们同在； 雅各的　神是我们的避难所！
46.en: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

47.zh: 可拉后裔的诗，交与伶长。 万民哪，你们都要拍掌！ 要用夸胜的声音向　神呼喊！
47.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!

47.zh: 因为耶和华至高者是可畏的； 他是治理全地的大君王。
47.en: For the LORD Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.

47.zh: 他叫万民服在我们以下， 又叫列邦服在我们脚下。
47.en: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.

47.zh: 他为我们选择产业， 就是他所爱之雅各的荣耀。 （细拉）
47.en: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

47.zh: 神上升，有喊声相送； 耶和华上升，有角声相送。
47.en: God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.

47.zh: 你们要向　神歌颂，歌颂！ 向我们王歌颂，歌颂！
47.en: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!

47.zh: 因为　神是全地的王； 你们要用悟性歌颂。
47.en: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.

47.zh: 神作王治理万国； 　神坐在他的圣宝座上。
47.en: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.

47.zh: 列邦的君王聚集要作亚伯拉罕之　神的民。 因为世界的盾牌是属　神的； 他为至高！
47.en: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!

48.zh: 可拉后裔的诗歌。 耶和华本为大！ 在我们　神的城中， 在他的圣山上，该受大赞美。
48.en: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

48.zh: 锡安山—大君王的城， 在北面居高华美， 为全地所喜悦。
48.en: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.

48.zh: 神在其宫中， 自显为避难所。
48.en: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.

48.zh: 看哪，众王会合， 一同经过。
48.en: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.

48.zh: 他们见了这城就惊奇丧胆， 急忙逃跑。
48.en: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.

48.zh: 他们在那里被战兢疼痛抓住， 好像产难的妇人一样。
48.en: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.

48.zh: [神啊]，你用东风打破他施的船只。
48.en: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.

48.zh: 我们在万军之耶和华的城中 —就是我们　神的城中—所看见的， 正如我们所听见的。 　神必坚立这城，直到永远。 （细拉）
48.en: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of the LORD of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.

48.zh: 神啊，我们在你的殿中想念你的慈爱。
48.en: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.

48.zh: 神啊，你受的赞美正与你的名相称，直到地极！ 你的右手满了公义。
48.en: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.

48.zh: 因你的判断，锡安山应当欢喜， 犹大的城邑应当快乐。
48.en: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.

48.zh: 你们当周游锡安， 四围旋绕，数点城楼，
48.en: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.

48.zh: 细看她的外郭， 察看她的宫殿， 为要传说到后代。
48.en: Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.

48.zh: 因为这　神永永远远为我们的　神； 他必作我们引路的，直到死时。
48.en: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.

49.zh: 可拉后裔的诗，交与伶长。 万民哪，你们都当听这话！ 世上一切的居民，
49.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,

49.zh: 无论上流下流，富足贫穷， 都当留心听！
49.en: both low and high, rich and poor together.

49.zh: 我口要说智慧的言语； 我心要想通达的道理。
49.en: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.

49.zh: 我要侧耳听比喻， 用琴解谜语。
49.en: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.

49.zh: 在患难的日子，奸恶随我脚跟，四面环绕我， 我何必惧怕？
49.en: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?

49.zh: 那些倚仗财货自夸钱财多的人，
49.en: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—

49.zh: 一个也无法赎自己的弟兄， 也不能替他将赎价给　神，
49.en: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.

49.zh: 叫他长远活着，不见朽坏； 因为赎他生命的价值极贵， 只可永远罢休。
49.en: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,
that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.

49.zh: 他必见智慧人死， 又见愚顽人和畜类人一同灭亡， 将他们的财货留给别人。
49.en: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.

49.zh: 他们心里思想： 他们的家室必永存， 住宅必留到万代； 他们以自己的名称自己的地。
49.en: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.

49.zh: 但人居尊贵中不能长久， 如同死亡的畜类一样。
49.en: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.

49.zh: 他们行的这道本为自己的愚昧； 但他们以后的人还佩服他们的话语。 （细拉）
49.en: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.

49.zh: 他们如同羊群派定下阴间； 死亡必作他们的牧者。 到了早晨，正直人必管辖他们； 他们的美容必被阴间所灭，以致无处可存。
49.en: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.

49.zh: 只是　神必救赎我的灵魂脱离阴间的权柄， 因他必收纳我。 （细拉）
49.en: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.

49.zh: 见人发财、家室增荣的时候， 你不要惧怕；
49.en: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

49.zh: 因为，他死的时候什么也不能带去； 他的荣耀不能随他下去。
49.en: for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.

49.zh: 他活着的时候，虽然自夸为有福 （你若利己，人必夸奖你）；
49.en: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—

49.zh: 他仍必归到他历代的祖宗那里， 永不见光。
49.en: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.

49.zh: 人在尊贵中而不醒悟， 就如死亡的畜类一样。
49.en: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.

50.zh: 亚萨的诗。 大能者　神—耶和华已经发言招呼天下， 从日出之地到日落之处。
50.en: A Psalm by Asaph. The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.

50.zh: 从全美的锡安中， 　神已经发光了。
50.en: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.

50.zh: 我们的　神要来，决不闭口。 有烈火在他面前吞灭； 有暴风在他四围大刮。
50.en: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.

50.zh: 他招呼上天下地， 为要审判他的民，
50.en: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:

50.zh: 说：招聚我的圣民到我这里来， 就是那些用祭物与我立约的人。
50.en: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”

50.zh: 诸天必表明他的公义， 因为　神是施行审判的。 （细拉）
50.en: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.

50.zh: 我的民哪，你们当听我的话！ 以色列啊，我要劝戒你； 我是　神，是你的　神！
50.en: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.

50.zh: 我并不因你的祭物责备你； 你的燔祭常在我面前。
50.en: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.

50.zh: 我不从你家中取公牛， 也不从你圈内取山羊；
50.en: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.

50.zh: 因为，树林中的百兽是我的， 千山上的牲畜也是我的。
50.en: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.

50.zh: 山中的飞鸟，我都知道； 野地的走兽也都属我。
50.en: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.

50.zh: 我若是饥饿，我不用告诉你， 因为世界和其中所充满的都是我的。
50.en: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

50.zh: 我岂吃公牛的肉呢？ 我岂喝山羊的血呢？
50.en: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

50.zh: 你们要以感谢为祭献与　神， 又要向至高者还你的愿，
50.en: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.

50.zh: 并要在患难之日求告我； 我必搭救你，你也要荣耀我。
50.en: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

50.zh: 但　神对恶人说：你怎敢传说我的律例， 口中提到我的约呢？
50.en: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,

50.zh: 其实你恨恶管教， 将我的言语丢在背后。
50.en: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?

50.zh: 你见了盗贼就乐意与他同伙， 又与行奸淫的人一同有分。
50.en: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.

50.zh: 你口任说恶言； 你舌编造诡诈。
50.en: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.

50.zh: 你坐着毁谤你的兄弟， 谗毁你亲母的儿子。
50.en: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.

50.zh: 你行了这些事，我还闭口不言， 你想我恰和你一样； 其实我要责备你，将这些事摆在你眼前。
50.en: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.

50.zh: 你们忘记　神的，要思想这事， 免得我把你们撕碎，无人搭救。
50.en: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.

50.zh: 凡以感谢献上为祭的便是荣耀我； 那按正路而行的，我必使他得着我的救恩。
50.en: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”

51.zh: 大卫与拔示巴同室以后，先知拿单来见他；他作这诗，交与伶长。 　神啊，求你按你的慈爱怜恤我！ 按你丰盛的慈悲涂抹我的过犯！
51.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David, when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

51.zh: 求你将我的罪孽洗除净尽， 并洁除我的罪！
51.en: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.

51.zh: 因为，我知道我的过犯； 我的罪常在我面前。
51.en: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.

51.zh: 我向你犯罪，惟独得罪了你； 在你眼前行了这恶， 以致你责备我的时候显为公义， 判断我的时候显为清正。
51.en: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.

51.zh: 我是在罪孽里生的， 在我母亲怀胎的时候就有了罪。
51.en: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.

51.zh: 你所喜爱的是内里诚实； 你在我隐密处，必使我得智慧。
51.en: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

51.zh: 求你用牛膝草洁净我，我就干净； 求你洗涤我，我就比雪更白。
51.en: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

51.zh: 求你使我得听欢喜快乐[的声音]， 使你所压伤的骨头可以踊跃。
51.en: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.

51.zh: 求你掩面不看我的罪， 涂抹我一切的罪孽。
51.en: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.

51.zh: 神啊，求你为我造清洁的心， 使我里面重新有正直的灵。
51.en: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

51.zh: 不要丢弃我，使我离开你的面； 不要从我收回你的圣灵。
51.en: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.

51.zh: 求你使我仍得救恩之乐， 赐我乐意的灵扶持我，
51.en: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.

51.zh: 我就把你的道指教有过犯的人， 罪人必归顺你。
51.en: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.

51.zh: 神啊，你是拯救我的　神； 求你救我脱离流人血的罪！ 我的舌头就高声歌唱你的公义。
51.en: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.

51.zh: 主啊，求你使我嘴唇张开， 我的口便传扬赞美你的话！
51.en: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.

51.zh: 你本不喜爱祭物，若喜爱，我就献上； 燔祭，你也不喜悦。
51.en: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.

51.zh: [神所要]的祭就是忧伤的灵； 　神啊，忧伤痛悔的心，你必不轻看。
51.en: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.

51.zh: 求你随你的美意善待锡安， 建造耶路撒冷的城墙。
51.en: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.

51.zh: 那时，你必喜爱公义的祭 和燔祭并全牲的燔祭； 那时，人必将公牛献在你坛上。
51.en: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.

52.zh: 以东人多益来告诉扫罗说：「大卫到了亚希米勒家。」那时，大卫作这训诲诗，交与伶长。 勇士啊，你为何以作恶自夸？ 神的慈爱是常存的。
52.en: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by David, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, “David has come to Ahimelech’s house.” Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.

52.zh: 你的舌头邪恶诡诈， 好像剃头刀，快利伤人。
52.en: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

52.zh: 你爱恶胜似爱善， 又爱说谎，不爱说公义。 （细拉）
52.en: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.

52.zh: 诡诈的舌头啊， 你爱说一切毁灭的话！
52.en: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.

52.zh: 神也要毁灭你，直到永远； 他要把你拿去，从你的帐棚中抽出， 从活人之地将你拔出。 （细拉）
52.en: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.

52.zh: 义人要看见而惧怕， 并要笑他，
52.en: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,

52.zh: 说：看哪，这就是那不以　神为他力量的人， 只倚仗他丰富的财物，在邪恶上坚立自己。
52.en: “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”

52.zh: 至于我，就像　神殿中的青橄榄树； 我永永远远倚靠　神的慈爱。
52.en: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.

52.zh: 我要称谢你，直到永远， 因为你行了这事。 我也要在你圣民面前仰望你的名； 这名本为美好。
52.en: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.

53.zh: 大卫的训诲诗，交与伶长。调用麻哈拉。 愚顽人心里说：没有　神。 他们都是邪恶，行了可憎恶的罪孽； 没有一个人行善。
53.en: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Mahalath.” A contemplation by David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.

53.zh: 神从天上垂看世人，要看有明白的没有？ 有寻求他的没有？
53.en: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.

53.zh: 他们各人都退后，一同变为污秽； 并没有行善的，连一个也没有。
53.en: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

53.zh: 作孽的没有知识吗？ 他们吞吃我的百姓如同吃饭一样，并不求告　神。
53.en: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?

53.zh: 他们在无可惧怕之处就大大害怕， 因为　神把那安营攻击你之人的骨头散开了。 你使他们蒙羞，因为　神弃绝了他们。
53.en: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.

53.zh: 但愿以色列的救恩从锡安而出。 　神救回他被掳的子民那时， 雅各要快乐，以色列要欢喜。
53.en: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

54.zh: 西弗人来对扫罗说：「大卫岂不是在我们那里藏身吗？」那时，大卫作这训诲诗，交与伶长。用丝弦的乐器。 　神啊，求你以你的名救我， 凭你的大能为我伸冤。
54.en: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David, when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, “Isn’t David hiding himself among us?” Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.

54.zh: 神啊，求你听我的祷告， 留心听我口中的言语。
54.en: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.

54.zh: 因为，外人起来攻击我， 强暴人寻索我的命； 他们眼中没有　神。 （细拉）
54.en: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.

54.zh: 神是帮助我的，是扶持我命的。
54.en: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.

54.zh: 他要报应我仇敌所行的恶； 求你凭你的诚实灭绝他们。
54.en: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.

54.zh: 我要把甘心祭献给你。 耶和华啊，我要称赞你的名；这名本为美好。
54.en: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, LORD, for it is good.

54.zh: 他从一切的急难中把我救出来； 我的眼睛也看见了我仇敌[遭报]。
54.en: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.

55.zh: 大卫的训诲诗，交与伶长。用丝弦的乐器。 　神啊，求你留心听我的祷告， 不要隐藏不听我的恳求！
55.en: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David. Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.

55.zh: 求你侧耳听我，应允我。 我哀叹不安，发声唉哼，
55.en: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan

55.zh: 都因仇敌的声音，恶人的欺压； 因为他们将罪孽加在我身上，发怒气逼迫我。
55.en: because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.

55.zh: 我心在我里面甚是疼痛； 死的惊惶临到我身。
55.en: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.

55.zh: 恐惧战兢归到我身； 惊恐漫过了我。
55.en: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.

55.zh: 我说：但愿我有翅膀像鸽子， 我就飞去，得享安息。
55.en: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.

55.zh: 我必远游， 宿在旷野。 （细拉）
55.en: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.

55.zh: 我必速速逃到避所， 脱离狂风暴雨。
55.en: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”

55.zh: 主啊，求你吞灭他们，变乱他们的舌头！ 因为我在城中见了强暴争竞的事。
55.en: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

55.zh: 他们在城墙上昼夜绕行； 在城内也有罪孽和奸恶。
55.en: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.

55.zh: 邪恶在其中； 欺压和诡诈不离街市。
55.en: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.

55.zh: 原来不是仇敌辱骂我， 若是仇敌，还可忍耐； 也不是恨我的人向我狂大， 若是恨我的人就必躲避他。
55.en: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.

55.zh: 不料是你；你原与我平等， 是我的同伴，是我知己的朋友！
55.en: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.

55.zh: 我们素常彼此谈论，以为甘甜； 我们与群众在　神的殿中同行。
55.en: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.

55.zh: 愿死亡忽然临到他们！ 愿他们活活地下入阴间！ 因为他们的住处，他们的心中，都是邪恶。
55.en: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.

55.zh: 至于我，我要求告　神； 耶和华必拯救我。
55.en: As for me, I will call on God. The LORD will save me.

55.zh: 我要晚上、早晨、晌午哀声悲叹； 他也必听我的声音。
55.en: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.

55.zh: 他救赎我命脱离攻击我的人， 使我得享平安， 因为与我[相争的]人甚多。
55.en: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.

55.zh: 那没有更变、不敬畏　神的人， 从太古常存的　神必听见而苦待他。
55.en: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They never change and don’t fear God.

55.zh: 他背了约， 伸手攻击与他和好的人。
55.en: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.

55.zh: 他的口如奶油光滑， 他的心却怀着争战； 他的话比油柔和， 其实是拔出来的刀。
55.en: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.

55.zh: 你要把你的重担卸给耶和华， 他必抚养你； 他永不叫义人动摇。
55.en: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

55.zh: 神啊，你必使恶人下入灭亡的坑； 流人血、行诡诈的人必活不到半世， 但我要倚靠你。
55.en: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.

56.zh: 非利士人在迦特拿住大卫。那时，他作这金诗，交与伶长。调用远方无声鸽。 　神啊，求你怜悯我，因为人要把我吞了， 终日攻击欺压我。
56.en: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Silent Dove in Distant Lands.” A poem by David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.

56.zh: 我的仇敌终日要把我吞了， 因逞骄傲攻击我的人甚多。
56.en: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.

56.zh: 我惧怕的时候要倚靠你。
56.en: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

56.zh: 我倚靠　神，我要赞美他的话； 我倚靠　神，必不惧怕。 血气之辈能把我怎么样呢？
56.en: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?

56.zh: 他们终日颠倒我的话； 他们一切的心思都是要害我。
56.en: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.

56.zh: 他们聚集，埋伏窥探我的脚踪， 等候要害我的命。
56.en: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.

56.zh: 他们岂能因罪孽逃脱吗？ 　神啊，求你在怒中使众民堕落！
56.en: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.

56.zh: 我几次流离，你都记数； 求你把我眼泪装在你的皮袋里。 这不都记在你册子上吗？
56.en: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?

56.zh: 我呼求的日子，我的仇敌都要转身退后。 　神帮助我，这是我所知道的。
56.en: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.

56.zh: 我倚靠　神，我要赞美他的话； 我倚靠耶和华，我要赞美他的话。
56.en: In God, I will praise his word. In the LORD, I will praise his word.

56.zh: 我倚靠　神，必不惧怕。 人能把我怎么样呢？
56.en: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

56.zh: 神啊，我向你所许的愿在我身上； 我要将感谢祭献给你。
56.en: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.

56.zh: 因为你救我的命脱离死亡。 你岂不是[救护]我的脚不跌倒、 使我在生命光中行在　神面前吗？
56.en: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.

57.zh: 大卫逃避扫罗，藏在洞里。那时，他作这金诗，交与伶长。调用休要毁坏。 　神啊，求你怜悯我，怜悯我！ 因为我的心投靠你。 我要投靠在你翅膀的荫下， 等到灾害过去。
57.en: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when he fled from Saul, in the cave. Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.

57.zh: 我要求告至高的　神， 就是为我成全[诸事]的　神。
57.en: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.

57.zh: 那要吞我的人辱骂我的时候， 　神从天上必施恩救我， 也必向我发出慈爱和诚实。
57.en: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.

57.zh: 我的性命在狮子中间； 我躺卧在性如烈火的世人当中。 他们的牙齿是枪、箭； 他们的舌头是快刀。
57.en: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

57.zh: 神啊，愿你崇高过于诸天！ 愿你的荣耀高过全地！
57.en: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!

57.zh: 他们为我的脚设下网罗，压制我的心； 他们在我面前挖了坑，自己反掉在其中。 （细拉）
57.en: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves. Selah.

57.zh: 神啊，我心坚定，我心坚定； 我要唱诗，我要歌颂！
57.en: My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.

57.zh: 我的灵啊，你当醒起！ 琴瑟啊，你们当醒起！ 我自己要极早醒起！
57.en: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.

57.zh: 主啊，我要在万民中称谢你， 在列邦中歌颂你！
57.en: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.

57.zh: 因为，你的慈爱高及诸天； 你的诚实达到穹苍。
57.en: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.

57.zh: 神啊，愿你崇高过于诸天！ 愿你的荣耀高过全地！
57.en: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.

58.zh: 大卫的金诗，交与伶长。调用休要毁坏。 世人哪，你们默然不语，真合公义吗？ 施行审判，岂按正直吗？
58.en: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David. Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?

58.zh: 不然！你们是心中作恶； 你们在地上秤出你们手所行的强暴。
58.en: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands on the earth.

58.zh: 恶人一出母胎就[与]　神疏远， 一离母腹便走错路，说谎话。
58.en: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

58.zh: 他们的毒气好像蛇的毒气； 他们好像塞耳的聋虺，
58.en: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,

58.zh: 不听行法术的声音， 虽用极灵的咒语也是不听。
58.en: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.

58.zh: 神啊，求你敲碎他们口中的牙！ 耶和华啊，求你敲掉少壮狮子的大牙！
58.en: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, LORD.

58.zh: 愿他们消灭，如急流的水一般； 他们瞅准射箭的时候，愿箭头仿佛砍断。
58.en: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.

58.zh: 愿他们像蜗牛消化过去， 又像妇人坠落未见天日的胎。
58.en: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.

58.zh: 你们用荆棘烧火，锅还未热， 他要用旋风把青的和烧着的一齐刮去。
58.en: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.

58.zh: 义人见[仇敌]遭报就欢喜， 要在恶人的血中洗脚。
58.en: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,

58.zh: 因此，人必说：义人诚然有善报； 在地上果有施行判断的　神！
58.en: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”

59.zh: 扫罗打发人窥探大卫的房屋，要杀他。那时，大卫作这金诗，交与伶长。调用休要毁坏。 我的　神啊，求你救我脱离仇敌， 把我安置在高处，得脱那些起来攻击我的人。
59.en: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.

59.zh: 求你救我脱离作孽的人 和喜爱流人血的人！
59.en: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.

59.zh: 因为，他们埋伏要害我的命； 有能力的人聚集来攻击我。 耶和华啊，这不是为我的过犯， 也不是为我的罪愆。
59.en: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, LORD.

59.zh: 我虽然无过，他们预备整齐，跑来攻击我。 求你兴起鉴察，帮助我！
59.en: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!

59.zh: 万军之　神—耶和华以色列的　神啊！ 求你兴起，惩治万邦！ 不要怜悯行诡诈的恶人！ （细拉）
59.en: You, LORD God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.

59.zh: 他们晚上转回， 叫号如狗，围城绕行。
59.en: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.

59.zh: 他们口中喷吐[恶言]，嘴里有刀； [他们说]：有谁听见？
59.en: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”

59.zh: 但你—耶和华必笑话他们； 你要嗤笑万邦。
59.en: But you, LORD, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.

59.zh: 我的力量啊，我必仰望你， 因为　神是我的高台。
59.en: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.

59.zh: 我的　神要以慈爱迎接我； 　神要叫我看见我仇敌[遭报]。
59.en: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.

59.zh: 不要杀他们，恐怕我的民忘记。 主啊，你是我们的盾牌； 求你用你的能力使他们四散， 且降为卑。
59.en: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.

59.zh: 因他们口中的罪和嘴里的言语， 并咒骂虚谎的话， 愿他们在骄傲之中被缠住了。
59.en: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.

59.zh: 求你发怒，使他们消灭， 以致归于无有， 叫他们知道　神在雅各中间掌权， 直到地极。 （细拉）
59.en: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.

59.zh: 到了晚上，任凭他们转回； 任凭他们叫号如狗，围城绕行。
59.en: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.

59.zh: 他们必走来走去，寻找食物， 若不得饱就终夜在外。
59.en: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.

59.zh: 但我要歌颂你的力量， 早晨要高唱你的慈爱； 因为你作过我的高台， 在我急难的日子作过我的避难所。
59.en: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.

59.zh: 我的力量啊，我要歌颂你； 因为　神是我的高台， 是赐恩与我的　神。
59.en: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.

60.zh: 大卫与两河间的亚兰并琐巴的亚兰争战的时候，约押转回，在盐谷攻击以东，杀了一万二千人。那时，大卫作这金诗叫人学习，交与伶长。调用为证的百合花。 　神啊，你丢弃了我们，使我们破败； 你向我们发怒，求你使我们复兴！
60.en: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lily of the Covenant.” A teaching poem by David, when he fought with Aram Naharaim and with Aram Zobah, and Joab returned, and killed twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt. God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.

60.zh: 你使地震动，而且崩裂； 求你将裂口医好，因为地摇动。
60.en: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.

60.zh: 你叫你的民遇见艰难； 你叫我们喝那使人东倒西歪的酒。
60.en: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.

60.zh: 你把旌旗赐给敬畏你的人， 可以为真理扬起来。 （细拉）
60.en: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

60.zh: 求你应允我们，用右手拯救我们， 好叫你所亲爱的人得救。
60.en: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

60.zh: 神已经指着他的圣洁说：我要欢乐； 我要分开示剑，丈量疏割谷。
60.en: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

60.zh: 基列是我的，玛拿西也是我的。 以法莲是护卫我头的； 犹大是我的杖。
60.en: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.

60.zh: 摩押是我的沐浴盆； 我要向以东抛鞋。 非利士啊，你还能因我欢呼吗？
60.en: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my sandal on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”

60.zh: 谁能领我进坚固城？ 谁能引我到以东地？
60.en: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?

60.zh: 神啊，你不是丢弃了我们吗？ 　神啊，你不和我们的军兵同去吗？
60.en: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.

60.zh: 求你帮助我们攻击敌人， 因为人的帮助是枉然的。
60.en: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.

60.zh: 我们倚靠　神才得施展大能， 因为践踏我们敌人的就是他。
60.en: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.

61.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。用丝弦的乐器。 　神啊，求你听我的呼求， 侧耳听我的祷告！
61.en: For the Chief Musician. For a stringed instrument. By David. Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.

61.zh: 我心里发昏的时候， 我要从地极求告你。 求你领我到那比我更高的磐石！
61.en: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

61.zh: 因为你作过我的避难所， 作过我的坚固台，脱离仇敌。
61.en: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.

61.zh: 我要永远住在你的帐幕里！ 我要投靠在你翅膀下的隐密处！ （细拉）
61.en: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.

61.zh: 神啊，你原是听了我所许的愿； 你将产业赐给敬畏你名的人。
61.en: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

61.zh: 你要加添王的寿数； 他的年岁必存到世世。
61.en: You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.

61.zh: 他必永远坐在　神面前； 愿你预备慈爱和诚实保佑他！
61.en: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

61.zh: 这样，我要歌颂你的名，直到永远， 好天天还我所许的愿。
61.en: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.

62.zh: 大卫的诗，照耶杜顿的作法，交与伶长。 我的心默默无声，专等候　神； 我的救恩是从他[而来]。
62.en: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.

62.zh: 惟独他是我的磐石，我的拯救； 他是我的高台，我必不很动摇。
62.en: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.

62.zh: 你们大家攻击一人，把他毁坏， 如同毁坏歪斜的墙、将倒的壁，要到几时呢？
62.en: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

62.zh: 他们彼此商议，专要从他的尊位上把他推下； 他们喜爱谎话，口虽祝福，心却咒诅。 （细拉）
62.en: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

62.zh: 我的心哪，你当默默无声，专等候　神， 因为我的盼望是从他[而来]。
62.en: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

62.zh: 惟独他是我的磐石，我的拯救； 他是我的高台，我必不动摇。
62.en: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.

62.zh: 我的拯救、我的荣耀都在乎　神； 我力量的磐石、我的避难所都在乎　神。
62.en: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

62.zh: 你们众民当时时倚靠他， 在他面前倾心吐意； 　神是我们的避难所。 （细拉）
62.en: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.

62.zh: 下流人真是虚空； 上流人也是虚假； 放在天平里就必浮起； 他们一共比空气还轻。
62.en: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.

62.zh: 不要仗势欺人， 也不要因抢夺而骄傲； 若财宝加增，不要放在心上。
62.en: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.

62.zh: 神说了一次、两次，我都听见： 就是能力都属乎　神。
62.en: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.

62.zh: 主啊，慈爱也是属乎你， 因为你照着各人所行的报应他。
62.en: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.

63.zh: 大卫在犹大旷野的时候，作了这诗。 　神啊，你是我的　神， 我要切切地寻求你， 在干旱疲乏无水之地，我渴想你； 我的心切慕你。
63.en: A Psalm by David, when he was in the desert of Judah. God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

63.zh: 我在圣所中曾如此瞻仰你， 为要见你的能力和你的荣耀。
63.en: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.

63.zh: 因你的慈爱比生命更好， 我的嘴唇要颂赞你。
63.en: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.

63.zh: 我还活的时候要这样称颂你； 我要奉你的名举手。
63.en: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.

63.zh: 我在床上记念你， 在夜更的时候思想你； 我的心就像饱足了骨髓肥油， 我也要以欢乐的嘴唇赞美你。
63.en: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.

63.zh: 因为你曾帮助我， 我就在你翅膀的荫下欢呼。
63.en: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.

63.zh: 我心紧紧地跟随你； 你的右手扶持我。
63.en: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.

63.zh: 但那些寻索要灭我命的人 必往地底下去；
63.en: But those who seek my soul to destroy it shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

63.zh: 他们必被刀剑所杀， 被野狗所吃。
63.en: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.

63.zh: 但是王必因　神欢喜。 凡指着他发誓的必要夸口， 因为说谎之人的口必被塞住。
63.en: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.

64.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。 　神啊，我哀叹的时候，求你听我的声音！ 求你保护我的性命，不受仇敌的惊恐！
64.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

64.zh: 求你把我隐藏， 使我脱离作恶之人的暗谋和作孽之人的扰乱。
64.en: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;

64.zh: 他们磨舌如刀， 发出苦毒的言语，好像比准了的箭，
64.en: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,

64.zh: 要在暗地射完全人； 他们忽然射他，并不惧怕。
64.en: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.

64.zh: 他们彼此勉励设下恶计； 他们商量暗设网罗， 说：谁能看见？
64.en: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”

64.zh: 他们图谋奸恶， [说]：我们是极力图谋的。 他们各人的意念心思是深的。
64.en: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.

64.zh: 但　神要射他们； 他们忽然被箭射伤。
64.en: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.

64.zh: 他们必然绊跌，被自己的舌头所害； 凡看见他们的必都摇头。
64.en: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.

64.zh: 众人都要害怕， 要传扬　神的工作， 并且明白他的作为。
64.en: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.

64.zh: 义人必因耶和华欢喜，并要投靠他； 凡心里正直的人都要夸口。
64.en: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!

65.zh: 大卫的诗歌，交与伶长。 　神啊，锡安的人都等候赞美你； 所许的愿也要向你偿还。
65.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.

65.zh: 听祷告的[主]啊， 凡有血气的都要来就你。
65.en: You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.

65.zh: 罪孽胜了我； 至于我们的过犯，你都要赦免。
65.en: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.

65.zh: 你所拣选、使他亲近你、住在你院中的， 这人便为有福！ 我们必因你居所、你圣殿的美福知足了。
65.en: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.

65.zh: 拯救我们的　神啊，你必以威严秉公义应允我们； 你本是一切地极和海上远处的人所倚靠的。
65.en: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea.

65.zh: 他既以大能束腰， 就用力量安定诸山，
65.en: By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.

65.zh: 使诸海的响声和其中波浪的响声， 并万民的喧哗，都平静了。
65.en: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

65.zh: 住在地极的人因你的神迹惧怕； 你使日出日落之地都欢呼。
65.en: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.

65.zh: 你眷顾地，降下透雨， 使地大得肥美。 　神的河满了水； 你这样浇灌了地， 好为人预备五谷。
65.en: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.

65.zh: 你浇透地的犁沟，润平犁脊， 降甘霖，使地软和； 其中发长的，蒙你赐福。
65.en: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.

65.zh: 你以恩典为年岁的冠冕； 你的路径都滴下脂油，
65.en: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.

65.zh: 滴在旷野的草场上。 小山以欢乐束腰；
65.en: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.

65.zh: 草场以羊群为衣； 谷中也长满了五谷。 这一切都欢呼歌唱。
65.en: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.

66.zh: 一篇诗歌，交与伶长。 全地都当向　神欢呼！
66.en: For the Chief Musician. A song. A Psalm. Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!

66.zh: 歌颂他名的荣耀！ 用赞美的言语将他的荣耀发明！
66.en: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!

66.zh: 当对　神说：你的作为何等可畏！ 因你的大能，仇敌要投降你。
66.en: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.

66.zh: 全地要敬拜你，歌颂你， 要歌颂你的名。 （细拉）
66.en: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.

66.zh: 你们来看　神所行的， 他向世人所做之事是可畏的。
66.en: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.

66.zh: 他将海变成干地，众民步行过河； 我们在那里因他欢喜。
66.en: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.

66.zh: 他用权能治理[万民]，直到永远。 他的眼睛鉴察列邦； 悖逆的人不可自高。 （细拉）
66.en: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.

66.zh: 万民哪，你们当称颂我们的　神， 使人得听赞美他的声音。
66.en: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,

66.zh: 他使我们的性命存活， 也不叫我们的脚摇动。
66.en: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.

66.zh: 神啊，你曾试验我们， 熬炼我们，如熬炼银子一样。
66.en: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.

66.zh: 你使我们进入网罗， 把重担放在我们的身上。
66.en: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.

66.zh: 你使人坐车轧我们的头； 我们经过水火， 你却使我们到丰富之地。
66.en: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.

66.zh: 我要用燔祭进你的殿， 向你还我的愿，
66.en: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,

66.zh: 就是在急难时我嘴唇所发的、 口中所许的。
66.en: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.

66.zh: 我要把肥牛作燔祭， 将公羊的香祭献给你， 又把公牛和山羊献上。 （细拉）
66.en: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.

66.zh: 凡敬畏　神的人，你们都来听！ 我要述说他为我所行的事。
66.en: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.

66.zh: 我曾用口求告他； 我的舌头也称他为高。
66.en: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.

66.zh: 我若心里注重罪孽， 主必不听。
66.en: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.

66.zh: 但　神实在听见了； 他侧耳听了我祷告的声音。
66.en: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.

66.zh: 神是应当称颂的！ 他并没有推却我的祷告， 也没有叫他的慈爱离开我。
66.en: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.

67.zh: 一篇诗歌，交与伶长。用丝弦的乐器。 愿　神怜悯我们，赐福与我们， 用脸光照我们， （细拉）
67.en: For the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.

67.zh: 好叫世界得知你的道路， 万国得知你的救恩。
67.en: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,

67.zh: 神啊，愿列邦称赞你！ 愿万民都称赞你！
67.en: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

67.zh: 愿万国都快乐欢呼； 因为你必按公正审判万民， 引导世上的万国。 （细拉）
67.en: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.

67.zh: 神啊，愿列邦称赞你！ 愿万民都称赞你！
67.en: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

67.zh: 地已经出了土产； 　神—就是我们的　神要赐福与我们。
67.en: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.

67.zh: 神要赐福与我们； 地的四极都要敬畏他！
67.en: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.

68.zh: 大卫的诗歌，交与伶长。 愿　神兴起，使他的仇敌四散， 叫那恨他的人从他面前逃跑。
68.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.

68.zh: 他们被驱逐，如烟被[风]吹散； 恶人见　神之面而消灭，如蜡被火熔化。
68.en: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

68.zh: 惟有义人必然欢喜， 在　神面前高兴快乐。
68.en: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.

68.zh: 你们当向　神唱诗，歌颂他的名； 为那坐车行过旷野的修平大路。 他的名是耶和华， 要在他面前欢乐！
68.en: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to the LORD, his name! Rejoice before him!

68.zh: 神在他的圣所作孤儿的父， 作寡妇的伸冤者。
68.en: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

68.zh: 神叫孤独的有家， 使被囚的出来享福； 惟有悖逆的住在干燥之地。
68.en: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

68.zh: 神啊，你曾在你百姓前头出来， 在旷野行走。 （细拉）
68.en: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.

68.zh: 那时，地见　神的面而震动，天也落雨； 西奈山见以色列　神的面也震动。
68.en: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

68.zh: 神啊，你降下大雨； 你产业[以色列]疲乏的时候，你使他坚固。
68.en: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.

68.zh: 你的会众住在其中； 　神啊，你的恩惠是为困苦人预备的。
68.en: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.

68.zh: 主发命令， 传好信息的妇女成了大群。
68.en: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.

68.zh: 统兵的君王逃跑了，逃跑了； 在家等候的妇女分受所夺的。
68.en: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,

68.zh: 你们安卧在羊圈的时候， 好像鸽子的翅膀镀白银，翎毛镀黄金一般。
68.en: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.

68.zh: 全能者在境内赶散列王的时候， 势如飘雪在撒们。
68.en: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.

68.zh: 巴珊山是　神的山； 巴珊山是多峰多岭的山。
68.en: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.

68.zh: 你们多峰多岭的山哪， 为何斜看　神所愿居住的山？ 耶和华必住这山，直到永远！
68.en: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, the LORD will dwell there forever.

68.zh: 神的车辇累万盈千； 主在其中，好像在西奈圣山一样。
68.en: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.

68.zh: 你已经升上高天，掳掠仇敌； 你在人间，就是在悖逆的人间，受了供献， 叫耶和华　神可以与他们同住。
68.en: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell there.

68.zh: 天天背负我们重担的主， 就是拯救我们的　神， 是应当称颂的！ （细拉）
68.en: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.

68.zh: 神是为我们施行诸般救恩的　神； 人能脱离死亡是在乎主耶和华。
68.en: God is to us a God of deliverance. To GOD, the Lord, belongs escape from death.

68.zh: 但　神要打破他仇敌的头， 就是那常犯罪之人的发顶。
68.en: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.

68.zh: 主说：我要使众民从巴珊而归， 使他们从深海而回，
68.en: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea,

68.zh: 使你打碎仇敌，你的脚踹在血中， 使你狗的舌头从其中得分。
68.en: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”

68.zh: 神啊，你是我的　神，我的王； 人已经看见你行走，进入圣所。
68.en: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.

68.zh: 歌唱的行在前，作乐的随在后， 都在击鼓的童女中间。
68.en: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,

68.zh: 从以色列源头而来的， 当在各会中称颂主　神！
68.en: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”

68.zh: 在那里，有统管他们的小便雅悯， 有犹大的首领和他们的群众， 有西布伦的首领， 有拿弗他利的首领。
68.en: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

68.zh: 以色列的能力是　神所赐的； 　神啊，求你坚固你为我们所成全的事！
68.en: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.

68.zh: 因你耶路撒冷的殿， 列王必带贡物献给你。
68.en: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings will bring presents to you.

68.zh: 求你叱喝芦苇中的野兽和群公牛， 并列邦中的牛犊。 把银块踹在脚下； 　神已经赶散好争战的列邦。
68.en: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample under foot the bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.

68.zh: 埃及的公侯要出来朝见　神； 古实人要急忙举手[祷告]。
68.en: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.

68.zh: 世上的列国啊，你们要向　神歌唱； 愿你们歌颂主！
68.en: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord— Selah—

68.zh: 歌颂那自古驾行在诸天以上的[主]！ 他发出声音，是极大的声音。
68.en: to him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.

68.zh: 你们要将能力归给　神。 他的威荣在以色列之上； 他的能力是在穹苍。
68.en: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.

68.zh: 神啊，你从圣所显为可畏； 以色列的　神是那将力量权能赐给他百姓的。 　神是应当称颂的！
68.en: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!

69.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。调用百合花。 　神啊，求你救我！ 因为众水要淹没我。
69.en: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Lilies.” By David. Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!

69.zh: 我陷在深淤泥中，没有立脚之地； 我到了深水中，大水漫过我身。
69.en: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

69.zh: 我因呼求困乏，喉咙发干； 我因等候　神，眼睛失明。
69.en: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.

69.zh: 无故恨我的，比我头发还多； 无理与我为仇、要把我剪除的，甚为强盛。 我没有抢夺的，要叫我偿还。
69.en: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.

69.zh: 神啊，我的愚昧，你原知道； 我的罪愆不能隐瞒。
69.en: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.

69.zh: 万军的主—耶和华啊， 求你叫那等候你的，不要因我蒙羞！ 以色列的　神啊， 求你叫那寻求你的，不要因我受辱！
69.en: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord GOD of Armies. Don’t let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.

69.zh: 因我为你的缘故受了辱骂， 满面羞愧。
69.en: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.

69.zh: 我的弟兄看我为外路人； 我的同胞看我为外邦人。
69.en: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.

69.zh: 因我为你的殿心里焦急，如同火烧， 并且辱骂你人的辱骂都落在我身上。
69.en: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.

69.zh: 我哭泣，以禁食[刻苦]我心； 这倒算为我的羞辱。
69.en: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.

69.zh: 我拿麻布当衣裳， 就成了他们的笑谈。
69.en: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.

69.zh: 坐在城门口的谈论我； 酒徒也以我为歌曲。
69.en: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.

69.zh: 但我在悦纳的时候向你—耶和华祈祷。 　神啊，求你按你丰盛的慈爱， 凭你拯救的诚实应允我！
69.en: But as for me, my prayer is to you, LORD, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.

69.zh: 求你搭救我出离淤泥， 不叫我陷在其中； 求你使我脱离那些恨我的人， 使我出离深水。
69.en: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.

69.zh: 求你不容大水漫过我， 不容深渊吞灭我， 不容坑坎在我以上合口。
69.en: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.

69.zh: 耶和华啊，求你应允我！ 因为你的慈爱本为美好； 求你按你丰盛的慈悲回转眷顾我！
69.en: Answer me, LORD, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.

69.zh: 不要掩面不顾你的仆人； 我是在急难之中，求你速速地应允我！
69.en: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!

69.zh: 求你亲近我，救赎我！ 求你因我的仇敌把我赎回！
69.en: Draw near to my soul and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.

69.zh: 你知道我受的辱骂、欺凌、羞辱； 我的敌人都在你面前。
69.en: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.

69.zh: 辱骂伤破了我的心， 我又满了忧愁。 我指望有人体恤，却没有一个； 我指望有人安慰，却找不着一个。
69.en: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.

69.zh: 他们拿苦胆给我当食物； 我渴了，他们拿醋给我喝。
69.en: They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.

69.zh: 愿他们的筵席在他们面前变为网罗， 在他们平安的时候变为机槛。
69.en: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.

69.zh: 愿他们的眼睛昏蒙，不得看见； 愿你使他们的腰常常战抖。
69.en: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.

69.zh: 求你将你的恼恨倒在他们身上， 叫你的烈怒追上他们。
69.en: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.

69.zh: 愿他们的住处变为荒场； 愿他们的帐棚无人居住。
69.en: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.

69.zh: 因为，你所击打的，他们就逼迫； 你所击伤的，他们戏说他的愁苦。
69.en: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.

69.zh: 愿你在他们的罪上加罪， 不容他们在你面前称义。
69.en: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.

69.zh: 愿他们从生命册上被涂抹， 不得记录在义人之中。
69.en: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.

69.zh: 但我是困苦忧伤的； 　神啊，愿你的救恩将我安置在高处。
69.en: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.

69.zh: 我要以诗歌赞美　神的名， 以感谢称他为大！
69.en: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

69.zh: 这便叫耶和华喜悦，胜似献牛， 或是献有角有蹄的公牛。
69.en: It will please the LORD better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.

69.zh: 谦卑的人看见了就喜乐； 寻求　神的人，愿你们的心苏醒。
69.en: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.

69.zh: 因为耶和华听了穷乏人， 不藐视被囚的人。
69.en: For the LORD hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.

69.zh: 愿天和地、 洋海和其中一切的动物都赞美他！
69.en: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!

69.zh: 因为　神要拯救锡安，建造犹大的城邑； 他的民要在那里居住，得以为业。
69.en: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.

69.zh: 他仆人的后裔要承受为业； 爱他名的人也要住在其中。
69.en: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.

70.zh: 大卫的纪念诗，交与伶长。 　神啊，求你[快快]搭救我！ 耶和华啊，求你速速帮助我！
70.en: For the Chief Musician. By David. A reminder. Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, LORD.

70.zh: 愿那些寻索我命的，抱愧蒙羞； 愿那些喜悦我遭害的，退后受辱。
70.en: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

70.zh: 愿那些对我说阿哈、阿哈的， 因羞愧退后。
70.en: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”

70.zh: 愿一切寻求你的，因你高兴欢喜； 愿那些喜爱你救恩的，常说：当尊　神为大！
70.en: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”

70.zh: 但我是困苦穷乏的； 　神啊，求你速速到我这里来！ 你是帮助我的，搭救我的。 耶和华啊，求你不要耽延！
70.en: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. LORD, don’t delay.

71.zh: 耶和华啊，我投靠你； 求你叫我永不羞愧！
71.en: In you, LORD, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.

71.zh: 求你凭你的公义搭救我，救拔我； 侧耳听我，拯救我！
71.en: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.

71.zh: 求你作我常住的磐石； 你已经命定要救我， 因为你是我的岩石，我的山寨。
71.en: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.

71.zh: 我的　神啊，求你救我脱离恶人的手， 脱离不义和残暴之人的手。
71.en: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

71.zh: 主—耶和华啊，你是我所盼望的； 从我年幼，你是我所倚靠的。
71.en: For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.

71.zh: 我从出母胎被你扶持； 使我出母腹的是你。 我必常常赞美你！
71.en: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.

71.zh: 许多人以我为怪， 但你是我坚固的避难所。
71.en: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.

71.zh: 你的赞美，你的荣耀 终日必满了我的口。
71.en: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.

71.zh: 我年老的时候，求你不要丢弃我！ 我力气衰弱的时候，求你不要离弃我！
71.en: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.

71.zh: 我的仇敌议论我； 那些窥探要害我命的彼此商议，
71.en: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,

71.zh: 说：　神已经离弃他； 我们追赶他，捉拿他吧！ 因为没有人搭救。
71.en: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”

71.zh: 神啊，求你不要远离我！ 我的　神啊，求你速速帮助我！
71.en: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.

71.zh: 愿那与我性命为敌的，羞愧被灭； 愿那谋害我的，受辱蒙羞。
71.en: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.

71.zh: 我却要常常盼望， 并要越发赞美你。
71.en: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.

71.zh: 我的口终日要述说你的公义和你的救恩， 因我不计其数。
71.en: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.

71.zh: 我要来[说]主—耶和华大能的事； 我单要提说你的公义。
71.en: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord GOD. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.

71.zh: 神啊，自我年幼时，你就教训我； 直到如今，我传扬你奇妙的作为。
71.en: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.

71.zh: 神啊，我到年老发白的时候， 求你不要离弃我！ 等我将你的能力指示下代， 将你的大能指示后世的人。
71.en: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.

71.zh: 神啊，你的公义甚高； 行过大事的　神啊，谁能像你！
71.en: God, your righteousness also reaches to the heavens. You have done great things. God, who is like you?

71.zh: 你是叫我们多经历重大急难的， 必使我们复活， 从地的深处救上来。
71.en: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.

71.zh: 求你使我越发昌大， 又转来安慰我。
71.en: Increase my honor and comfort me again.

71.zh: 我的　神啊，我要鼓瑟称赞你， 称赞你的诚实！ 以色列的圣者啊，我要弹琴歌颂你！
71.en: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.

71.zh: 我歌颂你的时候， 我的嘴唇和你所赎我的灵魂都必欢呼；
71.en: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!

71.zh: 并且我的舌头必终日讲论你的公义， 因为那些谋害我的人已经蒙羞受辱了。
71.en: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.

72.zh: 所罗门的诗。 　神啊，求你将判断的权柄赐给王， 将公义赐给王的儿子。
72.en: By Solomon. God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.

72.zh: 他要按公义审判你的民， 按公平审判你的困苦人。
72.en: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.

72.zh: 大山小山都要因公义使民得享平安。
72.en: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.

72.zh: 他必为民中的困苦人伸冤， 拯救穷乏之辈， 压碎那欺压人的。
72.en: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.

72.zh: 太阳还存，月亮还在， 人要敬畏你，直到万代！
72.en: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.

72.zh: 他必降临，像雨降在已割的草[地]上， 如甘霖滋润田地。
72.en: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.

72.zh: 在他的日子，义人要发旺， 大有平安，好像月亮长存。
72.en: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.

72.zh: 他要执掌权柄，从这海直到那海， 从大河直到地极。
72.en: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.

72.zh: 住在旷野的，必在他面前下拜； 他的仇敌必要舔土。
72.en: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.

72.zh: 他施和海岛的王要进贡； 示巴和西巴的王要献礼物。
72.en: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

72.zh: 诸王都要叩拜他； 万国都要事奉他。
72.en: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.

72.zh: 因为，穷乏人呼求的时候，他要搭救； 没有人帮助的困苦人，他也要搭救。
72.en: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.

72.zh: 他要怜恤贫寒和穷乏的人， 拯救穷苦人的性命。
72.en: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.

72.zh: 他要救赎他们脱离欺压和强暴； 他们的血在他眼中看为宝贵。
72.en: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.

72.zh: 他们要存活。 示巴的金子要奉给他； 人要常常为他祷告，终日称颂他。
72.en: He will live; and Sheba’s gold will be given to him. Men will pray for him continually. They will bless him all day long.

72.zh: 在地的山顶上，五谷必然茂盛； 所结的谷实要响动，如黎巴嫩[的树林]； 城里的人要发旺，如地上的草。
72.en: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.

72.zh: 他的名要存到永远， 要留传如日之久。 人要因他蒙福； 万国要称他有福。
72.en: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.

72.zh: 独行奇事的耶和华—以色列的　神 是应当称颂的！
72.en: Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

72.zh: 他荣耀的名也当称颂，直到永远。 愿他的荣耀充满全地！ 阿们！阿们！
72.en: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.

72.zh: 耶西的儿子—大卫的祈祷完毕。
72.en: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.

73.zh: 亚萨的诗。 　神实在恩待以色列那些清心的人！
73.en: A Psalm by Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

73.zh: 至于我，我的脚几乎失闪； 我的脚险些滑跌。
73.en: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.

73.zh: 我见恶人和狂傲人享平安就心怀不平。
73.en: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

73.zh: 他们死的时候没有疼痛； 他们的力气却也壮实。
73.en: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.

73.zh: 他们不像别人受苦， 也不像别人遭灾。
73.en: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.

73.zh: 所以，骄傲如链子戴在他们的项上； 强暴像衣裳遮住他们的身体。
73.en: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.

73.zh: 他们的眼睛因体胖而凸出； 他们所得的，过于心里所想的。
73.en: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.

73.zh: 他们讥笑人，凭恶意说欺压人的话； 他们说话自高。
73.en: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.

73.zh: 他们的口亵渎上天； 他们的舌毁谤全地。
73.en: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.

73.zh: 所以　神的民归到这里， 喝尽了满[杯的苦]水。
73.en: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.

73.zh: 他们说：　神怎能晓得？ 至高者岂有知识呢？
73.en: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”

73.zh: 看哪，这就是恶人； 他们既是常享安逸，财宝便加增。
73.en: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.

73.zh: 我实在徒然洁净了我的心， 徒然洗手表明无辜。
73.en: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,

73.zh: 因为，我终日遭灾难； 每早晨受惩治。
73.en: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.

73.zh: 我若说，我要这样讲， 这就是以奸诈待你的众子。
73.en: If I had said, “I will speak thus”, behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.

73.zh: 我思索怎能明白这事， 眼看实系为难，
73.en: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me—

73.zh: 等我进了　神的圣所， 思想他们的结局。
73.en: until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.

73.zh: 你实在把他们安在滑地， 使他们掉在沉沦之中。
73.en: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.

73.zh: 他们转眼之间成了何等的荒凉！ 他们被惊恐灭尽了。
73.en: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.

73.zh: 人睡醒了，怎样看梦； 主啊，你醒了也必照样轻看他们的影像。
73.en: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.

73.zh: 因而，我心里发酸， 肺腑被刺。
73.en: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.

73.zh: 我这样愚昧无知， 在你面前如畜类一般。
73.en: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.

73.zh: 然而，我常与你同在； 你搀着我的右手。
73.en: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.

73.zh: 你要以你的训言引导我， 以后必接我到荣耀里。
73.en: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

73.zh: 除你以外，在天上我有谁呢？ 除你以外，在地上我也没有所爱慕的。
73.en: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.

73.zh: 我的肉体和我的心肠衰残； 但　神是我心里的力量， 又是我的福分，直到永远。
73.en: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

73.zh: 远离你的，必要死亡； 凡离弃你行邪淫的，你都灭绝了。
73.en: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.

73.zh: 但我亲近　神是与我有益； 我以主耶和华为我的避难所， 好叫我述说你一切的作为。
73.en: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.

74.zh: 亚萨的训诲诗。 　神啊，你为何永远丢弃我们呢？ 你为何向你草场的羊发怒，如烟冒出呢？
74.en: A contemplation by Asaph. God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

74.zh: 求你记念你古时所得来的会众， 就是你所赎、作你产业支派的， 并记念你向来所居住的锡安山。
74.en: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance: Mount Zion, in which you have lived.

74.zh: 求你举步去看那日久荒凉之地， 仇敌在圣所中所行的一切恶事。
74.en: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.

74.zh: 你的敌人在你会中吼叫； 他们竖了自己的旗为记号。
74.en: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.

74.zh: 他们好像人扬起斧子， 砍伐林中的树。
74.en: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.

74.zh: 圣所中一切雕刻的， 他们现在用斧子锤子打坏了。
74.en: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.

74.zh: 他们用火焚烧你的圣所， 亵渎你名的居所，[拆毁]到地。
74.en: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.

74.zh: 他们心里说：我们要尽行毁灭； 他们就在遍地把　神的会所都烧毁了。
74.en: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.

74.zh: 我们不见我们的标帜，不再有先知； 我们内中也没有人知道[这灾祸]要到几时呢！
74.en: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.

74.zh: 神啊，敌人辱骂要到几时呢？ 仇敌亵渎你的名要到永远吗？
74.en: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?

74.zh: 你为什么缩回你的右手？ 求你从怀中伸出来，毁灭他们。
74.en: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!

74.zh: 神自古以来为我的王， 在地上施行拯救。
74.en: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.

74.zh: 你曾用能力将海分开， 将水中大鱼的头打破。
74.en: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

74.zh: 你曾砸碎鳄鱼的头， 把它给旷野的禽兽为食物。
74.en: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.

74.zh: 你曾分裂磐石，水便成了溪河； 你使长流的江河干了。
74.en: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.

74.zh: 白昼属你，黑夜也属你； 亮光和日头是你所预备的。
74.en: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.

74.zh: 地的一切疆界是你所立的； 夏天和冬天是你所定的。
74.en: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.

74.zh: 耶和华啊，仇敌辱骂， 愚顽民亵渎了你的名，求你记念这事。
74.en: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, LORD. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.

74.zh: 不要将你斑鸠的性命交给野兽； 不要永远忘记你困苦人的性命。
74.en: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.

74.zh: 求你顾念所立的约， 因为地上黑暗之处都满了强暴的居所。
74.en: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.

74.zh: 不要叫受欺压的人蒙羞回去； 要叫困苦穷乏的人赞美你的名。
74.en: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.

74.zh: 神啊，求你起来为自己伸诉！ 要记念愚顽人怎样终日辱骂你。
74.en: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.

74.zh: 不要忘记你敌人的声音； 那起来敌你之人的喧哗时常上升。
74.en: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.

75.zh: 亚萨的诗歌，交与伶长。调用休要毁坏。 　神啊，我们称谢你，我们称谢你！ 因为你的名相近，人都述说你奇妙的作为。
