75.en: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Psalm by Asaph. A song. We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.

75.zh: 我到了所定的日期， 必按正直施行审判。
75.en: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.

75.zh: 地和其上的居民都消化了； 我曾立了地的柱子。 （细拉）
75.en: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.

75.zh: 我对狂傲人说：不要行事狂傲！ 对凶恶人说：不要举角！
75.en: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.

75.zh: 不要把你们的角高举； 不要挺着颈项说话。
75.en: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”

75.zh: 因为高举非从东，非从西， 也非从南而来。
75.en: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.

75.zh: 惟有　神断定； 他使这人降卑，使那人升高。
75.en: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.

75.zh: 耶和华手里有杯， 其中的酒起沫，杯内满了搀杂的酒； 他倒出来， 地上的恶人必都喝这酒的渣滓，而且喝尽。
75.en: For in the LORD’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.

75.zh: 但我要宣扬，直到永远！ 我要歌颂雅各的　神！
75.en: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

75.zh: 恶人一切的角，我要砍断； 惟有义人的角必被高举。
75.en: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.

76.zh: 亚萨的诗歌，交与伶长。用丝弦的乐器。 在犹大，　神为人所认识； 在以色列，他的名为大。
76.en: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm by Asaph. A song. In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.

76.zh: 在撒冷有他的帐幕； 在锡安有他的居所。
76.en: His tabernacle is also in Salem. His dwelling place in Zion.

76.zh: 他在那里折断弓上的火箭， 并盾牌、刀剑，和争战[的兵器]。 （细拉）
76.en: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.

76.zh: 你从有野食之山而来， 有光华和荣美。
76.en: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.

76.zh: 心中勇敢的人都被抢夺； 他们睡了长觉，没有一个英雄能措手。
76.en: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.

76.zh: 雅各的　神啊，你的斥责一发， [坐]车的、[骑]马的都沉睡了。
76.en: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

76.zh: 惟独你是可畏的！ 你怒气一发，谁能在你面前站得住呢？
76.en: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?

76.zh: 你从天上使人听判断。 　神起来施行审判， 要救地上一切谦卑的人； 那时地就惧怕而静默。 （细拉）
76.en: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,
when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.

76.zh: 人的忿怒要成全你的荣美； 人的余怒，你要禁止。
76.en: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.

76.zh: 你们许愿，当向耶和华—你们的　神还愿； 在他四面的人都当拿贡物献给那可畏的主。
76.en: Make vows to the LORD your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.

76.zh: 他要挫折王子的骄气； 他向地上的君王显威可畏。
76.en: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.

77.zh: 亚萨的诗，照耶杜顿的作法，交与伶长。 我要向　神发声呼求； 我向　神发声，他必留心听我。
77.en: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by Asaph. My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.

77.zh: 我在患难之日寻求主； 我在夜间不住地举手祷告； 我的心不肯受安慰。
77.en: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.

77.zh: 我想念　神，就烦燥不安； 我沉吟悲伤，心便发昏。 （细拉）
77.en: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.

77.zh: 你叫我不能闭眼； 我烦乱不安，甚至不能说话。
77.en: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.

77.zh: 我追想古时之日， 上古之年。
77.en: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

77.zh: 我想起我夜间的歌曲，扪心自问； 我心里也仔细省察。
77.en: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:

77.zh: 难道主要永远丢弃[我]， 不再施恩吗？
77.en: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?

77.zh: 难道他的慈爱永远穷尽， 他的应许世世废弃吗？
77.en: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?

77.zh: 难道　神忘记开恩， 因发怒就止住他的慈悲吗？ （细拉）
77.en: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.

77.zh: 我便说：这是我的懦弱， [但我要追念]至高者[显出]右手之年代。
77.en: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”

77.zh: 我要提说耶和华所行的； 我要记念你古时的奇事。
77.en: I will remember the LORD’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.

77.zh: 我也要思想你的经营， 默念你的作为。
77.en: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.

77.zh: 神啊，你的作为是洁净的； 有何神大如　神呢？
77.en: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?

77.zh: 你是行奇事的　神； 你曾在列邦中彰显你的能力。
77.en: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.

77.zh: 你曾用你的膀臂赎了你的民， 就是雅各和约瑟的子孙。 （细拉）
77.en: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

77.zh: 神啊，诸水见你， 一见就都惊惶； 深渊也都战抖。
77.en: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.

77.zh: 云中倒出水来； 天空发出响声； 你的箭也飞行四方。
77.en: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.

77.zh: 你的雷声在旋风中； 电光照亮世界； 大地战抖震动。
77.en: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.

77.zh: 你的道在海中； 你的路在大水中； 你的脚踪无人知道。
77.en: Your way was through the sea, your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.

77.zh: 你曾借摩西和亚伦的手引导你的百姓， 好像羊群一般。
77.en: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

78.zh: 亚萨的训诲诗。 我的民哪，你们要留心听我的训诲， 侧耳听我口中的话。
78.en: A contemplation by Asaph. Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.

78.zh: 我要开口说比喻； 我要说出古时的谜语，
78.en: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,

78.zh: 是我们所听见、所知道的， 也是我们的祖宗告诉我们的。
78.en: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

78.zh: 我们不将这些事向他们的子孙隐瞒， 要将耶和华的美德和他的能力， 并他奇妙的作为，述说给后代听。
78.en: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.

78.zh: 因为，他在雅各中立法度， 在以色列中设律法； 是他吩咐我们祖宗要传给子孙的，
78.en: For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;

78.zh: 使将要生的后代子孙可以晓得； 他们也要起来告诉他们的子孙，
78.en: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,

78.zh: 好叫他们仰望　神， 不忘记　神的作为， 惟要守他的命令。
78.en: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,

78.zh: 不要像他们的祖宗， 是顽梗悖逆、居心不正之辈， 向着　神，心不诚实。
78.en: and might not be as their fathers— a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.

78.zh: 以法莲的子孙带着兵器，拿着弓， 临阵之日转身退后。
78.en: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

78.zh: 他们不遵守　神的约， 不肯照他的律法行；
78.en: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.

78.zh: 又忘记他所行的 和他显给他们奇妙的作为。
78.en: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.

78.zh: 他在埃及地，在琐安田， 在他们祖宗的眼前施行奇事。
78.en: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

78.zh: 他将海分裂，使他们过去， 又叫水立起如垒。
78.en: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.

78.zh: 他白日用云彩， 终夜用火光引导他们。
78.en: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.

78.zh: 他在旷野分裂磐石， 多多地给他们水喝，如从深渊而出。
78.en: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

78.zh: 他使水从磐石涌出， 叫水如江河下流。
78.en: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

78.zh: 他们却仍旧得罪他， 在干燥之地悖逆至高者。
78.en: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.

78.zh: 他们心中试探　神， 随自己所欲的求食物，
78.en: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.

78.zh: 并且妄论　神说： 　神在旷野岂能摆设筵席吗？
78.en: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

78.zh: 他曾击打磐石，使水涌出，成了江河； 他还能赐粮食吗？ 还能为他的百姓预备肉吗？
78.en: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”

78.zh: 所以，耶和华听见就发怒； 有烈火向雅各烧起； 有怒气向以色列上腾；
78.en: Therefore the LORD heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,

78.zh: 因为他们不信服　神， 不倚赖他的救恩。
78.en: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.

78.zh: 他却吩咐天空， 又敞开天上的门，
78.en: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.

78.zh: 降吗哪，像雨给他们吃， 将天上的粮食赐给他们。
78.en: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.

78.zh: 各人吃大能者的食物； 他赐下粮食，使他们饱足。
78.en: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.

78.zh: 他领东风起在天空， 又用能力引了南风来。
78.en: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.

78.zh: 他降肉，像雨在他们当中，多如尘土， 又降飞鸟，多如海沙，
78.en: He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.

78.zh: 落在他们的营中， 在他们住处的四面。
78.en: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.

78.zh: 他们吃了，而且饱足； 这样就随了他们所欲的。
78.en: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.

78.zh: 他们贪而无厌， 食物还在他们口中的时候，
78.en: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,

78.zh: 神的怒气就向他们上腾， 杀了他们内中的肥壮人， 打倒以色列的少年人。
78.en: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their strongest, and struck down the young men of Israel.

78.zh: 虽是这样，他们仍旧犯罪， 不信他奇妙的作为。
78.en: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.

78.zh: 因此，他叫他们的日子全归虚空， 叫他们的年岁尽属惊恐。
78.en: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.

78.zh: 他杀他们的时候，他们才求问他， 回心转意，切切地寻求　神。
78.en: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.

78.zh: 他们也追念　神是他们的磐石， 至高的　神是他们的救赎主。
78.en: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.

78.zh: 他们却用口谄媚他， 用舌向他说谎。
78.en: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.

78.zh: 因他们的心向他不正， 在他的约上也不忠心。
78.en: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.

78.zh: 但他有怜悯， 赦免他们的罪孽， 不灭绝他们， 而且屡次消他的怒气， 不发尽他的忿怒。
78.en: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.

78.zh: 他想到他们不过是血气， 是一阵去而不返的风。
78.en: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.

78.zh: 他们在旷野悖逆他， 在荒地叫他担忧，何其多呢！
78.en: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!

78.zh: 他们再三试探　神， 惹动以色列的圣者。
78.en: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

78.zh: 他们不追念他的能力 和赎他们脱离敌人的日子；
78.en: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;

78.zh: 他怎样在埃及地显神迹， 在琐安田显奇事，
78.en: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,

78.zh: 把他们的江河并河汊的水都变为血， 使他们不能喝。
78.en: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.

78.zh: 他叫苍蝇成群落在他们当中，嘬尽他们， 又叫青蛙灭了他们，
78.en: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

78.zh: 把他们的土产交给蚂蚱， 把他们辛苦得来的交给蝗虫。
78.en: He also gave their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.

78.zh: 他降冰雹打坏他们的葡萄树， 下严霜打坏他们的桑树，
78.en: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.

78.zh: 又把他们的牲畜交给冰雹， 把他们的群畜交给闪电。
78.en: He also gave over their livestock to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

78.zh: 他使猛烈的怒气和忿怒、恼恨、苦难 成了一群降灾的使者，临到他们。
78.en: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.

78.zh: 他为自己的怒气修平了路， 将他们交给瘟疫， 使他们死亡，
78.en: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,

78.zh: 在埃及击杀一切长子， 在含的帐棚中击杀他们强壮时头生的。
78.en: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.

78.zh: 他却领出自己的民如羊， 在旷野引他们如羊群。
78.en: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

78.zh: 他领他们稳稳妥妥地，使他们不致害怕； 海却淹没他们的仇敌。
78.en: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

78.zh: 他带他们到自己圣地的边界， 到他右手所得的这山地。
78.en: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.

78.zh: 他在他们面前赶出外邦人， 用绳子将外邦的地量给他们为业， 叫以色列支派的人住在他们的帐棚里。
78.en: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

78.zh: 他们仍旧试探、悖逆至高的　神， 不守他的法度，
78.en: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,

78.zh: 反倒退后，行诡诈，像他们的祖宗一样； 他们改变，如同翻背的弓。
78.en: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.

78.zh: 因他们的邱坛惹了他的怒气； 因他们雕刻的偶像触动他的愤恨。
78.en: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.

78.zh: 神听见就发怒， 极其憎恶以色列人。
78.en: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,

78.zh: 甚至他离弃示罗的帐幕， 就是他在人间所搭的帐棚；
78.en: so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,

78.zh: 又将他的约柜交与人掳去， 将他的荣耀交在敌人手中；
78.en: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.

78.zh: 并将他的百姓交与刀剑， 向他的产业发怒。
78.en: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.

78.zh: 少年人被火烧灭； 处女也无喜歌。
78.en: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.

78.zh: 祭司倒在刀下， 寡妇却不哀哭。
78.en: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.

78.zh: 那时，主像世人睡醒， 像勇士饮酒呼喊。
78.en: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.

78.zh: 他就打退了他的敌人， 叫他们永蒙羞辱；
78.en: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.

78.zh: 并且他弃掉约瑟的帐棚， 不拣选以法莲支派，
78.en: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,

78.zh: 却拣选犹大支派—他所喜爱的锡安山；
78.en: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.

78.zh: 盖造他的圣所，好像高峰， 又像他建立永存之地；
78.en: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.

78.zh: 又拣选他的仆人大卫， 从羊圈中将他召来，
78.en: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

78.zh: 叫他不再跟从那些带奶的母羊， 为要牧养自己的百姓雅各 和自己的产业以色列。
78.en: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.

78.zh: 于是，他按心中的纯正牧养他们， 用手中的巧妙引导他们。
78.en: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.

79.zh: 亚萨的诗。 　神啊，外邦人进入你的产业， 污秽你的圣殿，使耶路撒冷变成荒堆，
79.en: A Psalm by Asaph. God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

79.zh: 把你仆人的尸首交与天空的飞鸟为食， 把你圣民的肉交与地上的野兽，
79.en: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.

79.zh: 在耶路撒冷周围流他们的血如水， 无人葬埋。
79.en: They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.

79.zh: 我们成为邻国的羞辱， 成为我们四围人的嗤笑讥刺。
79.en: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.

79.zh: 耶和华啊，这到几时呢？ 你要动怒到永远吗？ 你的愤恨要如火焚烧吗？
79.en: How long, LORD? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?

79.zh: 愿你将你的忿怒倒在那不认识你的外邦 和那不求告你名的国度。
79.en: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name,

79.zh: 因为他们吞了雅各， 把他的住处变为荒场。
79.en: for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.

79.zh: 求你不要记念我们先祖的罪孽，向我们追讨； 愿你的慈悲快迎着我们， 因为我们落到极卑微的地步。
79.en: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.

79.zh: 拯救我们的　神啊，求你因你名的荣耀帮助我们！ 为你名的缘故搭救我们，赦免我们的罪。
79.en: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.

79.zh: 为何容外邦人说「他们的　神在哪里」呢？ 愿你使外邦人知道你在我们眼前 伸你仆人流血的冤。
79.en: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.

79.zh: 愿被囚之人的叹息达到你面前； 愿你按你的大能力存留那些将要死的人。
79.en: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.

79.zh: 主啊，愿你将我们邻邦所羞辱你的羞辱 加七倍归到他们身上。
79.en: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.

79.zh: 这样，你的民，你草场的羊， 要称谢你，直到永远； 要述说赞美你的话，直到万代。
79.en: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.

80.zh: 亚萨的诗，交与伶长。调用为证的百合花。 领约瑟如领羊群之以色列的牧者啊，求你留心听！ 坐在二基路伯上的啊，求你发出光来！
80.en: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lilies of the Covenant.” A Psalm by Asaph. Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.

80.zh: 在以法莲、便雅悯、玛拿西前面 施展你的大能，来救我们。
80.en: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!

80.zh: 神啊，求你使我们回转， 使你的脸发光，我们便要得救！
80.en: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

80.zh: 耶和华—万军之　神啊， 你向你百姓的祷告发怒，要到几时呢？
80.en: LORD God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?

80.zh: 你以眼泪当食物给他们吃， 又多量出眼泪给他们喝。
80.en: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.

80.zh: 你使邻邦因我们纷争； 我们的仇敌彼此戏笑。
80.en: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.

80.zh: 万军之　神啊，求你使我们回转， 使你的脸发光，我们便要得救！
80.en: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

80.zh: 你从埃及挪出一棵葡萄树， 赶出外邦人，把这树栽上。
80.en: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.

80.zh: 你在这树根前预备了[地方]， 它就深深扎根，爬满了地。
80.en: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.

80.zh: 它的影子遮满了山， 枝子好像佳美的香柏树。
80.en: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.

80.zh: 它发出枝子，长到大海， 发出蔓子，延到大河。
80.en: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.

80.zh: 你为何拆毁这树的篱笆， 任凭一切过路的人摘取？
80.en: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

80.zh: 林中出来的野猪把它糟踏； 野地的走兽拿它当食物。
80.en: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.

80.zh: 万军之　神啊，求你回转！ 从天上垂看，眷顾这葡萄树，
80.en: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,

80.zh: 保护你右手所栽的 和你为自己所坚固的枝子。
80.en: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.

80.zh: 这树已经被火焚烧，被刀砍伐； 他们因你脸上的怒容就灭亡了。
80.en: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.

80.zh: 愿你的手扶持你右边的人， 就是你为自己所坚固的人子。
80.en: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.

80.zh: 这样，我们便不退后离开你； 求你救活我们，我们就要求告你的名。
80.en: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.

80.zh: 耶和华—万军之　神啊，求你使我们回转， 使你的脸发光，我们便要得救！
80.en: Turn us again, LORD God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

81.zh: 亚萨的诗，交与伶长。用迦特乐器。 你们当向　神—我们的力量大声欢呼， 向雅各的　神发声欢乐！
81.en: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. By Asaph. Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!

81.zh: 唱起诗歌，打手鼓， 弹美琴与瑟。
81.en: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.

81.zh: 当在月朔并月望— 我们过节的日期吹角，
81.en: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.

81.zh: 因这是为以色列定的律例， 是雅各　神的典章。
81.en: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

81.zh: 他去攻击埃及地的时候， 在约瑟中间立此为证。 我[在那里]听见我所不明白的言语：
81.en: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.

81.zh: [神说]：我使你的肩得脱重担， 你的手放下筐子。
81.en: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.

81.zh: 你在急难中呼求，我就搭救你； 我在雷的隐密处应允你， 在米利巴水那里试验你。 （细拉）
81.en: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.” Selah.

81.zh: 我的民哪，你当听，我要劝戒你； 以色列啊，甚愿你肯听从我。
81.en: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!

81.zh: 在你当中，不可有别的神； 外邦的神，你也不可下拜。
81.en: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.

81.zh: 我是耶和华—你的　神， 曾把你从埃及地领上来； 你要大大张口，我就给你充满。
81.en: I am the LORD, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

81.zh: 无奈，我的民不听我的声音； 以色列全不理我。
81.en: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.

81.zh: 我便任凭他们心里刚硬， 随自己的计谋而行。
81.en: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.

81.zh: 甚愿我的民肯听从我， 以色列肯行我的道，
81.en: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!

81.zh: 我便速速治服他们的仇敌， 反手攻击他们的敌人。
81.en: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.

81.zh: 恨耶和华的人必来投降， 但他的百姓必永久长存。
81.en: The haters of the LORD would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.

81.zh: 他也必拿上好的麦子给他们吃， 又拿从磐石出的蜂蜜叫他们饱足。
81.en: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”

82.zh: 亚萨的诗。 　神站在有权力者的会中， 在诸神中行审判，
82.en: A Psalm by Asaph. God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.

82.zh: 说：你们审判不秉公义， 徇恶人的情面，要到几时呢？ （细拉）
82.en: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.

82.zh: 你们当为贫寒的人和孤儿伸冤； 当为困苦和穷乏的人施行公义。
82.en: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

82.zh: 当保护贫寒和穷乏的人， 救他们脱离恶人的手。
82.en: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”

82.zh: 你们仍不知道，也不明白， 在黑暗中走来走去； 地的根基都摇动了。
82.en: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

82.zh: 我曾说：你们是神， 都是至高者的儿子。
82.en: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.

82.zh: 然而，你们要死，与世人一样， 要仆倒，像王子中的一位。
82.en: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”

82.zh: 神啊，求你起来审判世界， 因为你要得万邦为业。
82.en: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.

83.zh: 亚萨的诗歌。 　神啊，求你不要静默！ 　神啊，求你不要闭口，也不要不作声！
83.en: A song. A Psalm by Asaph. God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.

83.zh: 因为你的仇敌喧嚷， 恨你的抬起头来。
83.en: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.

83.zh: 他们同谋奸诈要害你的百姓， 彼此商议要害你所隐藏的人。
83.en: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.

83.zh: 他们说：来吧，我们将他们剪灭， 使他们不再成国！ 使以色列的名不再被人记念！
83.en: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”

83.zh: 他们同心商议， 彼此结盟，要抵挡你，
83.en: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.

83.zh: 就是住帐棚的以东人和以实玛利人， 摩押和夏甲人，
83.en: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

83.zh: 迦巴勒、亚扪， 和亚玛力、非利士并泰尔的居民。
83.en: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

83.zh: 亚述也与他们连合； 他们作罗得子孙的帮手。 （细拉）
83.en: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.

83.zh: 求你待他们，如待米甸， 如在基顺河待西西拉和耶宾一样。
83.en: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;

83.zh: 他们在隐·多珥灭亡， 成了地上的粪土。
83.en: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.

83.zh: 求你叫他们的首领像俄立和西伊伯， 叫他们的王子都像西巴和撒慕拿。
83.en: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

83.zh: 他们说：我们要得　神的住处， 作为自己的产业。
83.en: who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”

83.zh: 我的　神啊，求你叫他们像旋风的尘土， 像风前的碎秸。
83.en: My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.

83.zh: 火怎样焚烧树林， 火焰怎样烧着山岭，
83.en: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,

83.zh: 求你也照样用狂风追赶他们， 用暴雨恐吓他们。
83.en: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.

83.zh: 愿你使他们满面羞耻， 好叫他们寻求你—耶和华的名！
83.en: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, LORD.

83.zh: 愿他们永远羞愧惊惶！ 愿他们惭愧灭亡！
83.en: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;

83.zh: 使他们知道：惟独你— 名为耶和华的—是全地以上的至高者！
83.en: that they may know that you alone, whose name is the LORD, are the Most High over all the earth.

84.zh: 可拉后裔的诗，交与伶长。用迦特乐器。 万军之耶和华啊， 你的居所何等可爱！
84.en: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. How lovely are your dwellings, LORD of Armies!

84.zh: 我羡慕渴想耶和华的院宇； 我的心肠，我的肉体向永生　神呼吁。
84.en: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of the LORD. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

84.zh: 万军之耶和华—我的王，我的　神啊， 在你祭坛那里，麻雀为自己找着房屋， 燕子为自己找着抱雏之窝。
84.en: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, LORD of Armies, my King, and my God.

84.zh: 如此住在你殿中的便为有福！ 他们仍要赞美你。 （细拉）
84.en: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.

84.zh: 靠你有力量、心中想往锡安大道的， 这人便为有福！
84.en: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.

84.zh: 他们经过「流泪谷」，叫这谷变为泉源之地； 并有秋雨之福盖满了全谷。
84.en: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.

84.zh: 他们行走，力上加力， 各人到锡安朝见　神。
84.en: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.

84.zh: 耶和华—万军之　神啊，求你听我的祷告！ 雅各的　神啊，求你留心听！ （细拉）
84.en: LORD, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.

84.zh: 神啊，你是我们的盾牌； 求你垂顾观看你受膏者的面！
84.en: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.

84.zh: 在你的院宇住一日， 胜似[在别处住]千日； 宁可在我　神殿中看门， 不愿住在恶人的帐棚里。
84.en: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

84.zh: 因为耶和华—　神是日头，是盾牌， 要赐下恩惠和荣耀。 他未尝留下一样好处不给那些行动正直的人。
84.en: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

84.zh: 万军之耶和华啊， 倚靠你的人便为有福！
84.en: LORD of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.

85.zh: 可拉后裔的诗，交与伶长。 耶和华啊，你已经向你的地施恩， 救回被掳的雅各。
85.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. LORD, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.

85.zh: 你赦免了你百姓的罪孽， 遮盖了他们一切的过犯。 （细拉）
85.en: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.

85.zh: 你收转了所发的忿怒 和你猛烈的怒气。
85.en: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.

85.zh: 拯救我们的　神啊，求你使我们回转， 叫你的恼恨向我们止息。
85.en: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.

85.zh: 你要向我们发怒到永远吗？ 你要将你的怒气延留到万代吗？
85.en: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?

85.zh: 你不再将我们救活， 使你的百姓靠你欢喜吗？
85.en: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

85.zh: 耶和华啊，求你使我们得见你的慈爱， 又将你的救恩赐给我们。
85.en: Show us your loving kindness, LORD. Grant us your salvation.

85.zh: 我要听　神—耶和华所说的话； 因为他必应许将平安赐给他的百姓—他的圣民； 他们却不可再转去妄行。
85.en: I will hear what God, the LORD, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.

85.zh: 他的救恩诚然与敬畏他的人相近， 叫荣耀住在我们的地上。
85.en: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.

85.zh: 慈爱和诚实彼此相遇； 公义和平安彼此相亲。
85.en: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

85.zh: 诚实从地而生； 公义从天而现。
85.en: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.

85.zh: 耶和华必将好处赐给[我们]； 我们的地也要[多]出土产。
85.en: Yes, the LORD will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.

85.zh: 公义要行在他面前， 叫他的脚踪成为[可走的]路。
85.en: Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps.

86.zh: 大卫的祈祷。 耶和华啊，求你侧耳应允我， 因我是困苦穷乏的。
86.en: A Prayer by David. Hear, LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

86.zh: 求你保存我的性命，因我是虔诚人。 我的　神啊，求你拯救这倚靠你的仆人！
86.en: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.

86.zh: 主啊，求你怜悯我， 因我终日求告你。
86.en: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.

86.zh: 主啊，求你使仆人心里欢喜， 因为我的心仰望你。
86.en: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

86.zh: 主啊，你本为良善，乐意饶恕人， 有丰盛的慈爱赐给凡求告你的人。
86.en: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

86.zh: 耶和华啊，求你留心听我的祷告， 垂听我恳求的声音。
86.en: Hear, LORD, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.

86.zh: 我在患难之日要求告你， 因为你必应允我。
86.en: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.

86.zh: 主啊，诸神之中没有可比你的； 你的作为也无可比。
86.en: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.

86.zh: 主啊，你所造的万民都要来敬拜你； 他们也要荣耀你的名。
86.en: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.

86.zh: 因你为大，且行奇妙的事； 惟独你是　神。
86.en: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.

86.zh: 耶和华啊，求你将你的道指教我； 我要照你的真理行； 求你使我专心敬畏你的名！
86.en: Teach me your way, LORD. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.

86.zh: 主—我的　神啊，我要一心称赞你； 我要荣耀你的名，直到永远。
86.en: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.

86.zh: 因为，你向我发的慈爱是大的； 你救了我的灵魂免入极深的阴间。
86.en: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

86.zh: 神啊，骄傲的人起来攻击我， 又有一党强横的人寻索我的命； 他们没有将你放在眼中。
86.en: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.

86.zh: 主啊，你是有怜悯有恩典的　神， 不轻易发怒，并有丰盛的慈爱和诚实。
86.en: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

86.zh: 求你向我转脸，怜恤我， 将你的力量赐给仆人，救你婢女的儿子。
86.en: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.

86.zh: 求你向我显出恩待我的凭据， 叫恨我的人看见便羞愧， 因为你—耶和华帮助我，安慰我。
86.en: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, LORD, have helped me, and comforted me.

87.zh: 可拉后裔的诗歌。 耶和华所立的根基在圣山上。
87.en: A Psalm by the sons of Korah; a Song. His foundation is in the holy mountains.

87.zh: 他爱锡安的门， 胜于爱雅各一切的住处。
87.en: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

87.zh: 神的城啊， 有荣耀的事乃指着你说的。 （细拉）
87.en: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.

87.zh: 我要提起拉哈伯和巴比伦人， 是在认识我之中的； 看哪，非利士和泰尔并古实人， 个个生在那里。
87.en: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”

87.zh: 论到锡安，必说： 这一个、那一个都生在其中， 而且至高者必亲自坚立这城。
87.en: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.

87.zh: 当耶和华记录万民的时候， 他要点出这一个生在那里。 （细拉）
87.en: The LORD will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.

87.zh: 歌唱的，跳舞的，都[要说]： 我的泉源都在你里面。
87.en: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”

88.zh: 可拉后裔的诗歌，就是以斯拉人希幔的训诲诗，交与伶长。调用麻哈拉利暗俄。 耶和华—拯救我的　神啊， 我昼夜在你面前呼吁。
88.en: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Suffering of Affliction.” A contemplation by Heman, the Ezrahite. LORD, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.

88.zh: 愿我的祷告达到你面前； 求你侧耳听我的呼求！
88.en: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.

88.zh: 因为我心里满了患难； 我的性命临近阴间。
88.en: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.

88.zh: 我算和下坑的人同列， 如同无力的人一样。
88.en: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,

88.zh: 我被丢在死人中， 好像被杀的人躺在坟墓里。 他们是你不再记念的， 与你隔绝了。
88.en: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.

88.zh: 你把我放在极深的坑里， 在黑暗地方，在深处。
88.en: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

88.zh: 你的忿怒重压我身； 你用一切的波浪困住我。 （细拉）
88.en: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.

88.zh: 你把我所认识的隔在远处， 使我为他们所憎恶； 我被拘困，不得出来。
88.en: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.

88.zh: 我的眼睛因困苦而干瘪。 耶和华啊，我天天求告你，向你举手。
88.en: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, LORD. I have spread out my hands to you.

88.zh: 你岂要行奇事给死人看吗？ 难道阴魂还能起来称赞你吗？ （细拉）
88.en: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.

88.zh: 岂能在坟墓里述说你的慈爱吗？ 岂能在灭亡中述说你的信实吗？
88.en: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?

88.zh: 你的奇事岂能在幽暗里被知道吗？ 你的公义岂能在忘记之地被知道吗？
88.en: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

88.zh: 耶和华啊，我呼求你； 我早晨的祷告要达到你面前。
88.en: But to you, LORD, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.

88.zh: 耶和华啊，你为何丢弃我？ 为何掩面不顾我？
88.en: LORD, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?

88.zh: 我自幼受苦，几乎死亡； 我受你的惊恐，甚至慌张。
88.en: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.

88.zh: 你的烈怒漫过我身； 你的惊吓把我剪除。
88.en: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.

88.zh: 这些终日如水环绕我， 一齐都来围困我。
88.en: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.

88.zh: 你把我的良朋密友隔在远处， 使我所认识的人进入黑暗里。
88.en: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.

89.zh: 以斯拉人以探的训诲诗。 我要歌唱耶和华的慈爱，直到永远； 我要用口将你的信实传与万代。
89.en: A contemplation by Ethan, the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving kindness of the LORD forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.

89.zh: 因我曾说：[你的]慈悲必建立到永远； 你的信实必坚立在天上。
89.en: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”

89.zh: 我与我所拣选的人立了约， 向我的仆人大卫起了誓：
89.en: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,

89.zh: 我要建立你的后裔，直到永远； 要建立你的宝座，直到万代。 （细拉）
89.en: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.

89.zh: 耶和华啊，诸天要称赞你的奇事； 在圣者的会中，要称赞你的信实。
89.en: The heavens will praise your wonders, LORD, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

89.zh: 在天空谁能比耶和华呢？ 神的众子中，谁能像耶和华呢？
89.en: For who in the skies can be compared to the LORD? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like the LORD,

89.zh: 他在圣者的会中，是大有威严的　神， 比一切在他四围的更可畏惧。
89.en: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?

89.zh: 耶和华—万军之　神啊， 哪一个大能者像你耶和华？ 你的信实是在你的四围。
89.en: LORD, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? LORD, your faithfulness is around you.

89.zh: 你管辖海的狂傲； 波浪翻腾，你就使它平静了。
89.en: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.

89.zh: 你打碎了拉哈伯，似乎是已杀的人； 你用有能的膀臂打散了你的仇敌。
89.en: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.

89.zh: 天属你，地也属你； 世界和其中所充满的都为你所建立。
89.en: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.

89.zh: 南北为你所创造； 他泊和黑门都因你的名欢呼。
89.en: You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.

89.zh: 你有大能的膀臂； 你的手有力，你的右手也高举。
89.en: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.

89.zh: 公义和公平是你宝座的根基； 慈爱和诚实行在你前面。
89.en: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.

89.zh: 知道[向你]欢呼的，那民是有福的！ 耶和华啊，他们在你脸上的光里行走。
89.en: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, LORD.

89.zh: 他们因你的名终日欢乐， 因你的公义得以高举。
89.en: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.

89.zh: 你是他们力量的荣耀； 因为你喜悦我们，我们的角必被高举。
89.en: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.

89.zh: 我们的盾牌属耶和华； 我们的王属以色列的圣者。
89.en: For our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel.

89.zh: 当时，你在异象中晓谕你的圣民，说： 我已把救助之力加在那有能者的身上； 我高举那从民中所拣选的。
89.en: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.

89.zh: 我寻得我的仆人大卫， 用我的圣膏膏他。
89.en: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,

89.zh: 我的手必使他坚立； 我的膀臂也必坚固他。
89.en: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.

89.zh: 仇敌必不勒索他； 凶恶之子也不苦害他。
89.en: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.

89.zh: 我要在他面前打碎他的敌人， 击杀那恨他的人。
89.en: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.

89.zh: 只是我的信实和我的慈爱要与他同在； 因我的名，他的角必被高举。
89.en: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.

89.zh: 我要使他的[左]手伸到海上， 右手伸到河上。
89.en: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.

89.zh: 他要称呼我说：你是我的父， 是我的　神，是拯救我的磐石。
89.en: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’

89.zh: 我也要立他为长子， 为世上最高的君王。
89.en: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

89.zh: 我要为他存留我的慈爱，直到永远； 我与他立的约必要坚定。
89.en: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.

89.zh: 我也要使他的后裔存到永远， 使他的宝座如天之久。
89.en: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

89.zh: 倘若他的子孙离弃我的律法， 不照我的典章行，
89.en: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;

89.zh: 背弃我的律例， 不遵守我的诫命，
89.en: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;

89.zh: 我就要用杖责罚他们的过犯， 用鞭责罚他们的罪孽。
89.en: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

89.zh: 只是我必不将我的慈爱全然收回， 也必不叫我的信实废弃。
89.en: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.

89.zh: 我必不背弃我的约， 也不改变我口中所出的。
89.en: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.

89.zh: 我一次指着自己的圣洁起誓： 我决不向大卫说谎！
89.en: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.

89.zh: 他的后裔要存到永远； 他的宝座在我面前如日之恒一般，
89.en: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.

89.zh: 又如月亮永远坚立， 如天上确实的见证。 （细拉）
89.en: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.

89.zh: 但你恼怒你的受膏者， 就丢掉弃绝他。
89.en: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.

89.zh: 你厌恶了与仆人所立的约， 将他的冠冕践踏于地。
89.en: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.

89.zh: 你拆毁了他一切的篱笆， 使他的保障变为荒场。
89.en: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.

89.zh: 凡过路的人都抢夺他； 他成为邻邦的羞辱。
89.en: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.

89.zh: 你高举了他敌人的右手； 你叫他一切的仇敌欢喜。
89.en: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.

89.zh: 你叫他的刀剑卷刃， 叫他在争战之中站立不住。
89.en: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.

89.zh: 你使他的光辉止息， 将他的宝座推倒于地。
89.en: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.

89.zh: 你减少他青年的日子， 又使他蒙羞。 （细拉）
89.en: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.

89.zh: 耶和华啊，这要到几时呢？ 你要将自己隐藏到永远吗？ 你的忿怒如火焚烧要到几时呢？
89.en: How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?

89.zh: 求你想念我的时候是何等的短少； 你创造世人，要使他们归何等的虚空呢？
89.en: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!

89.zh: 谁能常活免死、 救他的灵魂脱离阴间的权柄呢？ （细拉）
89.en: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.

89.zh: 主啊，你从前凭你的信实 向大卫立誓要施行的慈爱在哪里呢？
89.en: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?

89.zh: 主啊，求你记念仆人们所受的羞辱， 记念我怎样将一切强盛民的[羞辱]存在我怀里。
89.en: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,

89.zh: 耶和华啊，你的仇敌用这羞辱羞辱了你的仆人， 羞辱了你受膏者的脚踪。
89.en: With which your enemies have mocked, LORD, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.

89.zh: 耶和华是应当称颂的，直到永远。 阿们！阿们！
89.en: Blessed be the LORD forever more. Amen, and Amen.

90.zh: 神人摩西的祈祷。 主啊，你世世代代作我们的居所。
90.en: A Prayer by Moses, the man of God. Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.

90.zh: 诸山未曾生出， 地与世界你未曾造成， 从亘古到永远，你是　神。
90.en: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

90.zh: 你使人归于尘土，说： 你们世人要归回。
90.en: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”

90.zh: 在你看来，千年如已过的昨日， 又如夜间的一更。
90.en: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.

90.zh: 你叫他们如水冲去； 他们如睡一觉。 早晨，他们如生长的草，
90.en: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.

90.zh: 早晨发芽生长， 晚上割下枯干。
90.en: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.

90.zh: 我们因你的怒气而消灭， 因你的忿怒而惊惶。
90.en: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.

90.zh: 你将我们的罪孽摆在你面前， 将我们的隐恶摆在你面光之中。
90.en: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

90.zh: 我们经过的日子都在你震怒之下； 我们度尽的年岁好像一声叹息。
90.en: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

90.zh: 我们一生的年日是七十岁， 若是强壮可到八十岁； 但其中所矜夸的不过是劳苦愁烦， 转眼成空，我们便如飞而去。
90.en: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.

90.zh: 谁晓得你怒气的权势？ 谁按着你该受的敬畏晓得你的忿怒呢？
90.en: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?

90.zh: 求你指教我们怎样数算自己的日子， 好叫我们得着智慧的心。
90.en: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

90.zh: 耶和华啊，我们要等到几时呢？ 求你转回，为你的仆人后悔。
90.en: Relent, LORD! How long? Have compassion on your servants!

90.zh: 求你使我们早早饱得你的慈爱， 好叫我们一生一世欢呼喜乐。
90.en: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

90.zh: 求你照着你使我们受苦的日子， 和我们遭难的年岁，叫我们喜乐。
90.en: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

90.zh: 愿你的作为向你仆人显现； 愿你的荣耀向他们子孙显明。
90.en: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.

90.zh: 愿主—我们　神的荣美归于我们身上。 愿你坚立我们手所做的工； 我们手所做的工，愿你坚立。
90.en: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.

91.zh: 住在至高者隐密处的， 必住在全能者的荫下。
91.en: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

91.zh: 我要论到耶和华说： 他是我的避难所，是我的山寨， 是我的　神，是我所倚靠的。
91.en: I will say of the LORD, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”

91.zh: 他必救你脱离捕鸟人的网罗 和毒害的瘟疫。
91.en: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.

91.zh: 他必用自己的翎毛遮蔽你； 你要投靠在他的翅膀底下； 他的诚实是大小的盾牌。
91.en: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.

91.zh: 你必不怕黑夜的惊骇， 或是白日飞的箭，
91.en: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,

91.zh: 也不怕黑夜行的瘟疫， 或是午间灭人的毒病。
91.en: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.

91.zh: 虽有千人仆倒在你旁边， 万人仆倒在你右边， 这灾却不得临近你。
91.en: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.

91.zh: 你惟亲眼观看， 见恶人遭报。
91.en: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.

91.zh: 耶和华是我的避难所； 你已将至高者当你的居所，
91.en: Because you have made the LORD your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,

91.zh: 祸患必不临到你， 灾害也不挨近你的帐棚。
91.en: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.

91.zh: 因他要为你吩咐他的使者， 在你行的一切道路上保护你。
91.en: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.

91.zh: 他们要用手托着你， 免得你的脚碰在石头上。
91.en: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.

91.zh: 你要踹在狮子和虺蛇的身上， 践踏少壮狮子和大蛇。
91.en: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.

91.zh: 神[说]：因为他专心爱我，我就要搭救他； 因为他知道我的名，我要把他安置在高处。
91.en: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.

91.zh: 他若求告我，我就应允他； 他在急难中，我要与他同在； 我要搭救他，使他尊贵。
91.en: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.

91.zh: 我要使他足享长寿， 将我的救恩显明给他。
91.en: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”

92.zh: 安息日的诗歌。 称谢耶和华！ 歌颂你至高者的名！
92.en: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD, to sing praises to your name, Most High,

92.zh: 用十弦的乐器和瑟， 用琴弹幽雅的声音， 早晨传扬你的慈爱； 每夜传扬你的信实。 这本为美事。
92.en: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,
with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.

92.zh: 因你—耶和华借着你的作为叫我高兴， 我要因你手的工作欢呼。
92.en: For you, LORD, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.

92.zh: 耶和华啊，你的工作何其大！ 你的心思极其深！
92.en: How great are your works, LORD! Your thoughts are very deep.

92.zh: 畜类人不晓得； 愚顽人也不明白。
92.en: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:

92.zh: 恶人茂盛如草， 一切作孽之人发旺的时候， 正是他们要灭亡， 直到永远。
92.en: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.

92.zh: 惟你—耶和华是至高， 直到永远。
92.en: But you, LORD, are on high forever more.

92.zh: 耶和华啊，你的仇敌都要灭亡； 一切作孽的也要离散。
92.en: For behold, your enemies, LORD, for behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.

92.zh: 你却高举了我的角，如野牛的角； 我是被新油膏了的。
92.en: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.

92.zh: 我眼睛看见仇敌[遭报]； 我耳朵听见那些起来攻击我的恶人[受罚]。
92.en: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.

92.zh: 义人要发旺如棕树， 生长如黎巴嫩的香柏树。
92.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

92.zh: 他们栽于耶和华的殿中， 发旺在我们　神的院里。
92.en: They are planted in the LORD’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.

92.zh: 他们年老的时候仍要结果子， 要满了汁浆而常发青，
92.en: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,

92.zh: 好显明耶和华是正直的。 他是我的磐石，在他毫无不义。
92.en: to show that the LORD is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

93.zh: 耶和华作王！ 他以威严为衣穿上； 耶和华以能力为衣，以能力束腰， 世界就坚定，不得动摇。
93.en: The LORD reigns! He is clothed with majesty! The LORD is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.

93.zh: 你的宝座从太初立定； 你从亘古就有。
93.en: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.

93.zh: 耶和华啊，大水扬起， 大水发声，波浪澎湃。
93.en: The floods have lifted up, LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.

93.zh: 耶和华在高处大有能力， 胜过诸水的响声，洋海的大浪。
93.en: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, the LORD on high is mighty.

93.zh: 耶和华啊，你的法度最的确； 你的殿永称为圣，是合宜的。
93.en: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, LORD, forever more.

94.zh: 耶和华啊，你是伸冤的　神； 伸冤的　神啊，求你发出光来！
94.en: LORD, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.

94.zh: 审判世界的主啊，求你挺身而立， 使骄傲人受应得的报应！
94.en: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.

94.zh: 耶和华啊，恶人夸胜要到几时呢？ 要到几时呢？
94.en: LORD, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?

94.zh: 他们絮絮叨叨说傲慢的话； 一切作孽的人都自己夸张。
94.en: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.

94.zh: 耶和华啊，他们强压你的百姓， 苦害你的产业。
94.en: They break your people in pieces, LORD, and afflict your heritage.

94.zh: 他们杀死寡妇和寄居的， 又杀害孤儿。
94.en: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.

94.zh: 他们说：耶和华必不看见； 雅各的　神必不思念。
94.en: They say, “The LORD will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”

94.zh: 你们民间的畜类人当思想； 你们愚顽人到几时才有智慧呢？
94.en: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?

94.zh: 造耳朵的，难道自己不听见吗？ 造眼睛的，难道自己不看见吗？
94.en: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?

94.zh: 管教列邦的，就是叫人得知识的， 难道自己不惩治人吗？
94.en: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.

94.zh: 耶和华知道人的意念是虚妄的。
94.en: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

94.zh: 耶和华啊，你所管教、 用律法所教训的人是有福的！
94.en: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, LORD, and teach out of your law,

94.zh: 你使他在遭难的日子得享平安； 惟有恶人陷在所挖的坑中。
94.en: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.

94.zh: 因为耶和华必不丢弃他的百姓， 也不离弃他的产业。
94.en: For the LORD won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

94.zh: 审判要转向公义； 心里正直的，必都随从。
94.en: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.

94.zh: 谁肯为我起来攻击作恶的？ 谁肯为我站起抵挡作孽的？
94.en: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?

94.zh: 若不是耶和华帮助我， 我就住在寂静之中了。
94.en: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.

94.zh: 我正说我失了脚， 耶和华啊，那时你的慈爱扶助我。
94.en: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, LORD, held me up.

94.zh: 我心里多忧多疑， 你安慰我，就使我欢乐。
94.en: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

94.zh: 那借着律例架弄残害、 在位上行奸恶的，岂能与你相交吗？
94.en: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?

94.zh: 他们大家聚集攻击义人， 将无辜的人定为死罪。
94.en: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

94.zh: 但耶和华向来作了我的高台； 我的　神作了我投靠的磐石。
94.en: But the LORD has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.

94.zh: 他叫他们的罪孽归到他们身上。 他们正在行恶之中，他要剪除他们； 耶和华—我们的　神要把他们剪除。
94.en: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. The LORD, our God, will cut them off.

95.zh: 来啊，我们要向耶和华歌唱， 向拯救我们的磐石欢呼！
95.en: Oh come, let’s sing to the LORD. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!

95.zh: 我们要来感谢他， 用诗歌向他欢呼！
95.en: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!

95.zh: 因耶和华为大　神， 为大王，超乎万神之上。
95.en: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.

95.zh: 地的深处在他手中； 山的高峰也属他。
95.en: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.

95.zh: 海洋属他，是他造的； 旱地也是他手造成的。
95.en: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.

95.zh: 来啊，我们要屈身敬拜， 在造我们的耶和华面前跪下。
95.en: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before the LORD, our Maker,

95.zh: 因为他是我们的　神； 我们是他草场的羊，是他手下的民。 惟愿你们今天听他的话：
95.en: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!

95.zh: 你们不可硬着心，像当日在米利巴， 就是在旷野的玛撒。
95.en: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,

95.zh: 那时，你们的祖宗试我探我， 并且观看我的作为。
95.en: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.

95.zh: 四十年之久，我厌烦那世代，说： 这是心里迷糊的百姓， 竟不晓得我的作为！
95.en: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “They are a people who err in their heart. They have not known my ways.”

95.zh: 所以，我在怒中起誓，说： 他们断不可进入我的安息！
95.en: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”

96.zh: 你们要向耶和华唱新歌！ 全地都要向耶和华歌唱！
96.en: Sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.

96.zh: 要向耶和华歌唱，称颂他的名！ 天天传扬他的救恩！
96.en: Sing to the LORD! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!

96.zh: 在列邦中述说他的荣耀！ 在万民中述说他的奇事！
96.en: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.

96.zh: 因耶和华为大，当受极大的赞美； 他在万神之上，当受敬畏。
96.en: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.

96.zh: 外邦的神都属虚无； 惟独耶和华创造诸天。
96.en: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.

96.zh: 有尊荣和威严在他面前； 有能力与华美在他圣所。
96.en: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

96.zh: 民中的万族啊，你们要将荣耀、能力归给耶和华， 都归给耶和华！
96.en: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

96.zh: 要将耶和华的名所当得的荣耀归给他， 拿供物来进入他的院宇。
96.en: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.

96.zh: 当以圣洁的妆饰敬拜耶和华； 全地要在他面前战抖！
96.en: Worship the LORD in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.

96.zh: 人在列邦中要说：耶和华作王！ 世界就坚定，不得动摇； 他要按公正审判众民。
96.en: Say among the nations, “The LORD reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.

96.zh: 愿天欢喜，愿地快乐！ 愿海和其中所充满的澎湃！
96.en: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!

96.zh: 愿田和其中所有的都欢乐！ 那时，林中的树木都要在耶和华面前欢呼。
96.en: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy

96.zh: 因为他来了，他来要审判全地。 他要按公义审判世界， 按他的信实审判万民。
96.en: before the LORD; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.

97.zh: 耶和华作王！愿地快乐！ 愿众海岛欢喜！
97.en: The LORD reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!

97.zh: 密云和幽暗在他的四围； 公义和公平是他宝座的根基。
97.en: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

97.zh: 有烈火在他前头行， 烧灭他四围的敌人。
97.en: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.

97.zh: 他的闪电光照世界， 大地看见便震动。
97.en: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.

97.zh: 诸山见耶和华的面， 就是全地之主的面，便消化如蜡。
97.en: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

97.zh: 诸天表明他的公义； 万民看见他的荣耀。
97.en: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.

97.zh: 愿一切事奉雕刻的偶像、 靠虚无[之神]自夸的，都蒙羞愧。 万神哪，你们都当拜他。
97.en: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!

97.zh: 耶和华啊，锡安听见你的判断就欢喜； 犹大的城邑也都快乐。
97.en: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, LORD.

97.zh: 因为你—耶和华至高，超乎全地； 你被尊崇，远超万神之上。
97.en: For you, LORD, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.

97.zh: 你们爱耶和华的，都当恨恶罪恶； 他保护圣民的性命， 搭救他们脱离恶人的手。
97.en: You who love the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

97.zh: 散布亮光是为义人； 预备喜乐是为正直人。
97.en: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

97.zh: 你们义人当靠耶和华欢喜， 称谢他可记念的圣[名]。
97.en: Be glad in the LORD, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.

98.zh: 一篇诗。 你们要向耶和华唱新歌！ 因为他行过奇妙的事； 他的右手和圣臂施行救恩。
98.en: A Psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.

98.zh: 耶和华发明了他的救恩， 在列邦人眼前显出公义；
98.en: The LORD has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.

98.zh: 记念他向以色列家所发的慈爱，所凭的信实。 地的四极都看见我们　神的救恩。
98.en: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

98.zh: 全地都要向耶和华欢乐； 要发起大声，欢呼歌颂！
98.en: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!

98.zh: 要用琴歌颂耶和华， 用琴和诗歌的声音歌颂他！
98.en: Sing praises to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.

98.zh: 用号和角声， 在大君王耶和华面前欢呼！
98.en: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, the LORD.

98.zh: 愿海和其中所充满的澎湃； 世界和住在其间的也要发声。
98.en: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.

98.zh: 愿大水拍手； 愿诸山在耶和华面前一同欢呼；
98.en: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.

98.zh: 因为他来要审判遍地。 他要按公义审判世界， 按公正审判万民。
98.en: Let them sing before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.

99.zh: 耶和华作王；万民当战抖！ 他坐在二基路伯上，地当动摇。
99.en: The LORD reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.

99.zh: 耶和华在锡安为大； 他超乎万民之上。
99.en: The LORD is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.

99.zh: 他们当称赞他大而可畏的名； 他本为圣！
99.en: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!

99.zh: 王有能力，喜爱公平，坚立公正， 在雅各中施行公平和公义。
99.en: The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.

99.zh: 你们当尊崇耶和华—我们的　神， 在他脚凳前下拜。 他本为圣！
99.en: Exalt the LORD our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!

99.zh: 在他的祭司中有摩西和亚伦； 在求告他名的人中有撒母耳。 他们求告耶和华，他就应允他们。
99.en: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on the LORD, and he answered them.

99.zh: 他在云柱中对他们说话； 他们遵守他的法度和他所赐给他们的律例。
99.en: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.

99.zh: 耶和华—我们的　神啊，你应允他们； 你是赦免他们的　神， 却按他们所行的报应他们。
99.en: You answered them, LORD our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.

99.zh: 你们要尊崇耶和华—我们的　神， 在他的圣山下拜， 因为耶和华—我们的　神本为圣！
99.en: Exalt the LORD, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for the LORD, our God, is holy!

100.zh: 称谢诗。 普天下当向耶和华欢呼！
100.en: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout for joy to the LORD, all you lands!

100.zh: 你们当乐意事奉耶和华， 当来向他歌唱！
100.en: Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

100.zh: 你们当晓得耶和华是　神！ 我们是他造的，也是属他的； 我们是他的民，也是他草场的羊。
100.en: Know that the LORD, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

100.zh: 当称谢进入他的门； 当赞美进入他的院。 当感谢他，称颂他的名！
100.en: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

100.zh: 因为耶和华本为善。 他的慈爱存到永远； 他的信实直到万代。
100.en: For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.

101.zh: 大卫的诗。 我要歌唱慈爱和公平； 耶和华啊，我要向你歌颂！
101.en: A Psalm by David. I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, LORD, I will sing praises.

101.zh: 我要用智慧行完全的道。 你几时到我这里来呢？ 我要存完全的心行在我家中。
101.en: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.

101.zh: 邪僻的事，我都不摆在我眼前； 悖逆人所做的事，我甚恨恶， 不容沾在我身上。
101.en: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.

101.zh: 弯曲的心思，我必远离； 一切的恶人，我不认识。
101.en: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.

101.zh: 在暗中谗谤他邻居的，我必将他灭绝； 眼目高傲、心里骄纵的，我必不容他。
101.en: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.

101.zh: 我眼要看国中的诚实人，叫他们与我同住； 行为完全的，他要伺候我。
101.en: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.

101.zh: 行诡诈的，必不得住在我家里； 说谎话的，必不得立在我眼前。
101.en: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.

101.zh: 我每日早晨要灭绝国中所有的恶人， 好把一切作孽的从耶和华的城里剪除。
101.en: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the LORD’s city.

102.zh: 困苦人发昏的时候，在耶和华面前吐露苦情的祷告。 耶和华啊，求你听我的祷告， 容我的呼求达到你面前！
102.en: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before the LORD. Hear my prayer, LORD! Let my cry come to you.

102.zh: 我在急难的日子，求你向我侧耳； 不要向我掩面！ 我呼求的日子，求你快快应允我！
102.en: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.

102.zh: 因为，我的年日如烟云消灭； 我的骨头如火把烧着。
102.en: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.

102.zh: 我的心被伤，如草枯干， 甚至我忘记吃饭。
102.en: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.

102.zh: 因我唉哼的声音， 我的肉紧贴骨头。
102.en: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.

102.zh: 我如同旷野的鹈鹕； 我好像荒场的鸮鸟。
102.en: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.

102.zh: 我警醒不睡； 我像房顶上孤单的麻雀。
102.en: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.

102.zh: 我的仇敌终日辱骂我； 向我猖狂的人指着我赌咒。
102.en: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.

102.zh: 我吃过炉灰，如同吃饭； 我所喝的与眼泪搀杂。
102.en: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,

102.zh: 这都因你的恼恨和忿怒； 你把我拾起来，又把我摔下去。
102.en: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.

102.zh: 我的年日如日影偏斜； 我也如草枯干。
102.en: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.

102.zh: 惟你—耶和华必存到永远； 你可记念的[名]也存到万代。
102.en: But you, LORD, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.

102.zh: 你必起来怜恤锡安， 因现在是可怜她的时候， 日期已经到了。
102.en: You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.

102.zh: 你的仆人原来喜悦她的石头， 可怜她的尘土。
102.en: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.

102.zh: 列国要敬畏耶和华的名； 世上诸王都敬畏你的荣耀。
102.en: So the nations will fear the LORD’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.

102.zh: 因为耶和华建造了锡安， 在他荣耀里显现。
102.en: For the LORD has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.

102.zh: 他垂听穷人的祷告， 并不藐视他们的祈求。
102.en: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.

102.zh: 这必为后代的人记下， 将来受造的民要赞美耶和华。
102.en: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise the LORD,

102.zh: 因为，他从至高的圣所垂看； 耶和华从天向地观察，
102.en: for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, the LORD saw the earth,

102.zh: 要垂听被囚之人的叹息， 要释放将要死的人，
102.en: to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,

102.zh: 使人在锡安传扬耶和华的名， 在耶路撒冷传扬赞美他的话，
102.en: that men may declare the LORD’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,

102.zh: 就是在万民和列国 聚会事奉耶和华的时候。
102.en: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.

102.zh: 他使我的力量中道衰弱， 使我的年日短少。
102.en: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.

102.zh: 我说：我的　神啊， 不要使我中年去世。 你的年数世世无穷！
102.en: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.

102.zh: 你起初立了地的根基； 天也是你手所造的。
102.en: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.

102.zh: 天地都要灭没，你却要长存； 天地都要如外衣渐渐旧了。 你要将天地如里衣更换， 天地就都改变了。
102.en: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.

102.zh: 惟有你永不改变； 你的年数没有穷尽。
102.en: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.

102.zh: 你仆人的子孙要长存； 他们的后裔要坚立在你面前。
102.en: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”

103.zh: 大卫的诗。 我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！ 凡在我里面的，也要称颂他的圣名！
103.en: By David. Praise the LORD, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!

103.zh: 我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！ 不可忘记他的一切恩惠！
103.en: Praise the LORD, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,

103.zh: 他赦免你的一切罪孽， 医治你的一切疾病。
103.en: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,

103.zh: 他救赎你的命脱离死亡， 以仁爱和慈悲为你的冠冕。
103.en: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,

103.zh: 他用美物使你所愿的得以知足， 以致你如鹰返老还童。
103.en: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

103.zh: 耶和华施行公义， 为一切受屈的人伸冤。
103.en: The LORD executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.

103.zh: 他使摩西知道他的法则， 叫以色列人晓得他的作为。
103.en: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.

103.zh: 耶和华有怜悯，有恩典， 不轻易发怒，且有丰盛的慈爱。
103.en: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.

103.zh: 他不长久责备， 也不永远怀[怒]。
103.en: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.

103.zh: 他没有按我们的罪过待我们， 也没有照我们的罪孽报应我们。
103.en: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.

103.zh: 天离地何等的高， 他的慈爱向敬畏他的人也是何等的大！
103.en: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.

103.zh: 东离西有多远， 他叫我们的过犯离我们也有多远！
103.en: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

103.zh: 父亲怎样怜恤他的儿女， 耶和华也怎样怜恤敬畏他的人！
103.en: Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.

103.zh: 因为他知道我们的本体， 思念我们不过是尘土。
103.en: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.

103.zh: 至于世人，他的年日如草一样。 他发旺如野地的花，
103.en: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

103.zh: 经风一吹，便归无有； 它的原处也不再认识它。
103.en: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.

103.zh: 但耶和华的慈爱归于敬畏他的人， 从亘古到永远； 他的公义也归于子子孙孙—
103.en: But the LORD’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,

103.zh: 就是那些遵守他的约、 记念他的训词而遵行的人。
103.en: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.

103.zh: 耶和华在天上立定宝座； 他的权柄统管万有。
103.en: The LORD has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.

103.zh: 听从他命令、成全他旨意、 有大能的天使，都要称颂耶和华！
103.en: Praise the LORD, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.

103.zh: 你们作他的诸军，作他的仆役， 行他所喜悦的，都要称颂耶和华！
103.en: Praise the LORD, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.

103.zh: 你们一切被他造的， 在他所治理的各处， 都要称颂耶和华！ 我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！
103.en: Praise the LORD, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise the LORD, my soul!

104.zh: 我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！ 耶和华—我的　神啊，你为至大！ 你以尊荣威严为衣服，
104.en: Bless the LORD, my soul. The LORD, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.

104.zh: 披上亮光，如披外袍， 铺张穹苍，如铺幔子，
104.en: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.

104.zh: 在水中立楼阁的栋梁， 用云彩为车辇， 借着风的翅膀而行，
104.en: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.

104.zh: 以风为使者， 以火焰为仆役，
104.en: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.

104.zh: 将地立在根基上， 使地永不动摇。
104.en: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.

104.zh: 你用深水遮盖地面，犹如衣裳； 诸水高过山岭。
104.en: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.

104.zh: 你的斥责一发，水便奔逃； 你的雷声一发，水便奔流。
104.en: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.

104.zh: 诸山升上，诸谷沉下， 归你为它所安定之地。
104.en: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.

104.zh: 你定了界限，使水不能过去， 不再转回遮盖地面。
104.en: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.

104.zh: 耶和华使泉源涌在山谷， 流在山间，
104.en: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.

104.zh: 使野地的走兽有水喝， 野驴得解其渴。
104.en: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.

104.zh: 天上的飞鸟在水旁住宿， 在树枝上啼叫。
104.en: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.

104.zh: 他从楼阁中浇灌山岭； 因他作为的功效，地就丰足。
104.en: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.

104.zh: 他使草生长，给六畜吃， 使菜蔬发长，供给人用， 使人从地里能得食物，
104.en: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:

104.zh: 又得酒能悦人心， 得油能润人面， 得粮能养人心。
104.en: wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.

104.zh: 佳美的树木，就是黎巴嫩的香柏树， 是耶和华所栽种的，都满了[汁浆]。
104.en: The LORD’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted,

104.zh: 雀鸟在其上搭窝； 至于鹤，松树是它的房屋。
104.en: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.

104.zh: 高山为野山羊[的住所]； 岩石为沙番的藏处。
104.en: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.

104.zh: 你安置月亮为定节令； 日头自知沉落。
104.en: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.

104.zh: 你造黑暗为夜， 林中的百兽就都爬出来。
104.en: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.

104.zh: 少壮狮子吼叫，要抓食， 向　神寻求食物。
104.en: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.

104.zh: 日头一出，兽便躲避， 卧在洞里。
104.en: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.

104.zh: 人出去做工， 劳碌直到晚上。
104.en: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.

104.zh: 耶和华啊，你所造的何其多！ 都是你用智慧造成的； 遍地满了你的丰富。
104.en: LORD, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.

104.zh: 那里有海，又大又广； 其中有无数的动物， 大小活物都有。
104.en: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.

104.zh: 那里有船行走， 有你所造的鳄鱼游泳在其中。
104.en: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.

104.zh: 这都仰望你按时给它食物。
104.en: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.

104.zh: 你给它们，它们便拾起来； 你张手，它们饱得美食。
104.en: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.

104.zh: 你掩面，它们便惊惶； 你收回它们的气，它们就死亡，归于尘土。
104.en: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.

104.zh: 你发出你的灵，它们便受造； 你使地面更换为新。
104.en: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.

104.zh: 愿耶和华的荣耀存到永远！ 愿耶和华喜悦自己所造的！
104.en: Let the LORD’s glory endure forever. Let the LORD rejoice in his works.

104.zh: 他看地，地便震动； 他摸山，山就冒烟。
104.en: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

104.zh: 我要一生向耶和华唱诗！ 我还活的时候，要向我　神歌颂！
104.en: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

104.zh: 愿他以我的默念为甘甜！ 我要因耶和华欢喜！
104.en: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in the LORD.

104.zh: 愿罪人从世上消灭！ 愿恶人归于无有！ 我的心哪，要称颂耶和华！ 你们要赞美耶和华！
104.en: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, my soul. Praise the LORD!

105.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，求告他的名， 在万民中传扬他的作为！
105.en: Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.

105.zh: 要向他唱诗歌颂， 谈论他一切奇妙的作为！
105.en: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.

105.zh: 要以他的圣名夸耀！ 寻求耶和华的人，心中应当欢喜！
105.en: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

105.zh: 要寻求耶和华与他的能力， 时常寻求他的面。
105.en: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

105.zh: 他仆人亚伯拉罕的后裔， 他所拣选雅各的子孙哪， 你们要记念他奇妙的作为和他的奇事， 并他口中的判语。
105.en: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

105.zh: 他是耶和华—我们的　神； 全地都有他的判断。
105.en: He is the LORD, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

105.zh: 他记念他的约，直到永远； 他所吩咐的话，直到千代—
105.en: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

105.zh: 就是与亚伯拉罕所立的[约]， 向以撒所起的誓。
105.en: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,

105.zh: 他又将这约向雅各定为律例， 向以色列定为永远的约，
105.en: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

105.zh: 说：我必将迦南地赐给你， 作你产业的分。
105.en: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”

105.zh: 当时，他们人丁有限，数目稀少， 并且在那地为寄居的。
105.en: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

105.zh: 他们从这邦游到那邦， 从这国行到那国。
105.en: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

105.zh: 他不容什么人欺负他们， 为他们的缘故责备君王，
105.en: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

105.zh: 说：不可难为我受膏的人， 也不可恶待我的先知。
105.en: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

105.zh: 他命饥荒降在那地上， 将所倚靠的粮食全行断绝，
105.en: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.

105.zh: 在他们以先打发一个人去 —约瑟被卖为奴仆。
105.en: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.

105.zh: 人用脚镣伤他的脚； 他被铁[链]捆拘。
105.en: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,

105.zh: 耶和华的话试炼他， 直等到他所说的应验了。
105.en: until the time that his word happened, and the LORD’s word proved him true.

105.zh: 王打发人把他解开， 就是治理众民的，把他释放，
105.en: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

105.zh: 立他作王家之主， 掌管他一切所有的，
105.en: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,

105.zh: 使他随意捆绑他的臣宰， 将智慧教导他的长老。
105.en: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.

105.zh: 以色列也到了埃及； 雅各在含地寄居。
105.en: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.

105.zh: 耶和华使他的百姓生养众多， 使他们比敌人强盛，
105.en: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.

105.zh: 使敌人的心转去恨他的百姓， 并用诡计待他的仆人。
105.en: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

105.zh: 他打发他的仆人摩西 和他所拣选的亚伦，
105.en: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

105.zh: 在敌人中间显他的神迹， 在含地显他的奇事。
105.en: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

105.zh: 他命黑暗，就有黑暗； 没有违背他话的。
105.en: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.

105.zh: 他叫埃及的水变为血， 叫他们的鱼死了。
105.en: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.

105.zh: 在他们的地上以及王宫的内室， 青蛙多多滋生。
105.en: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.

105.zh: 他说一声，苍蝇就成群而来， 并有虱子进入他们四境。
105.en: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.

105.zh: 他给他们降下冰雹为雨， 在他们的地上降下火焰。
105.en: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.

105.zh: 他也击打他们的葡萄树和无花果树， 毁坏他们境内的树木。
105.en: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.

105.zh: 他说一声，就有蝗虫蚂蚱上来， 不计其数，
105.en: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.

105.zh: 吃尽了他们地上各样的菜蔬 和田地的出产。
105.en: They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.

105.zh: 他又击杀他们国内一切的长子， 就是他们强壮时头生的。
105.en: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.

105.zh: 他领自己的百姓带银子金子出来； 他支派中没有一个软弱的。
105.en: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.

105.zh: 他们出来的时候，埃及人便欢喜； 原来埃及人惧怕他们。
105.en: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.

105.zh: 他铺张云彩当遮盖， 夜间使火光照。
105.en: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.

105.zh: 他们一求，他就使鹌鹑飞来， 并用天上的粮食叫他们饱足。
105.en: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.

105.zh: 他打开磐石，水就涌出； 在干旱之处，水流成河。
105.en: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.

105.zh: 这都因他记念他的圣言 和他的仆人亚伯拉罕。
105.en: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.

105.zh: 他带领百姓欢乐而出， 带领选民欢呼前往。
105.en: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.

105.zh: 他将列国的地赐给他们， 他们便承受众民劳碌得来的，
105.en: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,

105.zh: 好使他们遵他的律例， 守他的律法。 你们要赞美耶和华！
105.en: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise the LORD!

106.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 要称谢耶和华，因他本为善； 他的慈爱永远长存！
106.en: Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

106.zh: 谁能传说耶和华的大能？ 谁能表明他一切的美德？
106.en: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD, or fully declare all his praise?

106.zh: 凡遵守公平、常行公义的， 这人便为有福！
106.en: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.

106.zh: 耶和华啊，你用恩惠待你的百姓； 求你也用这恩惠记念我，开你的救恩眷顾我，
106.en: Remember me, LORD, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,

106.zh: 使我见你选民的福， 乐你国民的乐， 与你的产业一同夸耀。
106.en: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.

106.zh: 我们与我们的祖宗一同犯罪； 我们作了孽，行了恶。
106.en: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.

106.zh: 我们的祖宗在埃及不明白你的奇事， 不记念你丰盛的慈爱， 反倒在红海行了悖逆。
106.en: Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

106.zh: 然而，他因自己的名拯救他们， 为要彰显他的大能，
106.en: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.

106.zh: 并且斥责红海，海便干了； 他带领他们经过深处，如同经过旷野。
106.en: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.

106.zh: 他拯救他们脱离恨他们人的手， 从仇敌手中救赎他们。
106.en: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

106.zh: 水淹没他们的敌人， 没有一个存留。
106.en: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.

106.zh: 那时，他们才信了他的话， 歌唱赞美他。
106.en: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.

106.zh: 等不多时，他们就忘了他的作为， 不仰望他的指教，
106.en: They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,

106.zh: 反倒在旷野大起欲心， 在荒地试探　神。
106.en: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.

106.zh: 他将他们所求的赐给他们， 却使他们的心灵软弱。
106.en: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.

106.zh: 他们又在营中嫉妒摩西 和耶和华的圣者亚伦。
106.en: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, the LORD’s saint.

106.zh: 地裂开，吞下大坍， 掩盖亚比兰一党的人。
106.en: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

106.zh: 有火在他们的党中发起； 有火焰烧毁了恶人。
106.en: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.

106.zh: 他们在何烈山造了牛犊， 叩拜铸成的像。
106.en: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.

106.zh: 如此将他们荣耀[的主] 换为吃草之牛的像，
106.en: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.

106.zh: 忘了　神—他们的救主； 他曾在埃及行大事，
106.en: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,

106.zh: 在含地行奇事， 在红海行可畏的事。
106.en: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.

106.zh: 所以，他说要灭绝他们； 若非有他所拣选的摩西站在当中， 使他的忿怒转消， 恐怕他就灭绝他们。
106.en: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them.

106.zh: 他们又藐视那美地， 不信他的话，
106.en: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,

106.zh: 在自己帐棚内发怨言， 不听耶和华的声音。
106.en: but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to the LORD’s voice.

106.zh: 所以，他对他们起誓： 必叫他们倒在旷野，
106.en: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,

106.zh: 叫他们的后裔倒在列国之中， 分散在各地。
106.en: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.

106.zh: 他们又与巴力·毗珥连合， 且吃了祭死神的物。
106.en: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

106.zh: 他们这样行，惹耶和华发怒， 便有瘟疫流行在他们中间。
106.en: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.

106.zh: 那时，非尼哈站起，刑罚恶人， 瘟疫这才止息。
106.en: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.

106.zh: 那就算为他的义， 世世代代，直到永远。
106.en: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.

106.zh: 他们在米利巴水又叫耶和华发怒， 甚至摩西也受了亏损，
106.en: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;

106.zh: 是因他们惹动他的灵， 摩西用嘴说了急躁的话。
106.en: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.

106.zh: 他们不照耶和华所吩咐的 灭绝外邦人，
106.en: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as the LORD commanded them,

106.zh: 反与他们混杂相合， 学习他们的行为，
106.en: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.

106.zh: 事奉他们的偶像， 这就成了自己的网罗，
106.en: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.

106.zh: 把自己的儿女祭祀鬼魔，
106.en: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

106.zh: 流无辜人的血， 就是自己儿女的血， 把他们祭祀迦南的偶像， 那地就被血污秽了。
106.en: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.

106.zh: 这样，他们被自己所做的污秽了， 在行为上犯了邪淫。
