106.en: Thus they were defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.

106.zh: 所以，耶和华的怒气向他的百姓发作， 憎恶他的产业，
106.en: Therefore the LORD burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.

106.zh: 将他们交在外邦人的手里； 恨他们的人就辖制他们。
106.en: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.

106.zh: 他们的仇敌也欺压他们， 他们就伏在敌人手下。
106.en: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.

106.zh: 他屡次搭救他们， 他们却设谋背逆， 因自己的罪孽降为卑下。
106.en: He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.

106.zh: 然而，他听见他们哀告的时候， 就眷顾他们的急难，
106.en: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.

106.zh: 为他们记念他的约， 照他丰盛的慈爱后悔。
106.en: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

106.zh: 他也使他们在凡掳掠他们的人面前蒙怜恤。
106.en: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.

106.zh: 耶和华—我们的　神啊，求你拯救我们， 从外邦中招聚我们， 我们好称赞你的圣名， 以赞美你为夸胜。
106.en: Save us, LORD, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!

106.zh: 耶和华—以色列的　神是应当称颂的， 从亘古直到永远。 愿众民都说：阿们！ 你们要赞美耶和华！
106.en: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise the LORD!

107.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善； 他的慈爱永远长存！
107.en: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

107.zh: 愿耶和华的赎民说这话， 就是他从敌人手中所救赎的，
107.en: Let the redeemed by the LORD say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

107.zh: 从各地，从东从西， 从南从北，所招聚来的。
107.en: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

107.zh: 他们在旷野荒地漂流， 寻不见可住的城邑，
107.en: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.

107.zh: 又饥又渴， 心里发昏。
107.en: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

107.zh: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华； 他从他们的祸患中搭救他们，
107.en: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

107.zh: 又领他们行走直路， 使他们往可居住的城邑。
107.en: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.

107.zh: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱 和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他；
107.en: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

107.zh: 因他使心里渴慕的人得以知足， 使心里饥饿的人得饱美物。
107.en: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.

107.zh: 那些坐在黑暗中、死荫里的人 被困苦和铁[链]捆锁，
107.en: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,

107.zh: 是因他们违背　神的话语， 藐视至高者的旨意。
107.en: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.

107.zh: 所以，他用劳苦治服他们的心； 他们仆倒，无人扶助。
107.en: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.

107.zh: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华； 他从他们的祸患中拯救他们。
107.en: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

107.zh: 他从黑暗中和死荫里领他们出来， 折断他们的绑索。
107.en: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.

107.zh: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱 和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他；
107.en: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

107.zh: 因为他打破了铜门， 砍断了铁闩。
107.en: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.

107.zh: 愚妄人因自己的过犯 和自己的罪孽便受苦楚。
107.en: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.

107.zh: 他们心里厌恶各样的食物， 就临近死门。
107.en: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.

107.zh: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华； 他从他们的祸患中拯救他们。
107.en: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.

107.zh: 他发命医治他们， 救他们脱离死亡。
107.en: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.

107.zh: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱 和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他。
107.en: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

107.zh: 愿他们以感谢为祭献给他， 欢呼述说他的作为！
107.en: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.

107.zh: 在海上坐船， 在大水中经理事务的，
107.en: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,

107.zh: 他们看见耶和华的作为， 并他在深水中的奇事。
107.en: these see the LORD’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.

107.zh: 因他一吩咐，狂风就起来， 海中的波浪也扬起。
107.en: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.

107.zh: 他们上到天空，下到海底； 他们的心因患难便消化。
107.en: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.

107.zh: 他们摇摇晃晃，东倒西歪，好像醉酒的人； 他们的智慧无法可施。
107.en: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.

107.zh: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华， 他从他们的祸患中领出他们来。
107.en: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.

107.zh: 他使狂风止息， 波浪就平静。
107.en: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

107.zh: 风息浪静，他们便欢喜； 他就引他们到所愿去的海口。
107.en: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.

107.zh: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱 和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他。
107.en: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!

107.zh: 愿他们在民的会中尊崇他， 在长老的位上赞美他！
107.en: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.

107.zh: 他使江河变为旷野， 叫水泉变为干渴之地，
107.en: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,

107.zh: 使肥地变为硷地； 这都因其间居民的罪恶。
107.en: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

107.zh: 他使旷野变为水潭， 叫旱地变为水泉。
107.en: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.

107.zh: 他使饥饿的人住在那里， 好建造可住的城邑，
107.en: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,

107.zh: 又种田地，栽葡萄园， 得享所出的土产。
107.en: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.

107.zh: 他又赐福给他们，叫他们生养众多， 也不叫他们的牲畜减少。
107.en: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.

107.zh: 他们又因暴虐、患难、愁苦， 就减少且卑下。
107.en: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

107.zh: 他使君王蒙羞被辱， 使他们在荒废无路之地漂流。
107.en: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.

107.zh: 他却将穷乏人安置在高处，脱离苦难， 使他的家属多如羊群。
107.en: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.

107.zh: 正直人看见就欢喜； 罪孽之辈必塞口无言。
107.en: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.

107.zh: 凡有智慧的，必在这些事上留心， 也必思想耶和华的慈爱。
107.en: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of the LORD.

108.zh: 大卫的诗歌。 　神啊，我心坚定； 我口要唱诗歌颂！
108.en: A Song. A Psalm by David. My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.

108.zh: 琴瑟啊，你们当醒起！ 我自己要极早醒起！
108.en: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.

108.zh: 耶和华啊，我要在万民中称谢你， 在列邦中歌颂你！
108.en: I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.

108.zh: 因为，你的慈爱大过诸天； 你的诚实达到穹苍。
108.en: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

108.zh: 神啊，愿你崇高过于诸天！ 愿你的荣耀高过全地！
108.en: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.

108.zh: 求你应允我们，用右手拯救我们， 好叫你所亲爱的人得救。
108.en: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

108.zh: 神已经指着他的圣洁说： 我要欢乐；我要分开示剑， 丈量疏割谷。
108.en: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

108.zh: 基列是我的； 玛拿西是我的； 以法莲是护卫我头的； 犹大是我的杖；
108.en: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.

108.zh: 摩押是我的沐浴盆； 我要向以东抛鞋； 我必因胜非利士呼喊。
108.en: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”

108.zh: 谁能领我进坚固城？ 谁能引我到以东地？
108.en: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

108.zh: 神啊，你不是丢弃了我们吗？ 　神啊，你不和我们的军兵同去吗？
108.en: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.

108.zh: 求你帮助我们攻击敌人， 因为人的帮助是枉然的。
108.en: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.

108.zh: 我们倚靠　神才得施展大能， 因为践踏我们敌人的就是他。
108.en: Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.

109.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。 我所赞美的　神啊， 求你不要闭口不言。
109.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. God of my praise, don’t remain silent,

109.zh: 因为恶人的嘴和诡诈人的口已经张开攻击我； 他们用撒谎的舌头对我说话。
109.en: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.

109.zh: 他们围绕我，说怨恨的话， 又无故地攻打我。
109.en: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.

109.zh: 他们与我为敌以报我爱， 但我[专心]祈祷。
109.en: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.

109.zh: 他们向我以恶报善， 以恨报爱。
109.en: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

109.zh: 愿你派一个恶人辖制他， 派一个对头站在他右边！
109.en: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.

109.zh: 他受审判的时候， 愿他出来担当罪名！ 愿他的祈祷反成为罪！
109.en: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.

109.zh: 愿他的年日短少！ 愿别人得他的职分！
109.en: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.

109.zh: 愿他的儿女为孤儿， 他的妻子为寡妇！
109.en: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

109.zh: 愿他的儿女漂流讨饭， 从他们荒凉之处出来求[食]！
109.en: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.

109.zh: 愿强暴的债主牢笼他一切所有的！ 愿外人抢他劳碌得来的！
109.en: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.

109.zh: 愿无人向他延绵施恩！ 愿无人可怜他的孤儿！
109.en: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.

109.zh: 愿他的后人断绝， 名字被涂抹，不传于下代！
109.en: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

109.zh: 愿他祖宗的罪孽被耶和华记念！ 愿他母亲的罪过不被涂抹！
109.en: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the LORD. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.

109.zh: 愿这些罪常在耶和华面前， 使他的名号断绝于世！
109.en: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;

109.zh: 因为他不想施恩， 却逼迫困苦穷乏的和伤心的人， 要把他们治死。
109.en: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.

109.zh: 他爱咒骂，咒骂就临到他； 他不喜爱福乐，福乐就与他远离！
109.en: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.

109.zh: 他拿咒骂当衣服穿上； 这咒骂就如水进他里面， 像油入他的骨头。
109.en: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.

109.zh: 愿这咒骂当他遮身的衣服， 当他常束的腰带！
109.en: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.

109.zh: 这就是我对头和用恶言议论我的人 从耶和华那里所受的报应。
109.en: This is the reward of my adversaries from the LORD, of those who speak evil against my soul.

109.zh: 主—耶和华啊，求你为你的名[恩]待我； 因你的慈爱美好，求你搭救我！
109.en: But deal with me, GOD the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;

109.zh: 因为我困苦穷乏， 内心受伤。
109.en: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.

109.zh: 我如日影渐渐偏斜而去； 我如蝗虫被抖出来。
109.en: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.

109.zh: 我因禁食，膝骨软弱； 我身上的肉也渐渐瘦了。
109.en: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.

109.zh: 我受他们的羞辱， 他们看见我便摇头。
109.en: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.

109.zh: 耶和华—我的　神啊，求你帮助我， 照你的慈爱拯救我，
109.en: Help me, LORD, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;

109.zh: 使他们知道这是你的手， 是你—耶和华所行的事。
109.en: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, LORD, have done it.

109.zh: 任凭他们咒骂，惟愿你赐福； 他们几时起来就必蒙羞， 你的仆人却要欢喜。
109.en: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.

109.zh: 愿我的对头披戴羞辱！ 愿他们以自己的羞愧为外袍遮身！
109.en: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

109.zh: 我要用口极力称谢耶和华； 我要在众人中间赞美他；
109.en: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.

109.zh: 因为他必站在穷乏人的右边， 要救他脱离审判他灵魂的人。
109.en: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.

110.zh: 大卫的诗。 耶和华对我主说： 你坐在我的右边， 等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳。
110.en: A Psalm by David. The LORD says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”

110.zh: 耶和华必使你从锡安伸出能力的杖来； 你要在你仇敌中掌权。
110.en: The LORD will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.

110.zh: 当你掌权的日子， 你的民要以圣洁的妆饰为衣， 甘心牺牲自己； 你的民多如清晨的甘露。
110.en: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.

110.zh: 耶和华起了誓，决不后悔，[说]： 你是照着麦基洗德的等次永远为祭司。
110.en: The LORD has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

110.zh: 在你右边的主， 当他发怒的日子，必打伤列王。
110.en: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.

110.zh: 他要在列邦中刑罚[恶人]， 尸首就遍满[各处]； 他要在许多国中打破[仇敌的]头。
110.en: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.

110.zh: 他要喝路旁的河水， 因此必抬起头来。
110.en: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.

111.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 我要在正直人的大会中，并公会中， 一心称谢耶和华。
111.en: Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

111.zh: 耶和华的作为本为大； 凡喜爱的都必考察。
111.en: The LORD’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.

111.zh: 他所行的是尊荣和威严； 他的公义存到永远。
111.en: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.

111.zh: 他行了奇事，使人记念； 耶和华有恩惠，有怜悯。
111.en: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. The LORD is gracious and merciful.

111.zh: 他赐粮食给敬畏他的人； 他必永远记念他的约。
111.en: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.

111.zh: 他向百姓显出大能的作为， 把外邦的地赐给他们为业。
111.en: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.

111.zh: 他手所行的是诚实公平； 他的训词都是确实的，
111.en: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.

111.zh: 是永永远远坚定的， 是按诚实正直设立的。
111.en: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.

111.zh: 他向百姓施行救赎， 命定他的约，直到永远； 他的名圣而可畏。
111.en: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!

111.zh: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的开端； 凡遵行[他命令]的是聪明人。 耶和华是永远当赞美的！
111.en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!

112.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 敬畏耶和华，甚喜爱他命令的， 这人便为有福！
112.en: Praise the LORD! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in his commandments.

112.zh: 他的后裔在世必强盛； 正直人的后代必要蒙福。
112.en: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.

112.zh: 他家中有货物，有钱财； 他的公义存到永远。
112.en: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.

112.zh: 正直人在黑暗中，有光向他发现； 他有恩惠，有怜悯，有公义。
112.en: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.

112.zh: 施恩与人、借贷与人的，这人事情顺利； 他被审判的时候要诉明自己的冤。
112.en: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.

112.zh: 他永不动摇； 义人被记念，直到永远。
112.en: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.

112.zh: 他必不怕凶恶的信息； 他心坚定，倚靠耶和华。
112.en: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.

112.zh: 他心确定，总不惧怕， 直到他看见敌人[遭报]。
112.en: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.

112.zh: 他施舍[钱财]，周济贫穷； 他的仁义存到永远。 他的角必被高举，大有荣耀。
112.en: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.

112.zh: 恶人看见便恼恨，必咬牙而消化； 恶人的心愿要归灭绝。
112.en: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.

113.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 耶和华的仆人哪，你们要赞美， 赞美耶和华的名！
113.en: Praise the LORD! Praise, you servants of the LORD, praise the LORD’s name.

113.zh: 耶和华的名是应当称颂的， 从今时直到永远！
113.en: Blessed be the LORD’s name, from this time forward and forever more.

113.zh: 从日出之地到日落之处， 耶和华的名是应当赞美的！
113.en: From the rising of the sun to its going down, the LORD’s name is to be praised.

113.zh: 耶和华超乎万民之上； 他的荣耀高过诸天。
113.en: The LORD is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.

113.zh: 谁像耶和华—我们的　神呢？ 他坐在至高之处，
113.en: Who is like the LORD, our God, who has his seat on high,

113.zh: 自己谦卑， 观看天上地下的事。
113.en: who stoops down to see in heaven and on the earth?

113.zh: 他从灰尘里抬举贫寒人， 从粪堆中提拔穷乏人，
113.en: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,

113.zh: 使他们与王子同坐， 就是与本国的王子同坐。
113.en: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

113.zh: 他使不能生育的妇人安居家中， 为多子的乐母。 你们要赞美耶和华！
113.en: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD!

114.zh: 以色列出了埃及， 雅各家离开说异言之民；
114.en: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,

114.zh: 那时，犹大为主的圣所， 以色列为他所治理的国度。
114.en: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

114.zh: 沧海看见就奔逃； 约旦河也倒流。
114.en: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.

114.zh: 大山踊跃，如公羊； 小山跳舞，如羊羔。
114.en: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.

114.zh: 沧海啊，你为何奔逃？ 约旦哪，你为何倒流？
114.en: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?

114.zh: 大山哪，你为何踊跃，如公羊？ 小山哪，你为何跳舞，如羊羔？
114.en: You mountains, that you skipped like rams? You little hills, like lambs?

114.zh: 大地啊，你因见主的面， 就是雅各　神的面，便要震动。
114.en: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

114.zh: 他叫磐石变为水池， 叫坚石变为泉源。
114.en: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.

115.zh: 耶和华啊，荣耀不要归与我们， 不要归与我们； 要因你的慈爱和诚实归在你的名下！
115.en: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.

115.zh: 为何容外邦人说： 他们的　神在哪里呢？
115.en: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”

115.zh: 然而，我们的　神在天上， 都随自己的意旨行事。
115.en: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.

115.zh: 他们的偶像是金的，银的， 是人手所造的，
115.en: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

115.zh: 有口却不能言， 有眼却不能看，
115.en: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.

115.zh: 有耳却不能听， 有鼻却不能闻，
115.en: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.

115.zh: 有手却不能摸， 有脚却不能走， 有喉咙也不能出声。
115.en: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.

115.zh: 造他的要和他一样； 凡靠他的也要如此。
115.en: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.

115.zh: 以色列啊，你要倚靠耶和华！ 他是你的帮助和你的盾牌。
115.en: Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

115.zh: 亚伦家啊，你们要倚靠耶和华！ 他是你们的帮助和你们的盾牌。
115.en: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

115.zh: 你们敬畏耶和华的，要倚靠耶和华！ 他是你们的帮助和你们的盾牌。
115.en: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

115.zh: 耶和华向来眷念我们； 他还要赐福[给我们]： 要赐福给以色列的家， 赐福给亚伦的家。
115.en: The LORD remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.

115.zh: 凡敬畏耶和华的，无论大小， 主必赐福给他。
115.en: He will bless those who fear the LORD, both small and great.

115.zh: 愿耶和华叫你们 和你们的子孙日见加增。
115.en: May the LORD increase you more and more, you and your children.

115.zh: 你们蒙了造天地之耶和华的福！
115.en: Blessed are you by the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

115.zh: 天，是耶和华的天； 地，他却给了世人。
115.en: The heavens are the LORD’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.

115.zh: 死人不能赞美耶和华； 下到寂静中的也都不能。
115.en: The dead don’t praise the LORD, nor any who go down into silence,

115.zh: 但我们要称颂耶和华， 从今时直到永远。 你们要赞美耶和华！
115.en: but we will bless the LORD, from this time forward and forever more. Praise the LORD!

116.zh: 我爱耶和华， 因为他听了我的声音和我的恳求。
116.en: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.

116.zh: 他既向我侧耳， 我一生要求告他。
116.en: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

116.zh: 死亡的绳索缠绕我； 阴间的痛苦抓住我； 我遭遇患难愁苦。
116.en: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.

116.zh: 那时，我便求告耶和华的名，说： 耶和华啊，求你救我的灵魂！
116.en: Then I called on the LORD’s name: “LORD, I beg you, deliver my soul.”

116.zh: 耶和华有恩惠，有公义； 我们的　神以怜悯为怀。
116.en: The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.

116.zh: 耶和华保护愚人； 我落到卑微的地步，他救了我。
116.en: The LORD preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.

116.zh: 我的心哪！你要仍归安乐， 因为耶和华用厚恩待你。
116.en: Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.

116.zh: 主啊，你救我的命免了死亡， 救我的眼免了流泪， 救我的脚免了跌倒。
116.en: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

116.zh: 我要在耶和华面前行活人之路。
116.en: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

116.zh: 我因信，所以如此说话； 我受了极大的困苦。
116.en: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”

116.zh: 我曾急促地说： 人都是说谎的！
116.en: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”

116.zh: 我拿什么报答耶和华向我所赐的一切厚恩？
116.en: What will I give to the LORD for all his benefits toward me?

116.zh: 我要举起救恩的杯， 称扬耶和华的名。
116.en: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the LORD’s name.

116.zh: 我要在他众民面前向耶和华还我的愿。
116.en: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people.

116.zh: 在耶和华眼中， 看圣民之死极为宝贵。
116.en: Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints.

116.zh: 耶和华啊，我真是你的仆人； 我是你的仆人，是你婢女的儿子。 你已经解开我的绑索。
116.en: LORD, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.

116.zh: 我要以感谢为祭献给你， 又要求告耶和华的名。
116.en: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the LORD’s name.

116.zh: 我要在他众民面前， 在耶和华殿的院内， 在耶路撒冷当中， 向耶和华还我的愿。 你们要赞美耶和华！
116.en: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people,
in the courts of the LORD’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

117.zh: 万国啊，你们都当赞美耶和华！ 万民哪，你们都当颂赞他！
117.en: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!

117.zh: 因为他向我们大施慈爱； 耶和华的诚实存到永远。 你们要赞美耶和华！
117.en: For his loving kindness is great toward us. The LORD’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise the LORD!

118.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善； 他的慈爱永远长存！
118.en: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

118.zh: 愿以色列说： 他的慈爱永远长存！
118.en: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

118.zh: 愿亚伦的家说： 他的慈爱永远长存！
118.en: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

118.zh: 愿敬畏耶和华的说： 他的慈爱永远长存！
118.en: Now let those who fear the LORD say that his loving kindness endures forever.

118.zh: 我在急难中求告耶和华，他就应允我， 把我[安置]在宽阔之地。
118.en: Out of my distress, I called on the LORD. The LORD answered me with freedom.

118.zh: 有耶和华帮助我，我必不惧怕， 人能把我怎么样呢？
118.en: The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

118.zh: 在那帮助我的人中，有耶和华帮助我， 所以我要看见那恨我的人[遭报]。
118.en: The LORD is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.

118.zh: 投靠耶和华，强似倚赖人；
118.en: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man.

118.zh: 投靠耶和华，强似倚赖王子。
118.en: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in princes.

118.zh: 万民围绕我， 我靠耶和华的名必剿灭他们。
118.en: All the nations surrounded me, but in the LORD’s name I cut them off.

118.zh: 他们环绕我，围困我， 我靠耶和华的名必剿灭他们。
118.en: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In the LORD’s name I indeed cut them off.

118.zh: 他们如同蜂子围绕我， 好像烧荆棘的火，必被熄灭； 我靠耶和华的名，必剿灭他们。
118.en: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.

118.zh: 你推我，要叫我跌倒， 但耶和华帮助了我。
118.en: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but the LORD helped me.

118.zh: 耶和华是我的力量，是我的诗歌； 他也成了我的拯救。
118.en: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.

118.zh: 在义人的帐棚里，有欢呼拯救的声音； 耶和华的右手施展大能。
118.en: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.

118.zh: 耶和华的右手高举； 耶和华的右手施展大能。
118.en: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD does valiantly!”

118.zh: 我必不致死，仍要存活， 并要传扬耶和华的作为。
118.en: I will not die, but live, and declare the LORD’s works.

118.zh: 耶和华虽严严地惩治我， 却未曾将我交于死亡。
118.en: The LORD has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

118.zh: 给我敞开义门； 我要进去称谢耶和华！
118.en: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to the LORD.

118.zh: 这是耶和华的门； 义人要进去！
118.en: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous will enter into it.

118.zh: 我要称谢你，因为你已经应允我， 又成了我的拯救！
118.en: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.

118.zh: 匠人所弃的石头 已成了房角的头块石头。
118.en: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.

118.zh: 这是耶和华所做的， 在我们眼中看为希奇。
118.en: This is the LORD’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.

118.zh: 这是耶和华所定的日子， 我们在其中要高兴欢喜！
118.en: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

118.zh: 耶和华啊，求你拯救！ 耶和华啊，求你使我们亨通！
118.en: Save us now, we beg you, LORD! LORD, we beg you, send prosperity now.

118.zh: 奉耶和华名来的是应当称颂的！ 我们从耶和华的殿中为你们祝福！
118.en: Blessed is he who comes in the LORD’s name! We have blessed you out of the LORD’s house.

118.zh: 耶和华是　神； 他光照了我们。 理当用绳索把祭牲拴住， [牵]到坛角那里。
118.en: The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.

118.zh: 你是我的　神，我要称谢你！ 你是我的　神，我要尊崇你！
118.en: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.

118.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善； 他的慈爱永远长存！
118.en: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

119.zh: 行为完全、遵行耶和华律法的， 这人便为有福！
119.en: ALEPH Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the LORD’s law.

119.zh: 遵守他的法度、一心寻求他的， 这人便为有福！
119.en: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.

119.zh: 这人不做非义的事， 但遵行他的道。
119.en: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，你曾将你的训词吩咐我们， 为要我们殷勤遵守。
119.en: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.

119.zh: 但愿我行事坚定， 得以遵守你的律例。
119.en: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!

119.zh: 我看重你的一切命令， 就不至于羞愧。
119.en: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.

119.zh: 我学了你公义的判语， 就要以正直的心称谢你。
119.en: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.

119.zh: 我必守你的律例； 求你总不要丢弃我！
119.en: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me. BETH

119.zh: 少年人用什么洁净他的行为呢？ 是要遵行你的话！
119.en: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.

119.zh: 我一心寻求了你； 求你不要叫我偏离你的命令。
119.en: With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.

119.zh: 我将你的话藏在心里， 免得我得罪你。
119.en: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，你是应当称颂的！ 求你将你的律例教训我！
119.en: Blessed are you, LORD. Teach me your statutes.

119.zh: 我用嘴唇传扬你口中的一切典章。
119.en: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.

119.zh: 我喜悦你的法度， 如同喜悦一切的财物。
119.en: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.

119.zh: 我要默想你的训词， 看重你的道路。
119.en: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.

119.zh: 我要在你的律例中自乐； 我不忘记你的话。
119.en: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word. GIMEL

119.zh: 求你用厚恩待你的仆人，使我存活， 我就遵守你的话。
119.en: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.

119.zh: 求你开我的眼睛， 使我看出你律法中的奇妙。
119.en: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.

119.zh: 我是在地上作寄居的； 求你不要向我隐瞒你的命令！
119.en: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.

119.zh: 我时常切慕你的典章， 甚至心碎。
119.en: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.

119.zh: 受咒诅、偏离你命令的骄傲人， 你已经责备他们。
119.en: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.

119.zh: 求你除掉我所受的羞辱和藐视， 因我遵守你的法度。
119.en: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.

119.zh: 虽有首领坐着妄论我， 你仆人却思想你的律例。
119.en: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.

119.zh: 你的法度是我所喜乐的， 是我的谋士。
119.en: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors. DALETH

119.zh: 我的性命几乎归于尘土； 求你照你的话将我救活！
119.en: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!

119.zh: 我述说我所行的，你应允了我； 求你将你的律例教训我！
119.en: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.

119.zh: 求你使我明白你的训词， 我就思想你的奇事。
119.en: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.

119.zh: 我的心因愁苦而消化； 求你照你的话使我坚立！
119.en: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.

119.zh: 求你使我离开奸诈的道， 开恩将你的律法赐给我！
119.en: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!

119.zh: 我拣选了忠信的道， 将你的典章摆在[我面前]。
119.en: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.

119.zh: 我持守你的法度； 耶和华啊，求你不要叫我羞愧！
119.en: I cling to your statutes, LORD. Don’t let me be disappointed.

119.zh: 你开广我心的时候， 我就往你命令的道上直奔。
119.en: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free. HE

119.zh: 耶和华啊，求你将你的律例指教我， 我必遵守到底！
119.en: Teach me, LORD, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.

119.zh: 求你赐我悟性，我便遵守你的律法， 且要一心遵守。
119.en: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.

119.zh: 求你叫我遵行你的命令， 因为这是我所喜乐的。
119.en: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.

119.zh: 求你使我的心趋向你的法度， 不趋向非义之财。
119.en: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.

119.zh: 求你叫我转眼不看虚假， 又叫我在你的道中生活。
119.en: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.

119.zh: 你向敬畏你的人所应许的话， 求你向仆人坚定！
119.en: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.

119.zh: 求你使我所怕的羞辱远离我， 因你的典章本为美。
119.en: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.

119.zh: 我羡慕你的训词； 求你使我在你的公义上生活！
119.en: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness. VAV

119.zh: 耶和华啊，愿你照你的话，使你的慈爱， 就是你的救恩，临到我身上，
119.en: Let your loving kindness also come to me, LORD, your salvation, according to your word.

119.zh: 我就有话回答那羞辱我的， 因我倚靠你的话。
119.en: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.

119.zh: 求你叫真理的话总不离开我口， 因我仰望你的典章。
119.en: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.

119.zh: 我要常守你的律法， 直到永永远远。
119.en: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.

119.zh: 我要自由而行， 因我素来考究你的训词。
119.en: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.

119.zh: 我也要在君王面前论说你的法度， 并不至于羞愧。
119.en: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.

119.zh: 我要在你的命令中自乐； 这命令素来是我所爱的。
119.en: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.

119.zh: 我又要遵行你的命令， 这命令素来是我所爱的； 我也要思想你的律例。
119.en: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes. ZAYIN

119.zh: 求你记念向你仆人[所应许]的话， 叫我有盼望。
119.en: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.

119.zh: 这话将我救活了； 我在患难中，因此得安慰。
119.en: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.

119.zh: 骄傲的人甚侮慢我， 我却未曾偏离你的律法。
119.en: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，我记念你从古以来的典章， 就得了安慰。
119.en: I remember your ordinances of old, LORD, and have comforted myself.

119.zh: 我见恶人离弃你的律法， 就怒气发作，犹如火烧。
119.en: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.

119.zh: 我在世寄居， 素来以你的律例为诗歌。
119.en: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，我夜间记念你的名， 遵守你的律法。
119.en: I have remembered your name, LORD, in the night, and I obey your law.

119.zh: 我所以如此， 是因我守你的训词。
119.en: This is my way, that I keep your precepts. HETH

119.zh: 耶和华是我的福分； 我曾说，我要遵守你的言语。
119.en: The LORD is my portion. I promised to obey your words.

119.zh: 我一心求过你的恩； 愿你照你的话怜悯我！
119.en: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.

119.zh: 我思想我所行的道， 就转步归向你的法度。
119.en: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.

119.zh: 我急忙遵守你的命令， 并不迟延。
119.en: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.

119.zh: 恶人的绳索缠绕我， 我却没有忘记你的律法。
119.en: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.

119.zh: 我因你公义的典章， 半夜必起来称谢你。
119.en: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.

119.zh: 凡敬畏你、守你训词的人， 我都与他作伴。
119.en: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，你的慈爱遍满大地； 求你将你的律例教训我！
119.en: The earth is full of your loving kindness, LORD. Teach me your statutes. TETH

119.zh: 耶和华啊，你向来是照你的话善待仆人。
119.en: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, LORD.

119.zh: 求你将精明和知识赐给我， 因我信了你的命令。
119.en: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.

119.zh: 我未受苦以先走迷了路， 现在却遵守你的话。
119.en: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.

119.zh: 你本为善，所行的也善； 求你将你的律例教训我！
119.en: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.

119.zh: 骄傲人编造谎言攻击我， 我却要一心守你的训词。
119.en: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.

119.zh: 他们心蒙脂油， 我却喜爱你的律法。
119.en: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.

119.zh: 我受苦是与我有益， 为要使我学习你的律例。
119.en: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.

119.zh: 你口中的训言与我有益， 胜于千万的金银。
119.en: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH

119.zh: 你的手制造我，建立我； 求你赐我悟性，可以学习你的命令！
119.en: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.

119.zh: 敬畏你的人见我就要欢喜， 因我仰望你的话。
119.en: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，我知道你的判语是公义的； 你使我受苦是以诚实待我。
119.en: LORD, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

119.zh: 求你照着[应许]仆人的话， 以慈爱安慰我。
119.en: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.

119.zh: 愿你的慈悲临到我，使我存活， 因你的律法是我所喜爱的。
119.en: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.

119.zh: 愿骄傲人蒙羞，因为他们无理地倾覆我； 但我要思想你的训词。
119.en: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.

119.zh: 愿敬畏你的人归向我， 他们就知道你的法度。
119.en: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.

119.zh: 愿我的心在你的律例上完全， 使我不致蒙羞。
119.en: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed. KAPF

119.zh: 我心渴想你的救恩， 仰望你的应许。
119.en: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.

119.zh: 我因盼望你的应许眼睛失明，说： 你何时安慰我？
119.en: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”

119.zh: 我好像烟薰的皮袋， 却不忘记你的律例。
119.en: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.

119.zh: 你仆人的年日有多少呢？ 你几时向逼迫我的人施行审判呢？
119.en: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?

119.zh: 不从你律法的骄傲人为我掘了坑。
119.en: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.

119.zh: 你的命令尽都诚实； 他们无理地逼迫我，求你帮助我！
119.en: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!

119.zh: 他们几乎把我从世上灭绝， 但我没有离弃你的训词。
119.en: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.

119.zh: 求你照你的慈爱将我救活， 我就遵守你口中的法度。
119.en: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth. LAMEDH

119.zh: 耶和华啊，你的话安定在天， 直到永远。
119.en: LORD, your word is settled in heaven forever.

119.zh: 你的诚实存到万代； 你坚定了地，地就长存。
119.en: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.

119.zh: 天地照你的安排存到今日； 万物都是你的仆役。
119.en: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.

119.zh: 我若不是喜爱你的律法， 早就在苦难中灭绝了！
119.en: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.

119.zh: 我永不忘记你的训词， 因你用这训词将我救活了。
119.en: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.

119.zh: 我是属你的，求你救我， 因我寻求了你的训词。
119.en: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.

119.zh: 恶人等待我，要灭绝我， 我却要揣摩你的法度。
119.en: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.

119.zh: 我看万事尽都有限， 惟有你的命令极其宽广。
119.en: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless. MEM

119.zh: 我何等爱慕你的律法， 终日不住地思想。
119.en: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.

119.zh: 你的命令常存在我心里， 使我比仇敌有智慧。
119.en: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.

119.zh: 我比我的师傅更通达， 因我思想你的法度。
119.en: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.

119.zh: 我比年老的更明白， 因我守了你的训词。
119.en: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.

119.zh: 我禁止我脚走一切的邪路， 为要遵守你的话。
119.en: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.

119.zh: 我没有偏离你的典章， 因为你教训了我。
119.en: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.

119.zh: 你的言语在我上膛何等甘美， 在我口中比蜜更甜！
119.en: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!

119.zh: 我借着你的训词得以明白， 所以我恨一切的假道。
119.en: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way. NUN

119.zh: 你的话是我脚前的灯， 是我路上的光。
119.en: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

119.zh: 你公义的典章，我曾起誓遵守， 我必按誓而行。
119.en: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.

119.zh: 我甚是受苦； 耶和华啊，求你照你的话将我救活！
119.en: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, LORD, according to your word.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，求你悦纳我口中的赞美为供物， 又将你的典章教训我！
119.en: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. LORD, teach me your ordinances.

119.zh: 我的性命常在危险之中， 我却不忘记你的律法。
119.en: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.

119.zh: 恶人为我设下网罗， 我却没有偏离你的训词。
119.en: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.

119.zh: 我以你的法度为永远的产业， 因这是我心中所喜爱的。
119.en: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

119.zh: 我的心专向你的律例， 永远遵行，一直到底。
119.en: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end. SAMEKH

119.zh: 心怀二意的人为我所恨； 但你的律法为我所爱。
119.en: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.

119.zh: 你是我藏身之处，又是我的盾牌； 我甚仰望你的话语。
119.en: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.

119.zh: 作恶的人哪，你们离开我吧！ 我好遵守我　神的命令。
119.en: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.

119.zh: 求你照你的话扶持我，使我存活， 也不叫我因失望而害羞。
119.en: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.

119.zh: 求你扶持我，我便得救， 时常看重你的律例。
119.en: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.

119.zh: 凡偏离你律例的人，你都轻弃他们， 因为他们的诡诈必归虚空。
119.en: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.

119.zh: 凡地上的恶人，你除掉他，好像除掉渣滓； 因此我爱你的法度。
119.en: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.

119.zh: 我因惧怕你，肉就发抖； 我也怕你的判语。
119.en: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments. AYIN

119.zh: 我行过公平和公义， 求你不要撇下我给欺压我的人！
119.en: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.

119.zh: 求你为仆人作保，使我得好处， 不容骄傲人欺压我！
119.en: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.

119.zh: 我因盼望你的救恩 和你公义的话眼睛失明。
119.en: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.

119.zh: 求你照你的慈爱待仆人， 将你的律例教训我。
119.en: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.

119.zh: 我是你的仆人，求你赐我悟性， 使我得知你的法度。
119.en: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.

119.zh: 这是耶和华降罚的时候， 因人废了你的律法。
119.en: It is time to act, LORD, for they break your law.

119.zh: 所以，我爱你的命令胜于金子， 更胜于精金。
119.en: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.

119.zh: 你一切的训词，在万事上我都以为正直； 我却恨恶一切假道。
119.en: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way. PE

119.zh: 你的法度奇妙， 所以我一心谨守。
119.en: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.

119.zh: 你的言语一解开就发出亮光， 使愚人通达。
119.en: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.

119.zh: 我张口而气喘， 因我切慕你的命令。
119.en: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.

119.zh: 求你转向我，怜悯我， 好像你素常待那些爱你名的人。
119.en: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.

119.zh: 求你用你的话使我脚步稳当， 不许什么罪孽辖制我。
119.en: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.

119.zh: 求你救我脱离人的欺压， 我要遵守你的训词。
119.en: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.

119.zh: 求你用脸光照仆人， 又将你的律例教训我。
119.en: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.

119.zh: 我的眼泪下流成河， 因为他们不守你的律法。
119.en: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law. TZADHE

119.zh: 耶和华啊，你是公义的； 你的判语也是正直的！
119.en: You are righteous, LORD. Your judgments are upright.

119.zh: 你所命定的法度是凭公义和至诚。
119.en: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.

119.zh: 我心焦急，如同火烧， 因我敌人忘记你的言语。
119.en: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.

119.zh: 你的话极其精炼， 所以你的仆人喜爱。
119.en: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.

119.zh: 我微小，被人藐视， 却不忘记你的训词。
119.en: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.

119.zh: 你的公义永远长存； 你的律法尽都真实。
119.en: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.

119.zh: 我遭遇患难愁苦， 你的命令却是我所喜爱的。
119.en: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.

119.zh: 你的法度永远是公义的； 求你赐我悟性，我就活了。
119.en: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live. QOPH

119.zh: 耶和华啊，我一心呼吁你； 求你应允我，我必谨守你的律例！
119.en: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, LORD! I will keep your statutes.

119.zh: 我向你呼吁，求你救我！ 我要遵守你的法度。
119.en: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.

119.zh: 我趁天未亮呼求； 我仰望了你的言语。
119.en: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.

119.zh: 我趁夜更未换将眼睁开， 为要思想你的话语。
119.en: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.

119.zh: 求你照你的慈爱听我的声音； 耶和华啊，求你照你的典章将我救活！
119.en: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, LORD, according to your ordinances.

119.zh: 追求奸恶的人临近了； 他们远离你的律法。
119.en: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，你与我相近； 你一切的命令尽都真实！
119.en: You are near, LORD. All your commandments are truth.

119.zh: 我因[学]你的法度， 久已知道是你永远立定的。
119.en: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever. RESH

119.zh: 求你看顾我的苦难，搭救我， 因我不忘记你的律法。
119.en: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.

119.zh: 求你为我辨屈，救赎我， 照你的话将我救活。
119.en: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.

119.zh: 救恩远离恶人， 因为他们不寻求你的律例。
119.en: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，你的慈悲本为大； 求你照你的典章将我救活。
119.en: Great are your tender mercies, LORD. Revive me according to your ordinances.

119.zh: 逼迫我的，抵挡我的，很多， 我却没有偏离你的法度。
119.en: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.

119.zh: 我看见奸恶的人就甚憎恶， 因为他们不遵守你的话。
119.en: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.

119.zh: 你看我怎样爱你的训词！ 耶和华啊，求你照你的慈爱将我救活！
119.en: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, LORD, according to your loving kindness.

119.zh: 你话的总纲是真实； 你一切公义的典章是永远长存。
119.en: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever. SIN AND SHIN

119.zh: 首领无故地逼迫我， 但我的心畏惧你的言语。
119.en: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.

119.zh: 我喜爱你的话， 好像人得了许多掳物。
119.en: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.

119.zh: 谎话是我所恨恶所憎嫌的； 惟你的律法是我所爱的。
119.en: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.

119.zh: 我因你公义的典章一天七次赞美你。
119.en: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.

119.zh: 爱你律法的人有大平安， 什么都不能使他们绊脚。
119.en: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，我仰望了你的救恩， 遵行了你的命令。
119.en: I have hoped for your salvation, LORD. I have done your commandments.

119.zh: 我心里守了你的法度； 这法度我甚喜爱。
119.en: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.

119.zh: 我遵守了你的训词和法度， 因我一切所行的都在你面前。
119.en: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you. TAV

119.zh: 耶和华啊，愿我的呼吁达到你面前， 照你的话赐我悟性。
119.en: Let my cry come before you, LORD. Give me understanding according to your word.

119.zh: 愿我的恳求达到你面前， 照你的话搭救我。
119.en: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.

119.zh: 愿我的嘴发出赞美的话， 因为你将律例教训我。
119.en: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.

119.zh: 愿我的舌头歌唱你的话， 因你一切的命令尽都公义。
119.en: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.

119.zh: 愿你用手帮助我， 因我拣选了你的训词。
119.en: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，我切慕你的救恩！ 你的律法也是我所喜爱的。
119.en: I have longed for your salvation, LORD. Your law is my delight.

119.zh: 愿我的性命存活，得以赞美你！ 愿你的典章帮助我！
119.en: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.

119.zh: 我如亡羊走迷了路，求你寻找仆人， 因我不忘记你的命令。
119.en: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.

120.zh: 上行（或作登阶，下同）之诗。 我在急难中求告耶和华， 他就应允我。
120.en: A Song of Ascents. In my distress, I cried to the LORD. He answered me.

120.zh: 耶和华啊，求你救我脱离说谎的嘴唇和诡诈的舌头！
120.en: Deliver my soul, LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.

120.zh: 诡诈的舌头啊，要给你什么呢？ 要拿什么加给你呢？
120.en: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?

120.zh: 就是勇士的利箭和罗腾木 的炭火。
120.en: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

120.zh: 我寄居在米设， 住在基达帐棚之中，有祸了！
120.en: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

120.zh: 我与那恨恶和睦的人许久同住。
120.en: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.

120.zh: 我愿和睦， 但我发言，他们就要争战。
120.en: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.

121.zh: 上行之诗。 我要向山举目； 我的帮助从何而来？
121.en: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

121.zh: 我的帮助 从造天地的耶和华而来。
121.en: My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

121.zh: 他必不叫你的脚摇动； 保护你的必不打盹！
121.en: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.

121.zh: 保护以色列的， 也不打盹也不睡觉。
121.en: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

121.zh: 保护你的是耶和华； 耶和华在你右边荫庇你。
121.en: The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand.

121.zh: 白日，太阳必不伤你； 夜间，月亮必不害你。
121.en: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

121.zh: 耶和华要保护你，免受一切的灾害； 他要保护你的性命。
121.en: The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.

121.zh: 你出你入，耶和华要保护你， 从今时直到永远。
121.en: The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.

122.zh: 大卫上行之诗。 人对我说：我们往耶和华的殿去， 我就欢喜。
122.en: A Song of Ascents. By David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to the LORD’s house!”

122.zh: 耶路撒冷啊， 我们的脚站在你的门内。
122.en: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!

122.zh: 耶路撒冷被建造， 如同连络整齐的一座城。
122.en: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,

122.zh: 众支派，就是耶和华的支派，上那里去， 按以色列的常例称赞耶和华的名。
122.en: where the tribes go up, even the LORD’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to the LORD’s name.

122.zh: 因为在那里设立审判的宝座， 就是大卫家的宝座。
122.en: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.

122.zh: 你们要为耶路撒冷求平安！ 耶路撒冷啊，爱你的人必然兴旺！
122.en: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.

122.zh: 愿你城中平安！ 愿你宫内兴旺！
122.en: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.

122.zh: 因我弟兄和同伴的缘故，我要说： 愿平安在你中间！
122.en: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”

122.zh: 因耶和华—我们　神殿的缘故， 我要为你求福！
122.en: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.

123.zh: 上行之诗。 坐在天上的[主]啊， 我向你举目。
123.en: A Song of Ascents. I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.

123.zh: 看哪，仆人的眼睛怎样望主人的手， 使女的眼睛怎样望主母的手， 我们的眼睛也照样望耶和华—我们的　神， 直到他怜悯我们。
123.en: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD, our God, until he has mercy on us.

123.zh: 耶和华啊，求你怜悯我们，怜悯我们！ 因为我们被藐视，已到极处。
123.en: Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.

123.zh: 我们被那些安逸人的讥诮 和骄傲人的藐视，已到极处。
123.en: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.

124.zh: 大卫上行之诗。 以色列人要说： 若不是耶和华帮助我们，
124.en: A Song of Ascents. By David. If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, let Israel now say,

124.zh: 若不是耶和华帮助我们， 当人起来攻击我们、
124.en: if it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us,

124.zh: 向我们发怒的时候， 就把我们活活地吞了。
124.en: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,

124.zh: 那时，波涛必漫过我们， 河水必淹没我们，
124.en: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.
Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.

124.zh: 耶和华是应当称颂的！ 他没有把我们当野食交给他们吞吃。
124.en: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.

124.zh: 我们好像雀鸟，从捕鸟人的网罗里逃脱； 网罗破裂，我们逃脱了。
124.en: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.

124.zh: 我们得帮助， 是在乎[倚靠]造天地之耶和华的名。
124.en: Our help is in the LORD’s name, who made heaven and earth.

125.zh: 上行之诗。 倚靠耶和华的人 好像锡安山，永不动摇。
125.en: A Song of Ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.

125.zh: 众山怎样围绕耶路撒冷， 耶和华也照样围绕他的百姓， 从今时直到永远。
125.en: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.

125.zh: 恶人的杖不常落在义人的分上， 免得义人伸手作恶。
125.en: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.

125.zh: 耶和华啊，求你善待那些为善 和心里正直的人。
125.en: Do good, LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.

125.zh: 至于那偏行弯曲道路的人， 耶和华必使他和作恶的人一同出去[受刑]。 愿平安归于以色列！
125.en: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, the LORD will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.

126.zh: 上行之诗。 当耶和华将那些被掳的带回锡安的时候， 我们好像做梦的人。
126.en: A Song of Ascents. When the LORD brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.

126.zh: 我们满口喜笑、 满舌欢呼的时候， 外邦中就有人说： 耶和华为他们行了大事！
126.en: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”

126.zh: 耶和华果然为我们行了大事， 我们就欢喜。
126.en: The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.

126.zh: 耶和华啊，求你使我们被掳的人归回， 好像南地的河水复流。
126.en: Restore our fortunes again, LORD, like the streams in the Negev.

126.zh: 流泪撒种的， 必欢呼收割！
126.en: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

126.zh: 那带种流泪出去的， 必要欢欢乐乐地带禾捆回来！
126.en: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.

127.zh: 所罗门上行之诗。 若不是耶和华建造房屋， 建造的人就枉然劳力； 若不是耶和华看守城池， 看守的人就枉然警醒。
127.en: A Song of Ascents. By Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.

127.zh: 你们清晨早起，夜晚安歇， 吃劳碌得来的饭，本是枉然； 惟有耶和华所亲爱的，必叫他安然睡觉。
127.en: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.

127.zh: 儿女是耶和华所赐的产业； 所怀的胎是他所给的赏赐。
127.en: Behold, children are a heritage of the LORD. The fruit of the womb is his reward.

127.zh: 少年时[所生]的儿女 好像勇士手中的箭。
127.en: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.

127.zh: 箭袋充满的人便为有福； 他们在城门口和仇敌说话的时候， 必不至于羞愧。
127.en: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.

128.zh: 上行之诗。 凡敬畏耶和华、 遵行他道的人便为有福！
128.en: A Song of Ascents. Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways.

128.zh: 你要吃劳碌得来的； 你要享福，事情顺利。
128.en: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.

128.zh: 你妻子在你的内室，好像多结果子的葡萄树； 你儿女围绕你的桌子，好像橄榄栽子。
128.en: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.

128.zh: 看哪，敬畏耶和华的人必要这样蒙福！
128.en: Behold, this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed.

128.zh: 愿耶和华从锡安赐福给你！ 愿你一生一世看见耶路撒冷的好处！
128.en: May the LORD bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

128.zh: 愿你看见你儿女的儿女！ 愿平安归于以色列！
128.en: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.

129.zh: 上行之诗。 以色列当说：从我幼年以来， 敌人屡次苦害我，
129.en: A Song of Ascents. Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say:

129.zh: 从我幼年以来，敌人屡次苦害我， 却没有胜了我。
129.en: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.

129.zh: [如同]扶犁的在我背上扶犁而耕， 耕的犁沟甚长。
129.en: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.

129.zh: 耶和华是公义的； 他砍断了恶人的绳索。
129.en: The LORD is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.

129.zh: 愿恨恶锡安的都蒙羞退后！
129.en: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.

129.zh: 愿他们像房顶上的草， 未长成而枯干，
129.en: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,

129.zh: 收割的不够一把， 捆禾的也不满怀。
129.en: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.

129.zh: 过路的也不说： 愿耶和华所赐的福归与你们！ 我们奉耶和华的名给你们祝福！
129.en: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of the LORD be on you. We bless you in the LORD’s name.”

130.zh: 上行之诗。 耶和华啊，我从深处向你求告！
130.en: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD.

130.zh: 主啊，求你听我的声音！ 愿你侧耳听我恳求的声音！
130.en: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.

130.zh: 主—耶和华啊，你若究察罪孽， 谁能站得住呢？
130.en: If you, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?

130.zh: 但在你有赦免之恩， 要叫人敬畏你。
130.en: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.

130.zh: 我等候耶和华，我的心等候； 我也仰望他的话。
130.en: I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word.

130.zh: 我的心[等候]主， 胜于守夜的，[等候]天亮， [胜于]守夜的，[等候]天亮。
130.en: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.

130.zh: 以色列啊，你当仰望耶和华！ 因他有慈爱，有丰盛的救恩。
130.en: Israel, hope in the LORD, for there is loving kindness with the LORD. Abundant redemption is with him.

130.zh: 他必救赎以色列脱离一切的罪孽。
130.en: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.

131.zh: 大卫上行之诗。 耶和华啊，我的心不狂傲， 我的眼不高大； 重大和测不透的事， 我也不敢行。
131.en: A Song of Ascents. By David. LORD, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.

131.zh: 我的心平稳安静， 好像断过奶的孩子在他母亲的怀中； 我的心在我里面真像断过奶的孩子。
131.en: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.

131.zh: 以色列啊，你当仰望耶和华， 从今时直到永远！
131.en: Israel, hope in the LORD, from this time forward and forever more.

132.zh: 上行之诗。 耶和华啊，求你记念大卫所受的一切苦难！
132.en: A Song of Ascents. LORD, remember David and all his affliction,

132.zh: 他怎样向耶和华起誓， 向雅各的大能者许愿，
132.en: how he swore to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:

132.zh: 说：我必不进我的帐幕， 也不上我的床榻；
132.en: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;

132.zh: 我不容我的眼睛睡觉， 也不容我的眼目打盹；
132.en: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,

132.zh: 直等我为耶和华寻得所在， 为雅各的大能者寻得居所。
132.en: until I find out a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”

132.zh: 我们听说[约柜]在以法他， 我们在基列·耶琳就寻见了。
132.en: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar.

132.zh: 我们要进他的居所， 在他脚凳前下拜。
132.en: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.”

132.zh: 耶和华啊，求你兴起， 和你有能力的[约]柜同入安息之所！
132.en: Arise, LORD, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.

132.zh: 愿你的祭司披上公义！ 愿你的圣民欢呼！
132.en: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!

132.zh: 求你因你仆人大卫的缘故， 不要厌弃你的受膏者！
132.en: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.

132.zh: 耶和华向大卫、凭诚实起了誓， 必不反复，[说]： 我要使你所生的 坐在你的宝座上。
132.en: The LORD has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.

132.zh: 你的众子若守我的约 和我所教训他们的法度， 他们的子孙必永远坐在你的宝座上。
132.en: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”

132.zh: 因为耶和华拣选了锡安， 愿意当作自己的居所，
132.en: For the LORD has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.

132.zh: 说：这是我永远安息之所； 我要住在这里， 因为是我所愿意的。
132.en: “This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.

132.zh: 我要使其中的粮食丰满， 使其中的穷人饱足。
132.en: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.

132.zh: 我要使祭司披上救恩， 圣民大声欢呼！
132.en: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.

132.zh: 我要叫大卫的角在那里发生； 我为我的受膏者预备明灯。
132.en: I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.

132.zh: 我要使他的仇敌披上羞耻； 但他的冠冕要在头上发光。
132.en: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”

133.zh: 大卫上行之诗。 看哪，弟兄和睦同居 是何等地善，何等地美！
133.en: A Song of Ascents. By David. See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!

133.zh: 这好比那贵重的油[浇]在亚伦的头上， 流到胡须，又流到他的衣襟；
133.en: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,

133.zh: 又好比黑门的甘露降在锡安山； 因为在那里有耶和华所命定的福， 就是永远的生命。
133.en: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there the LORD gives the blessing, even life forever more.

134.zh: 上行之诗。 耶和华的仆人夜间站在耶和华殿中的， 你们当称颂耶和华！
134.en: A Song of Ascents. Look! Praise the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the LORD’s house!

134.zh: 你们当向圣所举手， 称颂耶和华！
134.en: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise the LORD!

134.zh: 愿造天地的耶和华， 从锡安赐福给你们！
134.en: May the LORD bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.

135.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 你们要赞美耶和华的名！ 耶和华的仆人站在耶和华殿中； 站在我们　神殿院中的，你们要赞美他！
135.en: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD’s name! Praise him, you servants of the LORD,
you who stand in the LORD’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.

135.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 耶和华本为善； 要歌颂他的名， 因为这是美好的。
135.en: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.

135.zh: 耶和华拣选雅各归自己， 拣选以色列特作自己的子民。
135.en: For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.

135.zh: 原来我知道耶和华为大， 也知道我们的主超乎万神之上。
135.en: For I know that the LORD is great, that our Lord is above all gods.

135.zh: 耶和华在天上，在地下， 在海中，在一切的深处， 都随自己的意旨而行。
135.en: Whatever the LORD pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.

135.zh: 他使云雾从地极上腾， 造电随雨而闪， 从府库中带出风来。
135.en: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.

135.zh: 他将埃及头生的， 连人带牲畜都击杀了。
135.en: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.

135.zh: 埃及啊，他施行神迹奇事， 在你当中，在法老和他一切臣仆身上。
135.en: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.

135.zh: 他击杀许多的民， 又杀戮大能的王，
135.en: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings—

135.zh: 就是亚摩利王西宏和巴珊王噩， 并迦南一切的国王，
135.en: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—

135.zh: 将他们的地赏赐他的百姓以色列为业。
135.en: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.

135.zh: 耶和华啊，你的名存到永远！ 耶和华啊，你可记念的名存到万代！
135.en: Your name, LORD, endures forever; your renown, LORD, throughout all generations.

135.zh: 耶和华要为他的百姓伸冤， 为他的仆人后悔。
135.en: For the LORD will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.

135.zh: 外邦的偶像是金的，银的， 是人手所造的；
135.en: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

135.zh: 有口却不能言， 有眼却不能看，
135.en: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.

135.zh: 有耳却不能听， 口中也没有气息。
135.en: They have ears, but they can’t hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.

135.zh: 造他的要和他一样， 凡靠他的也要如此。
135.en: Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them.

135.zh: 以色列家啊，你们要称颂耶和华！ 亚伦家啊，你们要称颂耶和华！
135.en: House of Israel, praise the LORD! House of Aaron, praise the LORD!

135.zh: 利未家啊，你们要称颂耶和华！ 你们敬畏耶和华的，要称颂耶和华！
135.en: House of Levi, praise the LORD! You who fear the LORD, praise the LORD!

135.zh: 住在耶路撒冷的耶和华 该从锡安受称颂。 你们要赞美耶和华！
135.en: Blessed be the LORD from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

136.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善； 他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

136.zh: 你们要称谢万神之神， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loving kindness endures forever.

136.zh: 你们要称谢万主之主， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: [称谢]那独行大奇事的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: to him who alone does great wonders, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: [称谢]那用智慧造天的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: to him who by understanding made the heavens, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: [称谢]那铺地在水以上的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: to him who spread out the earth above the waters, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: [称谢]那造成大光的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: to him who made the great lights, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: 他造日头管白昼， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: the sun to rule by day, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: 他造月亮星宿管黑夜， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: the moon and stars to rule by night, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: [称谢]那击杀埃及人之长子的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: 他领以色列人从他们中间出来， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: and brought out Israel from among them, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: 他施展大能的手和伸出来的膀臂， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: [称谢]那分裂红海的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: to him who divided the Red Sea apart, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: 他领以色列从其中经过， 因他的慈爱永远长存；
136.en: and made Israel to pass through the middle of it, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: 却把法老和他的军兵推翻在红海里， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: [称谢]那引导自己的民行走旷野的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: to him who led his people through the wilderness, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: [称谢]那击杀大君王的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: to him who struck great kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: 他杀戮有名的君王， 因他的慈爱永远长存；
136.en: and killed mighty kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: 就是杀戮亚摩利王西宏， 因他的慈爱永远长存；
136.en: Sihon king of the Amorites, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: 又杀巴珊王噩， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: Og king of Bashan, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: 他将他们的地赐他的百姓为业， 因他的慈爱永远长存；
136.en: and gave their land as an inheritance, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: 就是赐他的仆人以色列为业， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: even a heritage to Israel his servant, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: 他顾念我们在卑微的地步， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: who remembered us in our low estate, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: 他救拔我们脱离敌人， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: and has delivered us from our adversaries, for his loving kindness endures forever;

136.zh: 他赐粮食给凡有血气的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: who gives food to every creature, for his loving kindness endures forever.

136.zh: 你们要称谢天上的　神， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven, for his loving kindness endures forever.

137.zh: 我们曾在巴比伦的河边坐下， 一追想锡安就哭了。
137.en: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

137.zh: 我们把琴挂在那里的柳树上；
137.en: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.

137.zh: 因为在那里，掳掠我们的要我们唱歌， 抢夺我们的[要我们]作乐，说： 给我们唱一首锡安歌吧！
137.en: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”

137.zh: 我们怎能在外邦唱耶和华的歌呢？
137.en: How can we sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?

137.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，我若忘记你， 情愿我的右手忘记[技巧]！
137.en: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.

137.zh: 我若不记念你， 若不看耶路撒冷过于我所最喜乐的， 情愿我的舌头贴于上膛！
137.en: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.

137.zh: 耶路撒冷[遭难]的日子， 以东人说：拆毁！拆毁！ 直拆到根基！ 耶和华啊，求你记念这仇！
137.en: Remember, LORD, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”

137.zh: 将要被灭的巴比伦城啊， 报复你像你待我们的，那人便为有福！
137.en: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.

137.zh: 拿你的婴孩摔在磐石上的， 那人便为有福！
137.en: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.

138.zh: 大卫的诗。 我要一心称谢你， 在诸神面前歌颂你。
138.en: By David. I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.

138.zh: 我要向你的圣殿下拜， 为你的慈爱和诚实称赞你的名； 因你使你的话显为大， 过于你所应许的。
138.en: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.

138.zh: 我呼求的日子，你就应允我， 鼓励我，使我心里有能力。
138.en: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.

138.zh: 耶和华啊，地上的君王都要称谢你， 因他们听见了你口中的言语。
138.en: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, LORD, for they have heard the words of your mouth.

138.zh: 他们要歌颂耶和华的作为， 因耶和华大有荣耀。
138.en: Yes, they will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the LORD’s glory is great!

138.zh: 耶和华虽高，仍看顾低微的人； 他却从远处看出骄傲的人。
138.en: For though the LORD is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.

138.zh: 我虽行在患难中，你必将我救活； 我的仇敌发怒，你必伸手抵挡他们； 你的右手也必救我。
138.en: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.

138.zh: 耶和华必成全关乎我的事； 耶和华啊，你的慈爱永远长存！ 求你不要离弃你手所造的。
138.en: The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.

139.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。 耶和华啊，你已经鉴察我，认识我。
139.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. LORD, you have searched me, and you know me.

139.zh: 我坐下，我起来，你都晓得； 你从远处知道我的意念。
139.en: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.

139.zh: 我行路，我躺卧，你都细察； 你也深知我一切所行的。
139.en: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.

139.zh: 耶和华啊，我舌头上的话， 你没有一句不知道的。
139.en: For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, LORD, you know it altogether.

139.zh: 你在我前后环绕我， 按手在我身上。
139.en: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.

139.zh: [这样的]知识奇妙，是我不能测的， 至高，是我不能及的。
139.en: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.

139.zh: 我往哪里去躲避你的灵？ 我往哪里逃、躲避你的面？
139.en: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?

139.zh: 我若升到天上，你在那里； 我若在阴间下榻，你也在那里。
139.en: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!

139.zh: 我若展开清晨的翅膀， [飞]到海极居住，
139.en: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,

139.zh: 就是在那里，你的手必引导我； 你的右手也必扶持我。
139.en: even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.

139.zh: 我若说：黑暗必定遮蔽我， 我周围的亮光必成为黑夜；
139.en: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”

139.zh: 黑暗也不能遮蔽我，使你不见， 黑夜却如白昼发亮。 黑暗和光明，[在你看]都是一样。
139.en: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.

139.zh: 我的肺腑是你所造的； 我在母腹中，你已覆庇我。
139.en: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.

139.zh: 我要称谢你，因我受造，奇妙可畏； 你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。
139.en: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

139.zh: 我在暗中受造，在地的深处被联络； 那时，我的形体并不向你隐藏。
139.en: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.

139.zh: 我未成形的体质，你的眼早已看见了； 你所定的日子，我尚未度一日， 你都写在你的册上了。
139.en: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.

139.zh: 神啊，你的意念向我何等宝贵！ 其数何等众多！
139.en: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!

139.zh: 我若数点，比海沙更多； 我睡醒的时候，仍和你同在。
139.en: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.

139.zh: 神啊，你必要杀戮恶人； 所以，你们好流人血的，离开我去吧！
139.en: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!

139.zh: 因为他们说恶言顶撞你； 你的仇敌也妄称[你的名]。
139.en: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.

139.zh: 耶和华啊，恨恶你的，我岂不恨恶他们吗？ 攻击你的，我岂不憎嫌他们吗？
139.en: LORD, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?

139.zh: 我切切地恨恶他们， 以他们为仇敌。
139.en: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.

139.zh: 神啊，求你鉴察我，知道我的心思， 试炼我，知道我的意念，
139.en: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.

139.zh: 看在我里面有什么恶行没有， 引导我走永生的道路。
139.en: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.

140.zh: 大卫的诗，交与伶长。 耶和华啊，求你拯救我脱离凶恶的人， 保护我脱离强暴的人！
140.en: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Deliver me, LORD, from evil men. Preserve me from violent men:

140.zh: 他们心中图谋奸恶， 常常聚集要争战。
140.en: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.

140.zh: 他们使舌头尖利如蛇， 嘴里有虺蛇的毒气。 （细拉）
140.en: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.

140.zh: 耶和华啊，求你拯救我脱离恶人的手， 保护我脱离强暴的人！ 他们图谋推我跌倒。
140.en: LORD, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.

140.zh: 骄傲人为我暗设网罗和绳索； 他们在路旁铺下网，设下圈套。 （细拉）
140.en: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.

140.zh: 我曾对耶和华说：你是我的　神。 耶和华啊，求你留心听我恳求的声音！
140.en: I said to the LORD, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, LORD.

140.zh: 主—耶和华、我救恩的力量啊， 在争战的日子，你遮蔽了我的头。
140.en: LORD, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.

140.zh: 耶和华啊，求你不要遂恶人的心愿； 不要成就他们的计谋，[恐怕]他们自高。 （细拉）
140.en: LORD, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.

140.zh: 至于那些昂首围困我的人， 愿他们嘴唇的奸恶陷害自己！
140.en: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

140.zh: 愿火炭落在他们身上！ 愿他们被丢在火中， 抛在深坑里，不能再起来。
140.en: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.

140.zh: 说恶言的人在地上必坚立不住； 祸患必猎取强暴的人，将他打倒。
140.en: An evil speaker won’t be established on the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

140.zh: 我知道耶和华必为困苦人伸冤， 必为穷乏人辨屈。
140.en: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.

140.zh: 义人必要称赞你的名； 正直人必住在你面前。
140.en: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.

141.zh: 大卫的诗。 耶和华啊，我曾求告你， 求你快快临到我这里！ 我求告你的时候， 愿你留心听我的声音！
141.en: A Psalm by David. LORD, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.

141.zh: 愿我的祷告如香陈列在你面前！ 愿我举手[祈求]，如献晚祭！
141.en: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.

141.zh: 耶和华啊，求你禁止我的口， 把守我的嘴！
141.en: Set a watch, LORD, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.

141.zh: 求你不叫我的心偏向邪恶， 以致我和作孽的人同行恶事； 也不叫我吃他们的美食。
141.en: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.

141.zh: 任凭义人击打我，[这算为]仁慈； 任凭他责备我，[这算为]头上的膏油； 我的头不要躲闪。 正在他们行恶的时候，我仍要祈祷。
141.en: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.

141.zh: 他们的审判官被扔在岩下； 众人要听我的话，因为这话甘甜。
141.en: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.

141.zh: 我们的骨头散在墓旁， 好像人耕田、刨地的土块。
141.en: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”

141.zh: 主—耶和华啊，我的眼目仰望你； 我投靠你，求你不要将我撇得孤苦！
141.en: For my eyes are on you, LORD, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul destitute.

141.zh: 求你保护我脱离恶人为我设的网罗 和作孽之人的圈套！
141.en: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.

141.zh: 愿恶人落在自己的网里， 我却得以逃脱。
141.en: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.

142.zh: 大卫在洞里作的训诲诗，乃是祈祷。 我发声哀告耶和华， 发声恳求耶和华。
142.en: A contemplation by David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer. I cry with my voice to the LORD. With my voice, I ask the LORD for mercy.

142.zh: 我在他面前吐露我的苦情， 陈说我的患难。
142.en: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.

142.zh: 我的灵在我里面发昏的时候， 你知道我的道路。 在我行的路上， 敌人为我暗设网罗。
142.en: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.

142.zh: 求你向我右边观看， 因为没有人认识我； 我无处避难， 也没有人眷顾我。
142.en: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.

142.zh: 耶和华啊，我曾向你哀求。 我说：你是我的避难所； 在活人之地，你是我的福分。
142.en: I cried to you, LORD. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”

142.zh: 求你侧耳听我的呼求， 因我落到极卑之地； 求你救我脱离逼迫我的人， 因为他们比我强盛。
142.en: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.

142.zh: 求你领我出离被囚之地， 我好称赞你的名。 义人必环绕我， 因为你是用厚恩待我。
142.en: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.

143.zh: 大卫的诗。 耶和华啊，求你听我的祷告， 留心听我的恳求， 凭你的信实和公义应允我。
143.en: A Psalm by David. Hear my prayer, LORD. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.

143.zh: 求你不要审问仆人； 因为在你面前，凡活着的人没有一个是义的。
143.en: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.

143.zh: 原来仇敌逼迫我， 将我打倒在地， 使我住在幽暗之处， 像死了许久的人一样。
143.en: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.

143.zh: 所以，我的灵在我里面发昏； 我的心在我里面凄惨。
143.en: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.

143.zh: 我追想古时之日， 思想你的一切作为， 默念你手的工作。
143.en: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.

143.zh: 我向你举手； 我的心[渴想]你， 如干旱之地[盼雨]一样。 （细拉）
143.en: I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah.

143.zh: 耶和华啊，求你速速应允我！ 我心神耗尽！ 不要向我掩面， 免得我像那些下坑的人一样。
143.en: Hurry to answer me, LORD. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.

143.zh: 求你使我清晨得听你慈爱[之言]， 因我倚靠你； 求你使我知道当行的路， 因我的心仰望你。
143.en: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.

143.zh: 耶和华啊，求你救我脱离我的仇敌！ 我往你那里藏身。
143.en: Deliver me, LORD, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.

143.zh: 求你指教我遵行你的旨意， 因你是我的　神。 你的灵本为善； 求你引我到平坦之地。
143.en: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.

143.zh: 耶和华啊，求你为你的名将我救活， 凭你的公义，将我从患难中领出来，
143.en: Revive me, LORD, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.

143.zh: 凭你的慈爱剪除我的仇敌， 灭绝一切苦待我的人， 因我是你的仆人。
143.en: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, for I am your servant.

144.zh: 大卫的诗。 耶和华—我的磐石是应当称颂的！ 他教导我的手争战， 教导我的指头打仗。
144.en: By David. Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle—

144.zh: 他是我慈爱[的主]，我的山寨， 我的高台，我的救主， 我的盾牌，是我所投靠的； 他使我的百姓服在我以下。
144.en: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.

144.zh: 耶和华啊，人算什么，你竟认识他！ 世人算什么，你竟顾念他！
144.en: LORD, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?

144.zh: 人好像一口气； 他的年日如同影儿快快过去。
144.en: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.

144.zh: 耶和华啊，求你使天下垂，亲自降临， 摸山，山就冒烟。
144.en: Part your heavens, LORD, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.

144.zh: 求你发出闪电，使他们四散， 射出你的箭，使他们扰乱。
144.en: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.

144.zh: 求你从上伸手救拔我， 救我出离大水， 救我脱离外邦人的手。
144.en: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,

144.zh: 他们的口说谎话； 他们的右手起假誓。
144.en: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

144.zh: 神啊，我要向你唱新歌， 用十弦瑟向你歌颂。
144.en: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.

144.zh: 你是那拯救君王的； 你是那救仆人大卫脱离害命之刀的。
144.en: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.

144.zh: 求你救拔我， 救我脱离外邦人的手。 他们的口说谎话； 他们的右手起假誓。
144.en: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

144.zh: 我们的儿子从幼年好像树栽子长大； 我们的女儿如同殿角石， 是按建宫的样式凿成的。
144.en: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

144.zh: 我们的仓盈满，能出各样的粮食； 我们的羊在田间孳生千万。
144.en: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.

144.zh: 我们的牛驮着满驮， 没有人闯进来[抢夺]， 也没有人出去[争战]； 我们的街市上也没有哭号的声音。
144.en: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.

144.zh: 遇见这光景的百姓便为有福！ 有耶和华为他们的　神，这百姓便为有福！
144.en: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is the LORD.

145.zh: 大卫的赞美诗。 我的　神我的王啊，我要尊崇你！ 我要永永远远称颂你的名！
145.en: A praise psalm by David. I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.

145.zh: 我要天天称颂你， 也要永永远远赞美你的名！
145.en: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.

145.zh: 耶和华本为大，该受大赞美； 其大无法测度。
145.en: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.

145.zh: 这代要对那代颂赞你的作为， 也要传扬你的大能。
145.en: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.

145.zh: 我要默念你威严的尊荣 和你奇妙的作为。
145.en: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.

145.zh: 人要传说你可畏之事的能力； 我也要传扬你的大德。
145.en: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.

145.zh: 他们记念你的大恩就要传出来， 并要歌唱你的公义。
145.en: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.

145.zh: 耶和华有恩惠，有怜悯， 不轻易发怒，大有慈爱。
145.en: The LORD is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.

145.zh: 耶和华善待万民； 他的慈悲覆庇他一切所造的。
145.en: The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.

145.zh: 耶和华啊，你一切所造的都要称谢你； 你的圣民也要称颂你，
145.en: All your works will give thanks to you, LORD. Your saints will extol you.

145.zh: 传说你国的荣耀， 谈论你的大能，
145.en: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,

145.zh: 好叫世人知道你大能的作为， 并你国度威严的荣耀。
