145.en: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.

145.zh: 你的国是永远的国！ 你执掌的权柄存到万代！
145.en: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. The LORD is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.

145.zh: 凡跌倒的，耶和华将他们扶持； 凡被压下的，将他们扶起。
145.en: The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.

145.zh: 万民都举目仰望你； 你随时给他们食物。
145.en: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.

145.zh: 你张手， 使有生气的都随愿饱足。
145.en: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

145.zh: 耶和华在他一切所行的，无不公义； 在他一切所做的都有慈爱。
145.en: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.

145.zh: 凡求告耶和华的，就是诚心求告他的， 耶和华便与他们相近。
145.en: The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

145.zh: 敬畏他的，他必成就他们的心愿， 也必听他们的呼求，拯救他们。
145.en: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

145.zh: 耶和华保护一切爱他的人， 却要灭绝一切的恶人。
145.en: The LORD preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.

145.zh: 我的口要说出赞美耶和华的话； 惟愿凡有血气的都永永远远称颂他的圣名。
145.en: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.

146.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 我的心哪，你要赞美耶和华！
146.en: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, my soul.

146.zh: 我一生要赞美耶和华！ 我还活的时候要歌颂我的　神！
146.en: While I live, I will praise the LORD. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.

146.zh: 你们不要倚靠君王，不要倚靠世人； 他一点不能帮助。
146.en: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.

146.zh: 他的气一断，就归回尘土； 他所打算的，当日就消灭了。
146.en: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.

146.zh: 以雅各的　神为帮助、 仰望耶和华—他　神的，这人便为有福！
146.en: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD, his God,

146.zh: 耶和华造天、地、海，和其中的万物； 他守诚实，直到永远。
146.en: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;

146.zh: 他为受屈的伸冤， 赐食物与饥饿的。 耶和华释放被囚的；
146.en: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD frees the prisoners.

146.zh: 耶和华开了瞎子的[眼睛]； 耶和华扶起被压下的人。 耶和华喜爱义人。
146.en: The LORD opens the eyes of the blind. The LORD raises up those who are bowed down. The LORD loves the righteous.

146.zh: 耶和华保护寄居的， 扶持孤儿和寡妇， 却使恶人的道路弯曲。
146.en: The LORD preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.

146.zh: 耶和华要作王，直到永远！ 锡安哪，你的　神要作王，直到万代！ 你们要赞美耶和华！
146.en: The LORD will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!

147.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 因歌颂我们的　神为善为美； 赞美的话是合宜的。
147.en: Praise the LORD, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.

147.zh: 耶和华建造耶路撒冷， 聚集以色列中被赶散的人。
147.en: The LORD builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.

147.zh: 他医好伤心的人， 裹好他们的伤处。
147.en: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

147.zh: 他数点星宿的数目， 一一称它的名。
147.en: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.

147.zh: 我们的主为大，最有能力； 他的智慧无法测度。
147.en: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.

147.zh: 耶和华扶持谦卑人， 将恶人倾覆于地。
147.en: The LORD upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.

147.zh: 你们要以感谢向耶和华歌唱， 用琴向我们的　神歌颂。
147.en: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,

147.zh: 他用云遮天，为地降雨， 使草生长在山上。
147.en: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.

147.zh: 他赐食给走兽 和啼叫的小乌鸦。
147.en: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.

147.zh: 他不喜悦马的力[大]， 不喜爱人的腿[快]。
147.en: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

147.zh: 耶和华喜爱敬畏他 和盼望他慈爱的人。
147.en: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.

147.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，你要颂赞耶和华！ 锡安哪，你要赞美你的　神！
147.en: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!

147.zh: 因为他坚固了你的门闩， 赐福给你中间的儿女。
147.en: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.

147.zh: 他使你境内平安， 用上好的麦子使你满足。
147.en: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.

147.zh: 他发命在地； 他的话颁行最快。
147.en: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.

147.zh: 他降雪如羊毛， 撒霜如炉灰。
147.en: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.

147.zh: 他掷下冰雹如碎渣； 他发出寒冷，谁能当得起呢？
147.en: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?

147.zh: 他一出令，这些就都消化； 他使风刮起，水便流动。
147.en: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

147.zh: 他将他的道指示雅各， 将他的律例典章指示以色列。
147.en: He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.

147.zh: 别国他都没有这样待过； 至于他的典章，他们向来没有知道。 你们要赞美耶和华！
147.en: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise the LORD!

148.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 从天上赞美耶和华， 在高处赞美他！
148.en: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!

148.zh: 他的众使者都要赞美他！ 他的诸军都要赞美他！
148.en: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!

148.zh: 日头月亮，你们要赞美他！ 放光的星宿，你们都要赞美他！
148.en: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!

148.zh: 天上的天和天上的水， 你们都要赞美他！
148.en: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.

148.zh: 愿这些都赞美耶和华的名！ 因他一吩咐便都造成。
148.en: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for he commanded, and they were created.

148.zh: 他将这些立定，直到永永远远； 他定了命，不能废去。
148.en: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.

148.zh: 所有在地上的， 大鱼和一切深洋，
148.en: Praise the LORD from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths,

148.zh: 火与冰雹，雪和雾气， 成就他命的狂风，
148.en: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy wind, fulfilling his word,

148.zh: 大山和小山， 结果的树木和一切香柏树，
148.en: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,

148.zh: 野兽和一切牲畜， 昆虫和飞鸟，
148.en: wild animals and all livestock, small creatures and flying birds,

148.zh: 世上的君王和万民， 首领和世上一切审判官，
148.en: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,

148.zh: 少年人和处女， 老年人和孩童， 都当赞美耶和华！
148.en: both young men and maidens, old men and children.

148.zh: 愿这些都赞美耶和华的名！ 因为独有他的名被尊崇； 他的荣耀在天地之上。
148.en: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.

148.zh: 他将他百姓的角高举， 因此他一切圣民以色列人， 就是与他相近的百姓，都赞美他！ 你们要赞美耶和华！
148.en: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise the LORD!

149.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 向耶和华唱新歌， 在圣民的会中赞美他！
149.en: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.

149.zh: 愿以色列因造他的主欢喜！ 愿锡安的民因他们的王快乐！
149.en: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

149.zh: 愿他们跳舞赞美他的名， 击鼓弹琴歌颂他！
149.en: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!

149.zh: 因为耶和华喜爱他的百姓； 他要用救恩当作谦卑人的妆饰。
149.en: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.

149.zh: 愿圣民因[所得的]荣耀高兴！ 愿他们在床上欢呼！
149.en: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.

149.zh: 愿他们口中称赞　神为高， 手里有两刃的刀，
149.en: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,

149.zh: 为要报复列邦， 刑罚万民。
149.en: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;

149.zh: 要用链子捆他们的君王， 用铁镣锁他们的大臣；
149.en: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

149.zh: 要在他们身上施行所记录的审判。 他的圣民都有这荣耀。 你们要赞美耶和华！
149.en: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise the LORD!

150.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 在　神的圣所赞美他！ 在他显能力的穹苍赞美他！
150.en: Praise the LORD! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!

150.zh: 要因他大能的作为赞美他， 按着他极美的大德赞美他！
150.en: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!

150.zh: 要用角声赞美他， 鼓瑟弹琴赞美他！
150.en: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!

150.zh: 击鼓跳舞赞美他！ 用丝弦的乐器和箫[的声音]赞美他！
150.en: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!

150.zh: 用大响的钹赞美他！ 用高声的钹赞美他！
150.en: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!

150.zh: 凡有气息的都要赞美耶和华！ 你们要赞美耶和华！
150.en: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!
